generic_caravan_expedition_DESCRIPTION.text: There is no sea road to [SCOPE.sCountry('generic_trade_expedition_partner').GetName|Y], my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], and there does not need to be one. The markets of [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] can be reached by anybody willing to feed several hundred animals across open country and arrive at the other end with the load still on their backs; our people have been doing precisely that since long before anyone here owned a ship.

generic_caravan_expedition_CRITERIA_DESC.text: This venture will be finished once a caravan has traveled from [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName|Y] to the market at [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y], taken on cargo, returned home, and the accounts have been settled.

generic_caravan_expedition_BUTTON_TOOLTI.text: Send an overland trading caravan to a neighboring country.

generic_caravan_expedition_BUTTON_DETAIL.text: For realms with no coast to sail from, and for those who never did see the point of ships. A nearby country with a market and no quarrel with us will be chosen as our trade partner.

generic_caravan_expedition_REWARD_DESCRI.text: Completing this venture grants gold, #T Political Influence#!, warmer relations and trade modifiers; at the end we shall also choose a permanent #Y Charter#! that decides what our foreign trade becomes for a generation.

generic_caravan_expedition_open_contacts.text: Caravans do not simply happen, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]. Someone must be named to lead it, someone must be persuaded to pay for it, and someone in [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] must be told that we are coming well before we arrive; a caravan that surprises a market gets the price it deserves.

generic_caravan_expedition_hire_guides_D.text: Men who know the wells, the passes, the seasons, and the people who live near all three. The route exists inside their heads and nowhere else in the world; they are perfectly aware of what that is worth to us.

generic_caravan_expedition_survey_home_m.text: Before we load a single beast we ought to know what will actually sell when we get back. A caravan that returns with the wrong goods has simply walked a very long way for nothing.

generic_caravan_expedition_exchange_gift.text: Courtesy travels ahead of the caravan or it does not travel at all. What we send to [SCOPE.sCountry('generic_trade_expedition_partner').GetName|Y] now will decide how the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] are received in three months' time.

generic_caravan_expedition_appoint_escor.text: A loaded caravan moves at the pace of its slowest animal and can be seen from a very long way off. Riders who can discourage the curious are not a luxury on this road; they are the difference between a venture and a gift.

generic_caravan_expedition_secure_passag.text: Between here and [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] the road belongs to other people. We would much rather cross it with their blessing than explain ourselves at every ford and every guard post along the way.

generic_caravan_expedition_chart_route_D.text: Wells, grazing, passes, the stages where water must be carried and the stages where the water must not be trusted. Written down, all of it becomes a road; left unwritten, it dies with whichever old man happens to remember it.

generic_caravan_expedition_provision_car.text: Fodder, waterskins, spare harness, salt, and the several hundred small things whose absence turns a profitable venture into a line of bones across the dry country.

generic_caravan_expedition_departure_fea.text: The caravan leaves at dawn, and half of those watching it go are related to somebody walking with it. A feast the night before is worth more than the meat costs us.

generic_caravan_expedition_assemble_cara.text: Bring the beasts, the goods and the escort together at [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName|Y] under our envoy's command, and put them all on the road.

generic_caravan_expedition_assemble_tt.text: Our envoy must command an army of at least #Y 5#! units.

generic_caravan_expedition_reach_market_.text: Our envoy's caravan must be at #Y [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName]#!.

generic_caravan_expedition_return_home_t.text: Our envoy's caravan must have returned to #Y [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName]#!.

generic_caravan_expedition_reach_waystat.text: The stage is far too long to walk in one go. [SCOPE.sCountry('generic_trade_expedition_stopover_country').GetName|Y] holds the only water on it, and knows perfectly well that it does.

generic_caravan_expedition_reach_partner.text: Bring the caravan into [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] with the load intact and the animals still standing; anything less and we shall be selling our beasts to pay for the journey home.

generic_caravan_expedition_register_with.text: No stall, no scales and no storage until the warden of [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] has written our names into his book and decided how he feels about them.

generic_caravan_expedition_settle_custom.text: The duties on a caravan this size are a matter of judgement, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]; and the judgement belongs entirely to a man who can be reasoned with in more than one way.

generic_caravan_expedition_meet_market_g.text: The guilds of [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] decide what a stranger's goods are worth long before the stranger has finished unpacking them.

generic_caravan_expedition_outbid_rival_.text: [SCOPE.sCountry('generic_trade_expedition_rival').GetName|Y] has been trading here for years, and the guildmasters have already been warned about us at some length.

generic_caravan_expedition_load_cargo_DE.text: Choose what goes home with us. Every beast can carry one load and no more; what we decide here is the whole profit of the venture.

generic_caravan_expedition_plant_factor_.text: A permanent house in [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] with our own factors sitting in it, so that the next caravan arrives somewhere rather than merely arriving.

generic_caravan_expedition_seal_manifest.text: Everything counted, everything witnessed, everything sealed. Whatever is not on the list will not be missed until it is far too late to ask anybody about it.

generic_caravan_expedition_return_passag.text: Every animal in the train is now carrying the profit of the whole venture, at walking pace, through open country. This is the dangerous half, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle].

generic_caravan_expedition_return_home_D.text: Bring the caravan back to [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName|Y] and let the counting begin.

generic_caravan_expedition_honor_envoy_D.text: The man who walked to a foreign market and back has come home rich, and rather better known than he was when he left.

generic_caravan_expedition_count_profits.text: Close the accounts, and decide what this venture is going to become.

generic_caravan_expedition_risk_check_tt.text: #Y The road is not a safe one.#!\n  There is a [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_trade_expedition_risk_svalue')|Y0]% chance of trouble on this stage; #R hard country and dry wells#!, #R riders on the ridge#!, #R the drovers refusing to move#!, a #R market closed against us#!, or #R our envoy taken ill#! far from home.\n  An escort, full provisions, a charted route and a friendly waystation all make this less likely; distance, foreign tariffs and a rival working the same market all make it worse.

generic_caravan_expedition_return_risk_c.text: #Y The loaded road home is the dangerous one, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle].#!\n  The caravan is tested #Y twice#! on this stage, each time with a [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_trade_expedition_risk_svalue')|Y0]% chance of trouble; #R hard country#!, #R bandits#!, #R the drovers refusing to move#!, a #R market closed against us#!, or #R our envoy taken ill#!.\n  Every animal in the train is carrying the profit of the whole venture, at walking pace, in open country.

generic_caravan_expedition_raise_capital.text: Somebody has to pay for several hundred animals and the men who walk beside them, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]; and whoever pays for a venture tends to end up owning it. The treasury can carry it, our merchant houses would be glad to help, and the temples lend at reasonable rates to ventures they approve of.

generic_caravan_expedition_commission_me.text: Names on contracts, shares agreed, and the factors who will do the actual bargaining chosen and sworn. Our envoy speaks for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T]; these men will speak for the purse.

generic_caravan_expedition_publish_chart.text: The wells, the passes and the warnings gathered on this journey should not stay in one guide's head. Written out and copied, they turn a dangerous crossing into a road.

generic_migration_invasion_DESCRIPTION.text: The settled peoples beyond our border have grown comfortable behind fields, roads, granaries, and walls. Their lands are close enough for our warbands to reach, and rich enough that their ruin would feed our people, frighten our rivals, and open new ground for migration.

generic_migration_invasion_CRITERIA_DESC.text: This mission will be completed when our tribes have established a foothold, driven captives before the warbands, and broken enough of #Y [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName]#! to claim the spoils.

generic_migration_invasion_BUTTON_TOOLTI.text: Gather the clans for a war of plunder and migration.

generic_migration_invasion_BUTTON_DETAIL.text: A neighboring foreign region will be chosen as the target of a migratory invasion.

generic_migration_invasion_REWARD_DESCRI.text: Completing this mission grants military experience, a temporary migration legend modifier, and a final choice over the conquered lands.

generic_migration_invasion_prepare_DESC.text: Before crossing into [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|Y], the clans must be called to arms. It is time to gather the raiding parties and unleash the hounds of war!

generic_migration_invasion_prepare_tt.text: #Y [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName]#! must use the #T Government Interaction#! #Y Assemble Raiding Parties#!.

generic_migration_invasion_raise_horde_D.text: Promises of plunder are wind until families, herds, wagons, and warriors begin to move. A true invasion requires more than a raiding party: it requires a people ready to leave old ground behind.

generic_migration_invasion_raise_horde_t.text: #Y [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName]#! must raise at least #Y 1#! migratory horde. (#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_migratory_horde_svalue')|0]#!/#Y 1#!)

generic_migration_invasion_foothold_DESC.text: A migrating host does not need walls to begin an invasion. Once our wagons, herds, and warriors are inside [SCOPE.sArea('migration_invasion_target_area').GetName|Y], the clans can turn open ground into a forward camp and begin stripping the enemy countryside.

generic_migration_invasion_foothold_tt.text: Have at least #Y 1#! non-exiled migratory horde in #Y [SCOPE.sArea('migration_invasion_target_area').GetName]#!. (#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_target_area_foothold_svalue')|0]#!/#Y 1#!)

generic_migration_invasion_scour_area_DE.text: Not every settlement needs to be held. Some need only be made into warnings. A few burned storehouses and emptied villages in [SCOPE.sArea('migration_invasion_target_area').GetName|Y] will make the enemy spend soldiers protecting homes instead of meeting us in battle.

generic_migration_invasion_scour_area_tt.text: At least #Y 2#! territories in #Y [SCOPE.sArea('migration_invasion_target_area').GetName]#! have been #R Razed#! or #R Pillaged#!. (#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_target_area_devastated_svalue')|0]#!/#Y 2#!)

generic_migration_invasion_seize_strongh.text: A city taken by storm is more than a place on a map. Storehouses, shrines, armories, hostages, and scribal vaults all lie behind its gates. If we occupy such a city in [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|Y], the warriors can search it for plunder.

Occupy at least #Y 1#! foreign city in #Y [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName]#!. (#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_region_strongholds_controlled_svalue')|0]#!/#Y 1#!)
A random #R Sack Event#! will take place in the occupied city.

generic_migration_invasion_drive_captive.text: The enemy's granaries and harvest yards are as useful to us as their silver. With a month of raiding, the host can strip food from the countryside of [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|Y] and send it back to feed our capital.

Occupy, raze, or pillage at least #Y 1#! foreign territory in #Y [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName]#! whose province has at least #Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_burned_fields_food_svalue')|0]#! Food @food_icon!.

generic_migration_invasion_burn_fields_r.text: One eligible enemy territory will be #R Pillaged#!. Its province loses #R [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_burned_fields_food_svalue')|0]#! Food @food_icon!, and our capital province gains #G [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_burned_fields_food_svalue')|0]#! Food @food_icon!.

generic_migration_invasion_sell_captives.text: The long march has gathered more captives than the clans can easily feed or guard. Traders, client chiefs, and distant markets will pay for the strongest among them, though such cruelty will leave its own stain on our rule.

Control, raze, or pillage at least #Y 3#! foreign territories in #Y [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName]#!. (#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_captives_available_svalue')|0]#!/#Y 3#!)
We will gain #G [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_captive_sale_income_svalue')|0]#! @gold! from selling captives gathered during the invasion, but also gain #R 5#! Tyranny @tyranny!.

generic_migration_invasion_complete_DESC.text: The invasion has shattered the old order beyond our border. Now we must decide whether these lands are to be kept, stripped bare, or remembered as a warning to the next people in our path.

generic_migration_invasion_complete_tt.text: Own, or have subjects own, at least #Y 50%#! of the territories in #Y [SCOPE.sArea('migration_invasion_target_area').GetName]#!. (#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_target_area_owned_or_subject_owned_svalue')|0]#!/#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_target_area_total_territories_svalue')|0]#!)

generic_migration_invasion_complete_rewa.text: A final event will decide what becomes of the conquered lands.

generic_migration_invasion_claim_annex_t.text: We will annex up to #Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_annexable_territories_svalue')|0]#! occupied or subject-held territories in #Y [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName]#!, gaining Tyranny and Aggressive Expansion.

generic_migration_invasion_claim_vassal_.text: A new #Y Tribal Vassal#! will be created from up to #Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_migration_invasion_vassalizable_territories_svalue')|0]#! foreign territories that we occupy in #Y [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName]#!, at a small cost in Political Influence and Aggressive Expansion.

generic_migration_invasion_claim_elites_.text: One #Y Noble#! or #Y Citizen#! pop from each owned, subject-held, or occupied territory in #Y [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName]#! will be moved to our capital and enslaved, where possible.

generic_migration_invasion_claim_purge_t.text: Every pop in our owned, subject-held, or occupied territories in #Y [SCOPE.sP('migration_invasion_target').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName]#! whose culture is neither our primary culture nor one of our integrated cultures will be killed. This will cost Stability and bring heavy Tyranny and Aggressive Expansion.

generic_migration_invasion_claim_warning.text: We make no further settlement, but the tale of the invasion will strengthen our hand among the clans.

gm_subject_independence_DESCRIPTION.text: Our overlord would have us remain their loyal subject in perpetuity, or else maybe claim our lands for themselves. Grumblings of discontent are growing and an independence movement is slowly building within our realm. #G Shrewd#! diplomacy and bold action are necessities if we are ever to free ourselves from subjugation.

gm_subject_independence_CRITERIA_DESCRIP.text: This mission tree will give options on how to pursue a path to independence and end our subject status.

gm_subject_independence_REWARD_DESCRIPTI.text: You will gain your independence through your chosen path.

gm_subject_independence_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: We must end our subject status with whatever means necessary.

gm_subject_independence_1.tt.text: Though everyone wishes for independence, there are major disagreements on how to win our freedom.\nDepending on your decisions during this process, a diplomatic or aggressive approach will be adopted.

gm_subject_independence_1_DESC.text: Gaining our independence is something all can agree on. It is however in the details that major debates spring from. #Y We need to have a#! consensus on how to approach this seemingly unsurmountable task.

gm_subject_independence_2a_DESC.text: There is no peaceful or diplomatic way that will grant us our desire. Only intimidation and aggressive posturing will get us there. And if necessary, we'll fight or die for it.

gm_subject_independence_2a.tt.text: There's no turning your back from here...

gm_subject_independence_3a_DESC.text: Our capital must be prepared for any enemy siege. Spending some time and resources on improving our local defenses will guarantee the safety of our citizens inside.

gm_subject_independence_4a_DESC.text: The army has seen better days. We must make sure that it is ready for anything.

gm_subject_independence_5a_DESC.text: We must ensure the loyalty of the great families. The fate of our nation has been often steered by the whims of these people. Securing their support is a priority.

gm_subject_independence_6a_DESC.text: Our overlord has many rivals, we must turn to them for help. Surely some of them would pledge their support in our time of need.

gm_subject_independence_6a.allow.text: A [our_overlord.GetRankName] nation must exist that is not an ally of [our_overlord.GetName].

gm_subject_independence_6a.tt.text: We will ask other nations to support our cause.

gm_subject_independence_7a_DESC.text: The toll on our resources has been great in preparing for the ultimatum. We will turn to members in our government to demand special favors for the greater good.

gm_subject_independence_7a.allow.text: You must have filled the religious positions in your government.

gm_subject_independence_7a.tt.text: We will ask several characters in our nation and abroad for gold, manpower, political influence, and religious support.

gm_subject_independence_8a_DESC.text: Our navy is not comparable to today's standards. We must take the time and effort to improve and increase our fleets.

gm_subject_independence_8a.allow.text: You need to have equal or more ships than [our_overlord.GetName] OR have more than #Y 20#! ships.

gm_subject_independence_8a.allow_2.text: You need a coastal province with a port.

gm_subject_independence_9a_DESC.text: We're almost there. This is the time to make our final preparations before we give the ultimatum to our overlord. Hopefully, this will proceed as smoothly as possible but there are a few disgruntled people who could pose some trouble.

gm_subject_independence_9a.tt.text: We will take care of any final preparations and draft our ultimatum to our overlord.\nAny characters that were slighted in the past will make some last minute protests...

gm_subject_independence_9a.allow.text: You need to do at least 3 tasks before starting.

gm_subject_independence_10a_DESC.text: Send the ultimatum! Our overlord must choose between peace or blood. We will fight for our freedom if it is not given willingly. Every citizen is ready to give their life for this goal. We will be free or we will die.

gm_subject_independence_10a.tt.text: The ultimatum is sent to [our_overlord.GetRuler.GetName] and we wait for his decision.\n- If it leads to war, any allies that pledged their support will join us against [our_overlord.GetName].\n- If our independence is granted, we will gain a truce with [our_overlord.GetName] and they will receive claims on our territory.

gm_subject_independence_11a_DESC.text: Independent at last! However because of our actions, we are sure to see the consequences of these actions in the coming years. Let's hope we are prepared to face the hardships to come.

gm_subject_independence_2b_DESC.text: We will attempt to sway our overlord and negotiate a mutually beneficial agreement that will grant us our independence. #T Diplomacy#! will prevail.

gm_subject_independence_2b.tt.text: There's no turning your back from here...

gm_subject_independence_3b_DESC.text: Increasing the relations with our overlord is crucial to succeeding in our attempt. If our proposal is to have any chance, they must be willing to listen to it in the first place.

gm_subject_independence_4b_DESC.text: Exchanging noteworthy people has been a part of history ever since we can remember. We will choose a volunteer to go live in our overlord's nation. With any luck, they will send someone as well.

gm_subject_independence_4b.tt.text: You will be able to send a character to [our_overlord.GetName] in exchange for improved relations.

gm_subject_independence_5b_DESC.text: Our capital city is the shining beacon of our society. We must build it up to reflect the greatness we can reach by ourselves.

gm_subject_independence_6b_DESC.text: Swaying our overlord can be done via gifts. We will demand from members in our government to provide these gifts for the greater good.

gm_subject_independence_6b.allow.text: Most positions in your government must be filled.

gm_subject_independence_6b.tt.text: You will be able to make offers of gold, manpower, etc. to [our_overlord.GetName] in exchange for improved relations.

gm_subject_independence_7b_DESC.text: Who doesn't appreciate gold? We will provide a personal gift to sway their ruler himself.

gm_subject_independence_8b_DESC.text: Befriending their ruler will provide a unique opportunity of direct communication with the man who will make the decision. Achieving this will benefit us greatly.

gm_subject_independence_9b_DESC.text: It is time. We will prepare the contract that will grant us our independence. Many have given much to get to this point, maybe even some disgruntled people might stir up some trouble.

gm_subject_independence_9b.tt.text: We will take care of any final preparations and draft our proposal to our overlord.\nAny characters that were slighted in the past will make some last minute protests...

gm_subject_independence_9b.allow.text: You need to do at least 3 tasks before starting.

gm_subject_independence_10b_DESC.text: Send the proposal! All we have to do is wait for their answer, but after all the efforts we have made, there is no doubt that our overlord will accept.

gm_subject_independence_10b.tt.text: The proposal is sent to [our_overlord.GetRuler.GetName] and we wait for his decision.\n- If our request is accepted, we will gain our independence and we will gain an alliance with [our_overlord.GetName] if possible.\n - If our request is denied, relations between the two nations will deteriorate but we will remain a subject. An alternate path will become available to make a final attempt at independence.

gm_subject_independence_11b_DESC.text: Independence at last. Our former overlord has granted us what we asked for. In exchange an alliance has been forged that is sure to last for decades. The trust in each other will prove to be extremely valuable in the coming years.

gm_subject_independence_11c_DESC.text: The unthinkable has happened. Our overlord has declined our proposal for independence. Many are disillusioned with this result as no one expected this outcome. What will we do from here?

gm_subject_independence_12c_DESC.text: We will send an operative inside their capital city to scout out opportunities for sabotage. This must be kept under wraps, since we don't want our overlord to know we are still looking to gain our independence.

gm_subject_independence_13c_DESC.text: An agent of ours will survey their military activities and let us know immediately if any opportunities present themselves that we can exploit.

gm_subject_independence_14c_DESC.text: Monitoring their navy and dockyards is a good way for finding weak spots in their naval activities. The person we send to do this, will have to be very careful.

gm_subject_independence_15c_DESC.text: A member of their government will be targeted. We will try and sway him to our cause. If possible, even convince them to join our side.

gm_subject_independence_16c_DESC.text: There are several key characters within our overlord's nation. Taking them out will cause great turmoil and will benefit our purposes. We must pursue this.

gm_subject_independence_17c_DESC.text: Robbers and brigands are not news. They pop up everywhere all the time. We will send some men from our reserves to pose as such a band and have them disrupt their capital province's countryside. Any spoils they would gain, will increase our coffers.

gm_subject_independence_17c.tt.text: A band of brigands will continually raid [our_overlord.GetName] and sporadically return the spoils of their successes.

gm_subject_independence_18c_DESC.text: There are others like us, bound to subject status by our overlord. We must try and convince them to join us when the time is right. Without the foundation, the tower will fall.

gm_subject_independence_18c.allow.text: Your overlord must have other subjects.

gm_subject_independence_19c_DESC.text: It is time to rid ourselves of this subject status. We will choose our own path. Declining our offer is a grave mistake that our overlord will never forget. Their nation crippled, what can they do to oppose our independence now?

gm_subject_independence_19c.allow.text: You need to do at least 4 tasks before proclaiming your independence.

generic_trade_expedition_DESCRIPTION.text: There is money to be made in the marketplaces of [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y], my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], and they are close enough that we could reach them without much trouble. If we charter the venture properly, name a good envoy, prepare the convoy and choose our cargo with some care, our merchants will come home with full holds; they will also come home with stories, foreign contacts, and a much better idea of what the world outside [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] is willing to pay for.

generic_trade_expedition_CRITERIA_DESCRI.text: This venture will be finished once a trade fleet has sailed from [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName|Y] to the market at [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y], taken on cargo, returned home in one piece, and the ledgers have been settled.

generic_trade_expedition_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: Send a friendly trading expedition to a neighboring coastal country.

generic_trade_expedition_BUTTON_DETAILS.text: A nearby country that does not dislike us, and that holds a port with a Marketplace in it, will be chosen as our trade partner.

generic_trade_expedition_REWARD_DESCRIPT.text: Completing this venture grants gold, #T Political Influence#!, warmer relations and trade modifiers; at the end we shall also choose a permanent #Y Charter#! that decides what our foreign trade becomes for a generation.

generic_trade_expedition_open_contacts_D.text: The merchants of [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] do not lack for visitors, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], and their rulers will not throw open their warehouses to strangers who simply turn up; someone must be named, someone must be paid, and word must be sent ahead. Let us charter the expedition properly and choose an envoy before a single sail is raised.

generic_trade_expedition_eligible_envoy_.text: We must have a suitable adult courtier who can lead the expedition.

generic_trade_expedition_envoy_selected_.text: We must choose an envoy to lead the expedition.

generic_trade_expedition_hire_interprete.text: A good bargain can sour over a single badly chosen word. Interpreters, harbor guides and scribes who understand foreign weights and measures will keep our envoy from mistaking courtesy for insult; they will also keep him from mistaking idle talk for a promise, which is the more expensive mistake of the two.

generic_trade_expedition_survey_home_mar.text: Before our ships leave [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName|Y], our merchants ought to find out what will actually sell here; there is no glory in sailing across the sea and returning with a hold full of something the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] people have no use for.

generic_trade_expedition_exchange_gifts_.text: Fine cloth, polished vessels, oath-gifts and carefully measured courtesy will show the court of [SCOPE.sCountry('generic_trade_expedition_partner').GetName|Y] that we mean to enrich them as well as ourselves. What we put in the gift ledger now decides how we are received later; as honored guests, as careful traders, or as petitioners with good manners and nothing else.

generic_trade_expedition_harbor_rights_D.text: Our envoys must secure safe harbor in [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y]. This is no conquest and no demand for tribute; it is a friendly request that our ships be allowed to enter, trade and leave again under formal protection.

generic_trade_expedition_chart_course_DE.text: The route between [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName|Y] and [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] must be copied into sailing notes that a captain can actually use. Even familiar water looks unfamiliar when the holds are full and foreign pilots are watching to see how well we know it.

generic_trade_expedition_provision_convo.text: Water casks, spare cordage, sealed grain, deck tools and guards who can be trusted; none of it is as impressive as the gifts, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], and the whole venture will fail without it.

generic_trade_expedition_departure_feast.text: A feast before the ships leave will show our own merchants that the crown stands behind this venture; it will also give any foreign eyes in [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName|Y] a pleasant taste of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] generosity, which never hurts.

generic_trade_expedition_assemble_convoy.text: No ruler ever won respect by sending a few leaking skiffs to a foreign market. A proper fleet must gather at [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName|Y] under the command of our chosen envoy before we go anywhere.

Have a navy of at least #Y 10#! ships docked in #Y [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName]#! and commanded by the chosen envoy. (#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_trade_expedition_home_convoys_svalue')|0]#!/#Y 1#!)

generic_trade_expedition_reach_partner_p.text: The harbor rights are granted and the way is open. Our envoy must now bring the fleet into [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y], where pilots from [SCOPE.sCountry('generic_trade_expedition_partner').GetName|Y] will guide our merchants in to the market.

Have the envoy-commanded navy of at least #Y 10#! ships docked in #Y [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName]#!. (#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_trade_expedition_partner_convoys_svalue')|0]#!/#Y 1#!)

generic_trade_expedition_register_harbor.text: #Y Nothing#! comes ashore in [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] without seals, dues, inspections and our names written into the correct ledgers. Our envoy must spend some days in the harbor office deciding how honestly to enter those records; a convoy must become visible to a port before it can become profitable in one.

generic_trade_expedition_inspect_warehou.text: Registration only puts us in the ledgers. Before any serious bargaining begins, our envoy should walk through the warehouses, quay sheds, locks and weighing rooms where our cargo will be sitting; it is remarkable what a man notices when he looks at the locks himself.

generic_trade_expedition_harbor_register.text: We must register the convoy with the harbor master in #Y [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName]#!.

generic_trade_expedition_meet_market_gui.text: The marketplace of [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] is a web of guilds, brokers, weighers, lenders and quiet family arrangements that nobody will explain to a stranger. Our envoy must sit with them and work out what sort of cargo is worth carrying home.

generic_trade_expedition_record_customs_.text: Our expedition is not only buying goods, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]. It is watching how foreign clerks write their contracts, how harbor dues are collected, how the guilds settle a quarrel, and how a busy market manages to keep its people honest; all of that is worth bringing home as well.

generic_trade_expedition_load_cargo_DESC.text: For several months our merchants will be weighing cargo, arguing over measures, hiring and re-hiring interpreters, and slowly learning what is genuinely worth the voyage home. The envoy's fleet must stay at anchor in [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] while all this goes on.

generic_trade_expedition_load_cargo_tt.text: Keep the envoy-commanded navy of at least #Y 10#! ships docked in #Y [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName]#!. (#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_trade_expedition_partner_convoys_svalue')|0]#!/#Y 1#!)

generic_trade_expedition_plant_factor_ho.text: A few trusted agents could stay behind in [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] after the fleet sails; keeping ledgers, writing letters, and doing the small favors that make the next expedition arrive somewhere rather than merely arrive.

generic_trade_expedition_seal_manifest_D.text: The goods are aboard, but cargo without a sealed manifest is simply an argument waiting to happen at the other end. Every chest, jar, bundle and debt must be written down and witnessed before we sail.

generic_trade_expedition_return_home_DES.text: The holds are full, the contracts are sealed, and every sailor in the fleet has his own account of which merchant cheated whom. Bring the envoy home to [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName|Y] before the profit, the lessons and the blame can all be divided without us.

generic_trade_expedition_return_home_tt.text: Return the envoy-commanded navy of at least #Y 10#! ships to dock in #Y [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_home_port').GetName]#!. (#Y [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_trade_expedition_home_convoys_svalue')|0]#!/#Y 1#!)

generic_trade_expedition_honor_envoy_DES.text: Our envoy carried our words, ate foreign dust, haggled under strange roofs and brought the fleet back whole. What we do with him now is worth thinking about carefully.

generic_trade_expedition_publish_charts_.text: The routes, harbor notes and warnings gathered on this voyage should not disappear into some captain's private chest. Copied out and given to our own masters, they will make the next voyage a good deal less uncertain.

generic_trade_expedition_count_profits_D.text: The fleet is home, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]. The cargo must be sold, the gifts displayed, the ledgers checked; and then we must decide what this venture is going to become.

generic_trade_expedition_appoint_escort_.text: Merchantmen ride low and slow, and every pilot between here and [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] knows exactly what that means. A few warships and a captain who answers to our envoy will cost us something now; they will be worth every coin the first time a strange sail turns toward the convoy.

generic_trade_expedition_make_stopover_D.text: The crossing is long enough that our holds will want fresh water and our hulls fresh pitch before we ever see the marketplace. [SCOPE.sCountry('generic_trade_expedition_stopover_country').GetName|Y] keeps a harbor on our route; whether we enter it as guests or simply enter it is for us to decide.

generic_trade_expedition_settle_customs_.text: #Y Nothing#! leaves the quays of [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] until the ledger agrees with the cargo. We may pay what is written; or we may pay rather less to the man holding the pen, and have him write something friendlier.

generic_trade_expedition_outbid_rival_DE.text: The factors of [SCOPE.sCountry('generic_trade_expedition_rival').GetName|Y] were here long before us, and the guildmasters of [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] already know their names and drink their wine. We can buy their place at the table, share the market with them, or find out what the guilds do when nobody bids at all.

generic_trade_expedition_return_passage_.text: Laden ships are slow ships, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], and every hull between [SCOPE.sP('generic_trade_expedition_partner_port').GetName|Y] and home is now carrying the entire profit of the venture. This is the leg that has drowned more fortunes than any storm at the outset.

generic_trade_expedition_factor_house_ca.text: We must keep fewer than #Y three#! foreign factor houses.

generic_trade_expedition_charter_company.text: #Y We shall grant the venture to a merchant house as a Chartered Company.#!\n  #G Permanent commerce, trade routes and standing abroad.#!\n  #R The house will grow into a power of its own; the crown pays for it in influence, forever.#!

generic_trade_expedition_charter_monopol.text: #Y We shall take the trade into the treasury as a Crown Monopoly.#!\n  #G Permanent tax and export revenue, and a steadier state.#!\n  #R Tyranny, unhappy citizens, and a partner who now bargains with a cartel instead of with traders.#!

generic_trade_expedition_charter_colony_.text: #Y We shall raise the factor house into a Factor Colony.#!\n  #G A permanent foothold, a claim on the port, and room for our people to grow there.#!\n  #R Aggressive expansion, a frightened partner, and a reputation that follows us.#!

generic_trade_expedition_charter_replace.text: #R This will tear up the Charter we already hold.#! Its modifiers are lost, the men who built their lives around it will not forget it, and our stability will suffer for it.

generic_trade_expedition_risk_check_tt.text: #Y The crossing is not a safe one.#!\n  There is a [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_trade_expedition_risk_svalue')|Y0]% chance of trouble on this leg; #R foul weather#!, #R pirates#!, #R quarrels among the crews#!, a #R harbor closed against us#!, or #R our envoy taken ill#! far from home.\n  An escort, full provisions, prepared charts and a friendly waystation all make this less likely; distance, foreign tariffs and a rival working the same market all make it worse.

generic_trade_expedition_return_risk_che.text: #Y The laden passage home is the dangerous one, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle].#!\n  The convoy is tested #Y twice#! on this leg, each time with a [SCOPE.ScriptValue('generic_trade_expedition_risk_svalue')|Y0]% chance of trouble; #R foul weather#!, #R pirates#!, #R quarrels among the crews#!, a #R harbor closed against us#!, or #R our envoy taken ill#!.\n  Every hull is carrying the whole profit of the venture. If we lose the cargo now, we lose very nearly everything the expedition was worth.

generic_trade_expedition_partner_haggle_.text: #Y [SCOPE.sCountry('generic_trade_expedition_partner').GetName] may decide our gifts were not quite enough#!, and ask for more before they open their harbor to us.

generic_trade_expedition_exclusivity_off.text: #Y [SCOPE.sCountry('generic_trade_expedition_partner').GetName] may offer us an exclusive partnership#!; better terms in their market, in exchange for our word that we shall send no other expedition anywhere for a decade.

generic_trade_expedition_raise_capital_D.text: Somebody has to pay for all of this before a single rope is bought, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]; and whoever pays for a venture tends to end up owning it. The treasury can carry it alone, our merchant houses would be delighted to help, and the temples have been known to lend at very reasonable rates to ventures they approve of.

generic_trade_expedition_commission_merc.text: Names on contracts, shares agreed, and the factors who will actually do the bargaining chosen and sworn. Our envoy speaks for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T]; these are the men who will speak for the purse.

generic_vampire_dominion_DESCRIPTION.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has chosen the province of [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y] as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] discreet larder for darker rites. Its people will endure a season of pallor, dread, and missing hours, while their [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] rises from the blood feast sharper, stronger, and more terrible than before.

generic_vampire_dominion_CRITERIA_DESCRI.text: This mission will be considered complete after the vampire ruler has drawn enough strength from #R [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName]#! to found an undying court.

generic_vampire_dominion_first_thirst_DE.text: After weeks of travel, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has finally arrived in [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y]. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective|Y] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle|T] has felt compelled by some strange inner urging to do [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] dark work here.

generic_vampire_dominion_cull_skeptics_D.text: There are people in [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y] that have seen too much and talk too freely - they have forgotten what it means to be afraid. Fear will teach a man to lower his eyes, to keep his mouth shut - lessons that are sorely needed in this godforsaken province.\n\n#R We will only be able to select three missions from this row before all others bypass.#!

generic_vampire_dominion_midnight_feedin.text: The strongest households will leave a bowl, a name, and an unlocked door at midnight. By morning they will remember nothing but the command to obey.\n\n#R We will only be able to select three missions from this row before all others bypass.#!

generic_vampire_dominion_thralls_in_silk.text: Five souls from the region will be quietly surrendered to the dark, and in their place, a pale host of #R Wraiths#! will gather that answer to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y].\n\n#R We will only be able to select three missions from this row before all others bypass.#!

generic_vampire_dominion_sealed_crypt_DE.text: A cold chamber will be dug beneath [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y] in a long-abandoned temple to some forgotten god, a place where the sun cannot pry and the stones remember every whispered oath.\n\n#R We will only be able to select three missions from this row before all others bypass.#!

generic_vampire_dominion_taste_for_polit.text: Envoys, advocates, and ambitious local worthies all carry excellent blood. Their secrets are almost as nourishing as their terror.\n\n#R We will only be able to select three missions from this row before all others bypass.#!

generic_vampire_dominion_pale_retinue_DE.text: The bravest youths of [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y] will guard the night roads. They will be less brave afterward, but far more useful.

generic_vampire_dominion_court_of_whispe.text: Every secret in [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y] will eventually pass through to the same dark room. By dawn, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] will know which lies are worth forgetting, and which ones are worth repeating.

generic_vampire_dominion_unnatural_mist.text: The Mist That Does Not Lift

generic_vampire_dominion_unnatural_mist_.text: A gray veil will settle over [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y]. Travelers will lose roads they have walked since childhood, and the ruler will never lose a scent.\n\n#R We will only be able to select three missions from this row before all others bypass.#!

generic_vampire_dominion_drained_herds_D.text: The stories being told by the farmers and shepherds living in [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y] are all of the same; at sunrise their cattle will be found pale in the fields, drained of every drop of blood.\n\n#R We will only be able to select three missions from this row before all others bypass.#!

generic_vampire_dominion_wolves_at_treel.text: The villagers living in [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y] are afraid to travel during the day by themselves and never at night, for there are packs of wolves stalking the forests and streets that have been killing people and animals.\n\n#R We will only be able to select three missions from this row before all others bypass.#!

generic_vampire_dominion_crows_never_lea.text: Black wings gather on rooftops and the streets are filled with the raucous laughter of malicious crows. They see everything in [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y], and it is whispered by the villagers that some master has taught them where to look.\n\n#R We will only be able to select three missions from this row before all others bypass.#!

generic_vampire_dominion_candlelight_nev.text: The people of [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y] will work all night rather than close their eyes - they are tormented by strange dreams and are afraid of what they see in them.\n\n#R We will only be able to select three missions from this row before all others bypass.#!

generic_vampire_dominion_silence_after_d.text: At sunset, [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y] will become obediently still, with all sounds of life disappearing into the night. All shops close their doors, and no one will leave their homes for any reason. There are no songs in the air, no creaking sound of cartwheels in the alleyways - just dead silence after dusk.

generic_vampire_dominion_undying_court_D.text: [SCOPE.sP('generic_vampire_dominion_target').GetName|Y] has yielded blood, fear, secrets, beasts, and sleepless devotion. It is time to crown the harvest and leave an undying court in its wake.

generic_vampire_dominion_bloodless_night.text: People wake weak and bloodless, unable to explain the pinprick wounds at their throats.

generic_vampire_dominion_culled_doubters.text: The loudest agitators have vanished and are no longer a thorn in our side. The survivors are quiet, obedient, and much less likely to cause trouble.

generic_vampire_dominion_night_tithe_pmo.text: Households leave offerings after sundown, and every offering seems to leave the province a little weaker.

generic_vampire_dominion_thrall_levies_p.text: Able-bodied locals have been drawn into private service, leaving farms and muster rolls thin.

generic_vampire_dominion_sealed_crypt_pm.text: A hidden crypt chills the land above it. The locals avoid the place, though none can say why.

generic_vampire_dominion_guest_who_never.text: We have taken an interest in micromanaging the local political affairs in our provinces in order to ensure we get what we want out of the region.

generic_vampire_dominion_pale_retinue_pm.text: The province's strongest recruits have become silent attendants to the throne.

generic_vampire_dominion_court_of_whispe.text: Informers and frightened petitioners crowd the shadows. Good ideas die quickly in such air.

generic_vampire_dominion_unnatural_mist_.text: A strange mist clings to the roads and fields, slowing travelers and dulling local labor.

generic_vampire_dominion_drained_herds_p.text: Livestock are found empty in the morning fields, and the granaries seem to empty with them.

generic_vampire_dominion_wolves_grown_bo.text: Predators prowl too close to the roads, and fewer locals volunteer for hard service.

generic_vampire_dominion_where_crows_gat.text: Watching birds crowd the shrines and rooftops, souring worship and daily life.

generic_vampire_dominion_sleepless_villa.text: The people keep candles burning until dawn. Work continues, but no one works well without sleep.

generic_vampire_dominion_quiet_hours_pmo.text: Fear keeps the peace after sunset, though markets and hearths both suffer from the silence.

generic_vampire_dominion_seat_of_pale_co.text: The province has become a chosen haunt of the ruler's undying court, honored only in the way prey is honored.

generic_vampire_dominion_culled_doubters.text: Those who questioned the ruler's nature have learned that discretion is healthier than curiosity.

generic_vampire_dominion_taste_for_polit.text: #T Diplomacy#! seems easier after sampling the fears and ambitions of important guests.

generic_vampire_dominion_pale_retinue_cm.text: Unnaturally loyal attendants haunt the palace corridors and obey without hesitation.

generic_vampire_dominion_realm_of_the_un.text: The realm remembers a season when the night ruled openly and few dared to resist.

generic_vampire_dominion_vigor_of_the_dr.text: The promise of a fresh hunt has invigorated us.

generic_vampire_dominion_scent_of_obedie.text: Fear has a flavor that can be smelled, and we have learned to savor it.

generic_vampire_dominion_warm_blood_char.text: Fresh strength burns beneath dead flesh.

generic_vampire_dominion_silken_thralls_.text: Charmed servants anticipate commands before they are spoken - the best kinds of soldiers.

generic_vampire_dominion_deathless_repos.text: Hidden rest and stolen warmth make us unnervingly lucid.

generic_vampire_dominion_sweetened_tongu.text: Our voice carries the softness of invitation and the weight of a locked door.

generic_vampire_dominion_pale_captain_ch.text: We command with cold precision, and bloodless attendants move as one.

generic_vampire_dominion_whisper_drinker.text: Secrets settle in the mind like rich wine, and we drink deeply from the chalice.

generic_vampire_dominion_mist_walker_cha.text: No fog can confuse a predator who made it...

generic_vampire_dominion_beast_blood_cha.text: Cruder feedings stir older instincts, which we will allow ourselves to indulge.

generic_vampire_dominion_lord_of_hungers.text: Packs of starving wolves seem to follow us wherever we go, much to the dismay of those around us.

generic_vampire_dominion_carrion_sight_c.text: Omens gather wherever weakness is about to become useful.

generic_vampire_dominion_sleepless_mind_.text: The stolen sleepless nights will never be returned to us, but it is too late for that now.

generic_vampire_dominion_dusk_command_ch.text: When the sun falls, every voice seems to wait for our permission to even breathe.

generic_vampire_dominion_lord_of_the_sap.text: An entire province's dread has been rendered into poise, hunger, and terrible authority.

generic_vampire_dominion_thrall_populati.text: Our chosen province must contain an owned territory with at least #Y 6#! pops, allowing five to be sacrificed without emptying the settlement.

generic_vampire_dominion_BUTTON_DETAILS.text: Draw strength from an owned province and establish an undying court.

generic_vampire_dominion_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: Begin the rites of the vampire dominion.

03_arteon_generic_DESCRIPTION.text: For centuries, the blood of mortals and immortals alike has watered the soil of #G Arteon#!, earning it the grim mantle of the #R Island of Eternal War#!. Three factions seek to take advantage of the realm's chaos and seize the island for themselves: the #T High Elven#! invaders clinging to their shattered coastal territories, the native #T Artheousan#! warriors gathered in the interior highlands, and the fanatical #T Viktreic#! converts who conquer in the name of their battle goddess [GetDeityDefinition('omen_viza').GetName|G]. All three wage brutal warfare against one another, showing no mercy in their struggle for the upper hand.\n\nPeace has long been a foreign concept on this cursed isle. Now, as the #T Great Slaver Navies#! return to the shores and independent colonies fracture under the weight of their own ambition, the island stands poised on a razor's edge. The old rivalries that once defined this land have collapsed into a chaotic scramble for survival — and the gates of history stand wide open for any faction bold enough to seize the mantle of leadership.

03_arteon_generic_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be considered complete when we have #Y Formed Arteon#!.

03_arteon_generic_task_1_DESC.text: This dark island does not forgive the unprepared. War is not a possibility on #Y Arteon#! — it is a certainty, as inevitable as the tide. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has seen to it that our armies reflect this reality: drilled, equipped, and ready for the trials ahead. Only the strong survive what is coming. We intend to be among them.

03_arteon_generic_task_2_DESC.text: Coin speaks a language that transcends race, religion, and faction. We shall seek out the finest mercenary companies in the land and bind them to us with lucrative contracts. The coming wars may demand strength of arms from beyond our own borders — foreign swords are an acceptable price for survival and expansion.

03_arteon_generic_task_3_DESC.text: The black sails of the #R Great Slaver Navies#! have raided our coastlines for long enough. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has decreed that this ends now. Watchtowers, fortified harbors, and a standing fleet will meet any raider before they can reach our villages. #Y Arteon#!'s people are not livestock to be seized.

03_arteon_generic_task_4_DESC.text: With our forces hardened and our coasts defended, the time has come to assert our sovereignty over our core territories. No empire was ever built on borrowed ground. We must first bind the heartland together before we can look beyond its borders.

03_arteon_generic_task_eptelon_1_DESC.text: The city of [GetProvince('(int32)653').GetName|Y] has long been a nuisance — a rival port that watches our movements and shelters those who would oppose us. The time has come to turn that nuisance into an asset. Seizing it gives us a foothold on #G Eptelon#!, whose fierce and numerous population will prove a fine source of soldiers for wars to come.

03_arteon_generic_task_eptelon_2_DESC.text: We shall assemble a grand expeditionary force and carry the war to #Y Eptelon#! itself. Half measures will not do here — any threat to our eastern flank must be answered with overwhelming commitment of force. The island will not be taken by negotiation.

03_arteon_generic_task_eptelon_3_DESC.text: Every war produces its displaced, and the #Y Eptelonian#! campaigns are no exception. Rather than allow this tide of refugees to become a burden, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has ordered them directed toward the mines and fields of the realm. The wealth of conquest must be put to work.

03_arteon_generic_task_5a_DESC.text: The #T Artheousan#! people did not come to #Y Arteon#! as invaders — they are of this island, born from its soil and shaped by its wars. We shall assert our divine right to rule all of #T Artheon#!, but we must proceed with caution. What has been won in generations of struggle can be lost in a single reckless campaign. We advance in the name of #T Artheous#! — and with his guidance.

03_arteon_generic_task_6a_DESC.text: South #Y Arteon#! has sheltered our enemies for long enough. The armies of #T Artheous#! will march from the highlands and bring the south to heel once and for all. Those who surrender will be spared. Those who resist will learn what it means to raise arms against the chosen of the war god.

03_arteon_generic_task_arth_wyrm_DESC.text: The priests speak of the legendary #T Fang of Arteon#! — a relic said to have been carried by the first #T Artheousan#! war-king, a blade that marks its bearer as the chosen of #T Artheous#!. We shall seek it out and prove our divine right to rule. Let those who doubt the legitimacy of our claim answer that.

03_arteon_generic_task_arth_hort_DESC.text: The #Y Horteonians#! are not a sophisticated people, but they are a durable one — hardened by labor and accustomed to hardship. With the territories of [GetProvince('(int32)410').GetName|Y] and [GetProvince('(int32)425').GetName|Y] in our hands, we can draw from this reservoir of sturdy warriors to swell the ranks of our auxiliary forces.

03_arteon_generic_task_7a_DESC.text: The foreign invaders who have clung to the shores of #Y Arteon#! have had their time. #T Artheous#! walks alongside [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] into glorious battle, and the war god does not march for half-victories. Every invader must be driven into the sea. Every foreign banner must be torn down. Our island will be reclaimed in full — or not at all.

03_arteon_generic_task_8a_DESC.text: The #T First Great War#! left scars on this island that have never fully healed — in the soil, in the people, and in the memory of every #T Artheousan#! who was told of what was lost. With the west secured, those scars have finally been answered. We have not erased what was done. But we have repaid it.

03_arteon_generic_task_5b_DESC.text: The #Y High Elven#! philosophy of #G Ascendance#! teaches that mastery of the self must precede mastery of others. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] does not seek to conquer #Y Arteon#! through brute force alone — [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] seeks to reshape it through superior will, discipline, and the long patience of those who understand that the tide always turns in favor of those who can outlast the chaos.

03_arteon_generic_task_6b_DESC.text: The factions of #Y Arteon#! have hated one another for centuries, and their ancient grudges are a resource to be mined. We shall play our enemies against one another — lending support where it weakens the stronger party, withholding it where our rivals would benefit. The island's feuds shall do our work for us, at a fraction of the cost.

03_arteon_generic_task_7b_DESC.text: The fanatical worshippers of [GetDeityDefinition('omen_viza').GetName|G] have long terrorized the eastern reaches of #Y Arteon#! with their holy wars and their shrieking zealotry. They must be silenced. We will send the followers of the so-called victory goddess a message that they will not forget: the east belongs to the #T Ascendic#! order, and their goddess has no dominion here.

03_arteon_generic_task_8b_DESC.text: Supremacy over #Y Arteon#! is no longer a distant ambition — it is a reality taking shape before us. With our fleet commanding the seas and our philosophy proven on the field of battle, the #Y High Elven#! way stands poised to bring something this island has never truly known: an order that does not collapse the moment its architect dies.

03_arteon_generic_task_5c_DESC.text: A holy war shall be launched in the name of [GetDeityDefinition('omen_viza').GetName|G], who has blessed [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] with divine fervor and the absolute certainty that this Omostthanat cannot fail. The unbelievers of #Y Arteon#! will have the choice of conversion or conquest. [GetDeityDefinition('omen_viza').GetName|G] does not grant second chances.

03_arteon_generic_task_6c_DESC.text: Holy wars require holy funds. The traders and temple-keepers of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y] must be organized into a supply network worthy of the goddess's campaign. With precious metals flowing through our markets and coin blessed in the temples, the Omostthanat will never want for resources.

03_arteon_generic_task_7c_DESC.text: The light of [GetDeityDefinition('omen_viza').GetName|G] grows stronger in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y] with every passing season. The great temple burns day and night, and the faithful fill the streets with song and prayer. Let the light of the goddess guide us to final victory and a peace founded on sacred law — not merely the exhaustion of the combatants.

03_arteon_generic_task_8c_DESC.text: As foretold within the marbled halls of the temples in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y], the divine judgment of [GetDeityDefinition('omen_viza').GetName|G] has fallen upon the north of #Y Arteon#! — upon its blood-cursed dynasties, its ancient dark lords, and all who stood against the victory goddess. Prophecy and conquest, this day, are the same thing.

03_arteon_generic_task_atheus_grave_DESC.text: The #T Grave of Atheus#! has been carried into our possession, a monument to the conqueror who plunged #Y Arteon#! into centuries of bloodshed. We shall destroy the sarcophagus and consign his legacy to dust. In doing so, the people of the island will know that the old terror is finally gone.

03_arteon_generic_task_9_slayer_desc.text: It is no secret that the #R Vampire#! kings of #Y Northern Arteon#! have endured for centuries by feeding on the living and hiding behind walls no mortal army could breach alone. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has vowed to end this ancient blight. We shall reforge the legendary blade #R Grand Illuminator#! — said to burn with a light that no creature of darkness can endure — and carry it to the north as proof that the age of the vampires is over.

03_arteon_generic_task_9_vampire_desc.text: Our dominion over #Y Northern Arteon#! grows, but an unholy rule requires a symbol of terror and blood to cement it. We shall forge the legendary blade #R Blood Drinker#! — a weapon that hungers as its master hungers — and use it to seal our covenant with darkness and strike fear into the hearts of every mortal on this island.

03_arteon_generic_task_9_vampire_lord_DE.text: The forging is done. One final sacrament remains: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] must take up #R Blood Drinker#! with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] own hand and let #Y Arteon#! behold its true master. Once the blade is borne by a vampire sovereign, every lesser #R Vampire#! ruler on the island shall be marked for slaughter, their courts broken, their realms folded into our dark dominion. There can be only one.

03_arteon_generic_task_10_DESC.text: The wars have taken their toll on the cities of #Y Arteon#!. Cracked walls, burned districts, streets choked with rubble — these are the monuments that war leaves behind. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] intends to replace them with something better. Ten cities rebuilt and strengthened will demonstrate that our rule is not merely one of conquest, but of stewardship.

03_arteon_generic_task_11_DESC.text: A ruler who commands only the land is a prisoner of the shores. Our navy must be capable of projecting force far beyond our own coastline — ensuring that no foreign power can threaten #Y Arteon#! by sea, and that our trade lanes remain ours to control. Forty warships is a beginning. Let the shipwrights earn their wages.

03_arteon_generic_task_12_DESC.text: As our borders expand, the heartland must not be left vulnerable. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y] shall be ringed with walls, stocked with garrisons, and backed by the full administrative apparatus of a realm prepared to weather any storm. Our enemies should look upon this capital and understand that taking it is not a plan — it is a fantasy.

03_arteon_generic_task_13_DESC.text: The #R Isle of Eternal War#! does not yield peace easily — it must be built, stone by stone, ship by ship, law by law. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y] stands at the edge of becoming the greatest city on the island — a true imperial capital, recognized far beyond these shores as the seat of a power that has outlasted every rival. What remains is the final act: turning military dominance into lasting governance.

03_arteon_generic_task_14_DESC.text: #Y Arteon#! is finally united under one glorious sovereign. The Crown of #Y Arteon#! is ours by right — earned in blood, in diplomacy, in faith, and in the long endurance of those who refused to yield when lesser rulers would have broken. The #R Isle of Eternal War#! has a new name today. Let all the world learn it.

03_arteon_generic_BUTTON_DETAILS.text: Secure our homeland, overcome Arteon's rival powers, and unite the island.

03_arteon_generic_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: Begin the struggle to unite Arteon.

03_azar_DESCRIPTION.text:
Hundreds of years ago, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] ruled over an expansive kingdom that ran along the impassable mountains to the north. From the grand city of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], home of the famed #T Great Ziggurat#!, #T Etemenazari#!, that was the center of their way of life, they challenged the might of the northerners while keeping the steppe riders at bay.

But one day, in what has become known as #Y The Betrayal at Ruzel#!, a traitorous vassal allowed the armies of the #T Zani Empire#! to travel through their lands without offering any warning to the #Y Azari#!, who were caught unawares and suffered a calamitous defeat. After a siege that lasted nearly ten years, the exhausted #Y Azari#! defenders could resist no longer and the #Y Zani#! destroyed their city and the Ziggurat, tearing it down to its foundation and enslaving the #T Golden Dwarves#!.

In the following decades, the #Y Zani#! Imperial Armies abandoned this region as their generals fought amongst each other, and the #T Golden Dwarves#! secretly repaired the walls of #G Tiuban#!. After the #Y Great Collapse#!, the #Y Azari#! survived and soldiered on, slowly rebuilding their broken civilization and gathering their strength.

03_azar_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has conquered the neighboring countries that once paid tribute to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], rebuilt the #T Great Ziggurat#!, #T Etemenazari#!, and reformed the #T Mâkdid Sho-Tan Azarî#! - the #T Golden Kingdom#!.

03_azar_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: We shall avenge the ghosts of our ancestors

03_azar_task_1_DESC.text: Long ago, the cruel armies of the #Y Zani Empire#! laid siege to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] and destroyed the #T Great Ziggurat#!, #Y Etemenazari#!, that was the center of our civilization.\n\nAlthough hundreds of years have passed since this fateful moment, no #Y Azari#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has had the resources to rebuild the Ziggurat - until now.

03_azar_task_2_DESC.text: Now that the gleaming #T Great Ziggurat of Tiuban#! towers above the city skyline once again, we must turn our attention to the rest of our ancestor's legacy. The canals that they built throughout the capital are impressive, but we should do what we can to expand them.

03_azar_task_3_DESC.text: Every morning at dawn, our ancestors would greet the Solar Disc with sacrifices that ensured their protection for the inhabitants of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] and the people of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] in general. Our work is not complete until we have restored the ancient manner of worship!

03_azar_task_4_DESC.text: Now that #T Etemenazari#! has been restored and the daily rituals performed by the #G War Priests#! have resumed in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], all have praised [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] as the #Y 'Viceroy of Summsîr'#!, an ancient #Y Azari#! honorific.

03_azar_task_5_DESC.text: Years ago, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] was the heart of an Empire that dominated the #Y Iron Foothills#!, but when the #T Zani Empire#! invaded from the north without warning, our perfidious kinsmen in [GetCountry('LRS').GetName|T] betrayed us and allowed their armies safe passage for the price of their freedom from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T]. The time has come to bring these breakaway cities to heel.

03_azar_task_6_DESC.text: With the rebellious western cities returned to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], we must contend with a powerful #Y Dunydurceg#! nation that has taken over many of the southern regions that we once ruled - the [GetCountry('KAF').GetName|T].\n\nYet there are many #T Dwarves#! that would answer the call for battle, especially if it meant avenging our ancestors. The #Y Bal-beni#! warriors on the other side of the mountains would send their sons to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] if there was a chance to burn [GetCountry('KAF').GetCapital.GetName|G]!

03_azar_task_7_DESC.text: Traveling merchants tell us of trouble in the lands to our east; it appears that the cities of [GetProvince('(int32)4438').GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)4446').GetName|G] are preparing to rebel against their overlord. In order to prevent chaos from spilling into our territories, we must bring peace to the region by conquering it.

03_azar_task_8_DESC.text: At long last, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has gathered all of the #T Golden Dwarves#! that live south of the mountains under the banner of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T]. In order to celebrate this unprecedented accomplishment, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has declared that there will be a celebration held at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] in one month.

03_azar_task_9_DESC.text: Now that the former holdings of [GetCountry('URU').GetName|T] are garrisoned by #Y Azari#! soldiers, we turn our attention even further westward, to the province of #G Shizar#! where the #T Golden Dwarves#! petty kingdoms for decades. The time has come to bring them into our fold; we must seize #G Shizar#! for the glory of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G]!

03_azar_task_10_DESC.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has commanded that a magical legion be built, one that will safeguard the borders of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] and keep our many foes at bay. The pious [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has implored the great #Y Ava#! to be with our warriors as they fight the battles in the days to come.

03_azar_task_10_tt.text: We need the #T Da-Ash Hêbriq Deity#! #G Ava#! in our Pantheon.

03_azar_task_11_DESC.text: The dream of reforming #T The Golden Empire#!, the #Y Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari#!, the lands claimed by our ancestors, is closer than it has ever been before, all thanks to the leadership of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]. May the gods of battle be with our men as they march towards glory!

03_azar_task_12_DESC.text: If we want our warriors to contend against the enemies arrayed against us, then we must ensure that they are equipped in the finest weapons and armor available in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T]. Send the serfs to the iron @iron! mines of [GetProvince('(int32)4289').GetName|G], for our blacksmiths have need of ore.

03_azar_task_13_DESC.text: There are rare spices that are grown within the city of [GetProvince('(int32)4558').GetName|G], and our people crave the taste of the spicy pepper that can only be found within its mills. Let us invest in the region in order to increase production!

03_azar_task_14_DESC.text: In a sign of ostentatious wealth, a testament to the growing power of might of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T],[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has commanded that a magnificent forum be built in the heart of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], one that shall be beautified with statues of the finest #Y Azari#! marble and decorated with pure gold.

03_azar_task_15_DESC.text: The resurgent [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] people are protected from their enemies by the dread #T Da Ash-Hêbriq Knights of#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] - a legion of highly trained warriors that utilize magic on the battlefield to deadly effect.

03_azar_task_15_tt.text: Have a legion in the capital region that has at least #Y 12#! units.

me_azar_1_desc.text:
Although the #T Hebric#! Priests prophesied of a day when the #T Great Ziggurat#! #T Etemenazari#! would be restored to the skyline of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], over the many centuries, the people began to lose hope that they would ever see their majestic temple restored.

But [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has heard the cries of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] brethren and has done what no dwarf thought possible; the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] commanded that the ziggurat be built again, no matter the cost to the nation.

All throughout #T Azar#!, the finest engineers and architects gathered themselves and their apprentices for a task that they viewed as a sacred obligation. When they finally completed this holy work, their faces were streaked with tears and prayers were upon their lips as they stood in the shadows of the grand structure towering above them.

me_azar_1.a.text: I promise to lead Azar to even great glories...

me_azar_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_2_desc.text: Although the expenditures required were massive, an army of serf laborers have spent the last few months cleaning out and expanding the vast canal system that connects [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] to the northern mountains - one of the largest construction efforts attempted by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] #T Dwarves#! in decades.\n\nFinally, their efforts are completed, and the benefits to the capital are already making themselves manifest. Our economy in particular is growing, for as word spreads far and wide of our architectural initiatives, more and more merchants are making the trek across the badlands of the #Y Iron Foothills#! to visit the rejuvenated #G Tiuban#! for themselves.

me_azar_2.a.text: Slowly but surely, we are restoring the legacy our ancestors left

me_azar_2_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_3_desc.text: At the top of the #T Great Ziggurat of Tiuban#!, the sweet smell of incense circles around the giant cult statue of the demi-god #Y Summsîr#! as the sound of chanting and prayer fills the air with a low rumble.\n\nFor almost five hundred years, the proper rites of #Y Summsîr#! have not been observed within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], but thanks to the efforts of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] to restore the nation, proper #Y Azari#! worship is finally happening in our most sacred temple.

me_azar_3.a.text: May Summsîr bless Tiuban and grant us victory over all!

me_azar_3_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_4_desc.text:
A gathering of #T Hebric#! #T Hierophants#! has convened within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] in order to bestow upon [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] two honors; a title and a treasure.

Some of the priests in attendance have traveled from as far away as [GetProvince('(int32)3940').GetName|G] to witness the occasion, and stories of the fame and renown of the valiant [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] have made it all the way to the #Y Skyreach Passages#!. Word travels quickly amongst the scattered #Y Dwarven#! communities, and it is said that the deeds of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] are even hailed in #G Morrigon#! to the west.

To commemorate the efforts of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] to restore the #T Great Ziggurat#!, the #T Hierophants#! have brought a sacred #Y rhyton#! to the #Y Azari#! capital. This priceless artifact will be used every day to pour libations upon the Altar within the Ziggurat. And who better to lead the service than the #Y Viceroy of Summsîr#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim]self - we are blessed to have such a holy leader.

me_azar_4.a.text: I shall lead the worship of Summsîr with this sacred horn

me_azar_4_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_4$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_5_desc.text: One of the most shameful episodes in Golden #Y Dwarf#! history is known as #Y The Betrayal at Ruzel#!. The cowardly citizens of [GetProvince('(int32)4293').GetName|G] allowed an invading #Y Zani#! #G Army#! to pass through their lands, with the governor of the traitorous city, Kidin-Rihat of the [GetCountry('LRS').GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective] dynasty, betraying our ancestors for crown of a king. Even now, their descendants rule over what is rightful #Y Azari#! clay; [GetCountry('LRS').GetRuler.GetName|Y] has long been a thorn in the side of our people.\n\nBy abandoning their oaths of brotherhood, [GetCountry('LRS').GetName|T] became an independent nation and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] was doomed to fall to the #Y Zani#! forces - a crime that must be avenged. Vowing to bring the breakaway western cities back into the #Y Azari#! fold, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has commanded that we begin preparing for war.

me_azar_5.a.text: I have not forgotten the Betrayal at Ruzel! Larsa shall suffer

me_azar_5_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_5$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_6_desc.text:
Word of the victories won by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] have made [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] the most famous [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] in all of the #Y Iron Foothills#!. The crafty [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has sought to capitalize on this state of affairs by sending riders to #Y Dwarven#! communities far and wide, calling for landless warriors to travel to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] to join our armies. Promising gold and glory to all who fight for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has told our generals to prepare for an assault on the [GetCountry('KAF').GetName|T], a powerful #Y Dunydurceg#! nation that has established itself on old #Y Azari#! lands.

While some doubted that this would be an effective way to recruit soldiers, the gathering mass of levies outside of the gates of #G Tiuban#! have proven [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] to be correct once again.

The promise of the plunder to be taken is too good, and thousands of men are ready to risk their lives for the prizes up for grabs. Even some #Y Bel-bani Raiders#!, fierce bandits from the northern deserts, have thrown in their lot with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], traveling all of the way from #G Usire Baetep#! and crossing mountains to reach the capital.

me_azar_6.a.text: We ride for the border with the [GetCountry('KAF').GetName]!

me_azar_6_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_7_desc.text: The Fall of the [GetCountry('KAF').GetName|T] eliminated one of the largest regional threats for the armies of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], but there were many foes willing to step into the void created by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y].\n\nWhen [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] first heard murmurings from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] #Y Kaffarian#! informants that there were troubles within the lands of [GetCountry('URU').GetName|T], the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] wasted no time in preparing claims.
