It appears that the leaders within the two Gezaran cities of [GetProvince('(int32)4438').GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)4446').GetName|G] have been preparing to launch a rebellion, but [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] does not want to see their plan come to fruition - if anyone is going to take over the region, then it will be [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim], not some mob of discontented city-dwellers.

me_azar_7.a.text: The Azar must restore peace to the eastern territories

me_azar_7_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_7$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_8_desc.text:
One of the greatest exhibitions ever observed within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] was undoubtedly the triumph decreed by the mighty [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y].

All of the royal families within the kingdom traveled to the #Y Azari#! capital in order to witness the parade of foreign captives and spoils of war being carried before the statue of #Y Summsîr#!. There, seated on a throne before all, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] observed the procession with visible excitement on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] face.

The common people of #G Tiuban#!, who were allowed to leave their shops and home to come see the spectacle, were nearly stricken dumb in amazement, for none had ever seen such wealth gathered in one place. And when it came time to cheer for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], the sound of their voices practically shook the city.

me_azar_8.a.text: All bow before [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName], a Divine King!

me_azar_8_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_8$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_9_desc.text: As the dominion of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] spreads farther east, encompassing large swathes of #G Eastern Karksm#!, many have wondered if the bloodlust of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] will ever be sated.\n\nSuch questions have been pondered within the city of [GetCountry('YMH').GetCapital.GetName|G], for [GetCountry('YMH').GetRuler.GetName|Y] of [GetCountry('YMH').GetName|T] has correctly assessed that the resurgent #T Golden Dwarves#! will attempt to absorb all their scattered kinsmen. Realizing that there is no delaying the inevitable, [GetCountry('YMH').GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has decreed that [GetCountry('YMH').GetRuler.GetHerHis] armies prepare for battle.

me_azar_9.a.text: You will not take our homes without a fight, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]!

me_azar_9_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_9$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_10_desc.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] was present within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] when the first cohort of the #Y Swords of Ava#! finished training within the city, and watched in awe as the Golden #Y Dwarven#! #Y Heavy Infantry#! dashed across the training camp in a blur of motion, their iron boots glowing with a purple light. They ran up into the mountains with an unnatural speed that belied their size, causing [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] to let out a low whistle - these men would be unstoppable.\n\nThese highly-skilled warriors have been taught certain magical techniques that will augment their speed and fighting capabilities by the mages living in #G Tiuban#!, and it will not be long before they are fighting alongside the regular levies of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T]. Word is already spreading through the army about the magical reinforcements coming to shore up the battle lines, and our men are thrilled to have such powerful Knights at their side.

me_azar_10.a.text: No one shall be able to stop the armies of Azar now!

me_azar_10_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_11_desc.text:
No one could have imagined that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] would accomplish as much as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] has in the last few years, and yet our country is barely recognizable to what it once was.

Not only have our external borders grown, but the great city of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] thrives like it once did hundreds of years ago. We have truly transformed #G Tiuban#! into something worth celebrating - it has become larger and richer than ever before, practically doubling in size over the last few years.

And so, when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] proposed to the #Y Council#! at #G Tiuban#! that we declare ourselves to be the #Y Makdid Sho-Tan Azari#!, the heir to the glory of the vanished #Y Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari#!, no one disagreed with the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], but agreed that it was long overdue.

me_azar_11.a.text: All hail the proclamation of the #E Mâkdid Sho-Tan Azarî#!!

me_azar_11_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_11$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_12_desc.text: Travelers to [GetProvince('(int32)4289').GetName|G] are quick to notice the small village on the outskirts of the mine, which is not a proper city quite yet but is bursting at the seams. Most people have certainly heard of the high-quality iron @iron! that is taken from the forests, but they are unaware of the growing settlement and are surprised to see a vibrant town in the depths of a dreary forest.\n\nThe local highway, built between #G Rinekkud#! and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] in order to transport ore to the mills, has brought people to the capital, as well - it seems some of the provincials have moved to #G Tiuban#!.

me_azar_12.a.text: We are pleased to hear this - all dwarves are welcome

me_azar_12_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_12$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_13_desc.text: Most foreigners struggle with pronouncing [GetProvince('(int32)4558').GetName|G], but everyone is acquainted with the exquisitive #Y Kaffarian Peppercorn#!, a mouth-watering spice @spices! that is only found in this bustling city. Few have tasted this delicacy, however, for a small satchel of the pungent peppercorns will cost a working man a month of his labor.\n\nEven despite the efforts of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] to build mills and marketplaces throughout [GetProvince('(int32)4558').GetName|G], the spice remains tantalizingly out of reach to all but the wealthiest within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T].

me_azar_13.a.text: Be careful that you do not eat too much - the heat creeps up on you

me_azar_13_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_13$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_14_desc.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has spent a princely sum in order to build the luxurious forum that the citizens are already calling the #Y 'Aureate'#! - a name that hardly does justice to the jaw-dropping extravagance that the House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective] has demonstrated within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].\n\nThe streets of the #G Forum#! are paved with pure gold, and the building facades are all constructed of marble taken from [GetProvince('(int32)4366').GetName|G] - some folks believe themselves to be dreaming when they enter the Aureate #G Forum#!, for how could any place on #G Omniluxia#! be so beautiful?

me_azar_14.a.text: The people of Azar deserve to enjoy their wealth!

me_azar_14_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_14$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_15_desc.text: With the recent discovery of soulgems in the mountains of [GetProvince('(int32)4299').GetName|G], it did not take long before our mages found a way to incorporate them into our military. Our elite units, especially the #Y Swords of Ava#!, were given cuirasses with soulgems sewn into the leather and taught commands that would unleash their magic.\n\nWithin weeks, our warriors mastered their new equipment, and the power of our #Y Da Ash-Hêbriq Knights of Azar#! will shatter any force that encounters them - they are truly the deadlist army in all of #G Luxterra#!.

me_azar_15.a.text: Our magical knights shall be unstoppable!

me_azar_15_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar_task_15$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_16_desc.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], the time has come for our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] forces to assemble for battle. Our claims have been prepared and all you have to do is say the word, o [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], and the hour of war will be at hand! The rebellious provinces of #Y Karksm#! must be brought to heel.

me_azar_16_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_17_desc.text:
As the triumphant [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] armies return to the garrisons of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], their bags weighed down with plunder from the rich coasts, the activity of the soldiers is matched in intensity by the ongoing discussions taking place within #T Etemenazari#!.

[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has been presented with a difficult decision, one that concerns that inhabitants of the recently conquered terirtories. #Y Karksmi#! barbarians have been squatting on our lands for centuries, and they have foolishly come to see the deserts and plains of the southern badlands as their home.

The question presented before the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] concerns their future. Some voices within the capital are calling for peaceful overtures, arguing that extending citizenship rights to the subjugated would do wonders for ensuring harmony within our borders. This opinion is in the minority, however, as most #T Golden Dwarves#! would love to see the #Y Karksmi#! clapped in fetters and sent to serf estates.

me_azar_17.a.text: We shall grant them the rights as citizens of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]

me_azar_17.b.text: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] always has need of more serfs

me_azar_17.c.text: Seize their wealth - they will be our slaves!

me_azar_17_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_18_desc.text:
Those closest to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] will be the first to say that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] is a complex individual that is guided by mysterious motives, and although the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] remains an enigma, there is one fact that is undisputed by all; [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] loathes the #Y Zainudian Faith#! with a passion that is all-consuming.

Although [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] would never admit this to anyone, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] personally believes that the #T Da Ash-Hêbriq#! gods abandoned our forebears long ago when our ancestors failed to keep the #T Zainudian#! Heresy from sweeping through the south - for what else could explain #Y The Betrayal at Ruzel#! or the ancient destruction of #T Etemenazari#! besides the gods turning their backs on the #Y Azari#!?

It came as no surprise, then, when the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] launched an Omostthanat against the filthy #Y Zainudians#! and their heresies. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] ordered that every #T Zainudian#! holy site within the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] be utterly destroyed - the only religion that will be tolerated within our borders shall be #T Da Ash-Hêbriq#!.

In order to ensure that the proper religious rites are observed by the people living in the far east, a massive temple has been constructed in the city of [GetProvince('(int32)4358').GetName|G] in order to serve the faithful.

me_azar_18.a.text: I cannot change the sins of the past, but I will avenge them...

me_azar_18_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_19_desc.text: Bolstered by the efforts of the conquered #Y Karksmi#!, who have served faithfully as laborers in our fields and have trained alongside our soldiers as auxiliaries, a legion comprised of our crack camel @camels! units has proudly been formed - one that incorporates the best warriors from all classes of society.\n\nThe #Y Karksmi#! tribesmen have taught our warriors their traditional methods of fighting from camelback, and even though some of our soldiers were hesitant to climb the towering beasts - for indeed, our kinsmen are short and falling to the ground in a full suit of armor is very painful - they have overcome their fears and have literally risen to the occasion. Now, our mounted units shall dominate the sandy wastelands!

me_azar_19.a.text: The harsh terrain of the desert shall be no impediment to my armies!

me_azar_19_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_4$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_20_desc.text: Our claims for the #T Golden Foothills#!, once a prosperous region of our Empire, have been prepared, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]. #G The Golden Foothills#! were once the farthest extent of the #Y Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari#!; our ancestors conquered the rich farmlands and rolling hills surrounding the lush #Y Bay of Kyaxares#! and built walled cities along its coasts.\n\nAs our strength waned in the days of darkness, we were forced to abandon these holdings and #Y Zaraken#! raiders from the eastern steppes seized our former possessions. Although they will fight fiercely to retain their pilfered cities, we must dispel them and take back what is rightfully ours.

me_azar_20.a.text: We are not afraid of the steppe riders - to battle!

me_azar_20_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_5$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_21_desc.text: At long last, the #T Golden Foothills#! have been retaken for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] and our forces occupy the garrisons of the wealthy cities surrounding the #Y Bay of Kyaxares#!. To their credit, the #Y Zarakens#! that held these towns were faithful stewards of their possessions, and over the centuries, they have expanded the local infrastructure in a way that came as a surprise to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y].\n\nMuch to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] chagrin, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] was forced to admit that the #Y Zarakens#! living along the Bay were no mere savages, and in some ways their knowledge and wealth rivals our own. They have taken advantage of their rich farmlands and natural harbors, and the tax revenues they collect from foreign merchants and traders have filled their cities with grand edifices of marble. The local elites have sent embassies to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] begging for their privileges to be maintained, promising that they will happily give us whatever we desire, but a dark impulse has crossed [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y]'s mind a couple of times...

me_azar_21.a.text: Let us study their military tactics

me_azar_21.b.text: Speak to their magistrates and take what civil lessons we can

me_azar_21.c.text: Send their best orators to Tiuban

me_azar_21.d.text: What could we learn from them regarding the gods?

me_azar_21.e.text: Sack the cities! Seize their gold and steal their innovations

me_azar_21_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_22_desc.text:
'[SCOPE.sCharacter('karksmi_camel_nomad').GetFirstName|Y], your reputation precedes you. Some claim that you have the soul of a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] - is what they say true, '#Y Dwarf#!'?'

Standing before the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] is a mighty Drakhan warrior named [SCOPE.sCharacter('karksmi_camel_nomad').GetName|Y], who has made his name by fighting in the camel @camels! legion that has dominated the wastelands. Hailed as the fiercest camel commander within our kingdom, Balkar has unsheathed his sword countless times against the enemies of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], and has even abandoned his traditional gods to worship the #T Da Ash-Hêbriq#! #G Pantheon#! - has there even been a soldier that has embraced the ways of the #T Golden Dwarves#! in such a manner? What circumstances could lead a man to abandon his faith and family in order to fight against his own people? Truly, Balkar's motivations remain mysterious, but his record is beyond reproach - he has proven himself time and time again on the battlefield.

Bowing deeply before [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], [SCOPE.sCharacter('karksmi_camel_nomad').GetFirstName|Y] presses his face to the floor before rising to his feet. 'I swear to you, Lord [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], that I shall not falter until the #Y Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari#! has been restored.'

me_azar_22.a.text: You shall serve me well, Balkar - of this, I am certain

me_azar_22_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_7$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_23_desc.text:
All throughout the settlements and villages of the #Y Karksmi#!, the local Elders have been sending their sons to work on the vast camel @camels! estates constructed throughout the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] - what a change of affairs for these proud tribesmen, who once raided our lands from the backs of their desert mounts every spring!

While some of their hotheaded youth resent being sent to labor for their #Y Azari#! overlords, asking instead at the Tribal Councils for permission to wage rebellion, they are harshly reprimanded by their local Elders, who will tolerate no talk of dissension after the failures of their disastrous campaigns against us.

'Our swords have been broken by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective], and what you ask for will only bring us death. Will you see your mothers and daughters slaving in the fields alongside you? Go and learn from the #T Dwarves#! - they are our brethren now! Share our knowledge and prove our worthiness to them. This is an opportunity for our people, and you must understand this.'

me_azar_23.a.text: Their Tribal Elders are wise...their foolish youth better be listening

me_azar_23_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_8$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_24_desc.text:
For many years, the cities of the #Y Iron Foothills#!, chief among them [GetProvince('(int32)4542').GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)4558').GetName|G], have been relatively isolated, no doubt due to the treacherous mountains that precipitously rise just outside of the walls of #G Akge#!. Although it can be argued that these natural defenses have allowed the cities to grow and thrive, they remain culturally isolated from the rest of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T].

After carefully considering the requests of local merchants, who have vociferously complained about the time required to traverse the badlands, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has decreed that good #Y Dwarven#! roads be built throughout the region.

Now, this so-called #Y Iron Highway#! has connected the two cities with the existing road networks of #G Western Karksm#!, and trade and travel for all in the region have become much easier endeavors. In a happy coincidence, our architects have grown confident with the subtle techniques needed for road-building; lessons that they can apply throughout our realm.

me_azar_24.a.text: Our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] engineers are the best in Luxterra!

me_azar_24_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_9$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_25_desc.text: First-time visitors to [GetProvince('(int32)4810').GetName|G] are often advised to cover their noses with a cloth once they pass through the #Y Saffron Gate#! that leads into the main markets. It is quite common to start sneezing uncontrollably once you enter the squares and bazaars of the bustling town, which is famous for the quality and potency of its locally-produced spices.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has seen the potential of this city to be much more than it currently is, however, and has chosen #G Pagxe#! to be the location of an #Y Azari#! #Y Military Harbor#!. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] believes that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] needs a presence in the #G Eteradica Sea#!, and #G Pagxe#! is one of the best candidates in the region; it is well-connected by roads, has good farmland and a booming economy, and the locals seem eager to receive the fleets of the #T Golden Dwarves#!.

me_azar_25.a.text: May the gods see fit to bless our initiative with success beyond reckoning

me_azar_25_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_26_desc.text: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] efforts to build up their presence within the #G Eteradica Sea#! have not been in vain. Many landless sons have heard the call of opportunity and left their childhood villages forever, heading for [GetProvince('(int32)4810').GetName|G] in hopes of finding work as a deckhand in the #Y Royal Navy#!. The terms of the standard enlistment contract are known to everyone; twenty years in service to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] will give you lands of your own and a title one day; an offer that many have found to be irresistible.\n\nIn order to capitalize on the success of their recruitment drive, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has decreed that an #Y Aureate Armada#! be built, a fleet that is destined to control the oceans that surround our dominions.

me_azar_26.a.text: Sail forth and destroy any that dare to challenge us upon the sea!

me_azar_26_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_11$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_27_desc.text:
Over the last few years, [GetProvince('(int32)4810').GetName|G] has become the most important city located in #G Western Karksm#! for a variety of reasons, although few could have predicted its rapid ascent. The merchants inhabiting the #Y Grand Guildhouse#! can affect prices in markets halfway across the world, so great is their clout and control of foreign trade, and their ability to do so is bolstered by the #Y Royal Navy#! of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] that protects their interests.

The #Y Military Harbor#! has become so important to the country that commissioning a #Y Naval Academy#! became a necessity; the fleets of the #T Golden Dwarves#! require skilled sailors and a professional class of officers to lead them.

One of the first students to graduate from the #Y Academy#! was none other than [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], who wanted to personally ensure that the highest standards are enforced in our places of learning.

me_azar_27.a.text: I have mastered both land and sea for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]

me_azar_27_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_12$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_28_desc.text:
When the ancient #Y Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari#! fell, the center of gravity that held western #G Luxterra#! collapsed practically overnight, ushering forth a period of darkness and misery that brought nothing but death.

Yet no one could have foreseen what would happen next, especially the treacherous #T Zani Empire#! that had caused this calamity in the first place; the aftermath of their invasions resulted in ruinous civil wars that would ultimately culminate in the #Y Great Collapse#! that nearly destroyed the world. Years of weakness and chaos gripped #G Luxterra#!, and the #Y Dragkhanic Invasions#! soon followed in the years to come. #T Mercenaries#! from the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T] crossed the #G Intergealian Sea#! and swept through our former dominions, aiding the [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|T] when they took our former city of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G] as their capital.

But this is about to change.

me_azar_28.a.text: I will drive the Dragkhans out of Luxterra once and for all...

me_azar_28_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_13$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_29_desc.text:
It is said that when the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] armies entered the walls of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G], so immense was the panic in the Royal Household that the nobility left behind most of their wealth and fled with what they could carry - even the #G Qhagan#! shamefully abandoned the Royal Palace. The elderly and infirm were left behind by those desperate to save their lives, and as the soldiers of the [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|T] abandoned their posts, the houses of the local elites were raided by mobs and set to the torch. Private bodyguards began to murder those that they were entrusted to protect, with many absconding towards the harbor with handfuls of silver purloined from pockets and weighed down with gold jewelry taken from the corpses of their former masters. The slaughter was random, bloody and horrific - many living within the #Y Jarenam#! capital truly believed that the end of days was upon them.

[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] took a sadistic pleasure in hearing these tales of misery, and when the Ceremonial Robes of the #Y Jarenam#! #G Qhagan#! were brought before [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] laughter split the halls at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].

'Here, then, is proof that the #Y Dragkhans#! are cowards - their #G Qhagan#! ran from the palace bare-assed instead of staying to fight for his empire.'

me_azar_29.a.text: Tell our men to spare no one! Avenge our ancestors!

me_azar_29_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_14$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_30_desc.text: It is known throughout the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] that the #T Dragkhanic#! hordes are fond of enslaving the innocent, and even the sight of the banner of the [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|T] has been known to strike terror into the hearts of people. Countless souls have been clapped in fetters and sent to the prisons of the #T Dragkhanic#! Empires, yet one in particular, the Slave #G Market#! of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G], stands above all others in its cruelty; tens of thousands of thralls are imprisoned within its cells, living in appalling conditions with no hope of freedom.\n\nHaving heard of this evil place, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has desired to see if what they say about its wickedness is true, but [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] spies have advised against this course of action; the city is filled with rebellious Drakhan citizens and there are fears that the life of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] would be in danger.

me_azar_30.a.text: I am unconcerned by these reports - let us leave at once

me_azar_30.b.text: On second thought, I don't have time for this.

me_azar_30_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_15$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_31_desc.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has long argued that taking the many cities of the #G Central Bhaxnmrechtem#! region is worth any difficulties that we might encounter along the way, for it is well known that the #Y Esquelian#! tribes that cower behind their city walls are hoarders of gold.\n\nAs usual, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has been proven right, and the frightened citizens of the conquered cities were able to send the exorbitant tributes demanded by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] as a one-time special tax. In return for this gift that was 'willingly' given by a relieved populace, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] promised to keep bandits off of the roads and barbarians away from the countryside - an agreement that the #Y Esquelians#! could not refuse.

me_azar_31.a.text: Pray that I do not change my mind and ask for more...

me_azar_31_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_16$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_32_desc.text: Preparations have begun within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] for the inevitable restoration of the #Y Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari#!, for at this point, it is a foregone conclusion - only a few more territories need to be taken before the eternal borders of our glorious predecessors have been restored.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has led our people to the threshold of a new #Y Golden Era#!, one in which the #Y Azari#! are ascendant - truly, the House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective] are the greatest rulers in the history of our people and their deeds shall be proclaimed until the very end of time.

me_azar_32.a.text: I am destined to become the first Golden Dwarf Emperor...

me_azar_32_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_17$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_33_desc.text: Word has reached [GetProvince('(int32)4262').GetName|G] of the good news in [GetProvince('(int32)4810').GetName|G]; after many months of building, the #Y Grand Guildhouse#! as been built within the #T Military#! Harbor. This majestic building, which was designed and realized by the finest #Y Dwarven#! architects living within the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], shall serve as the headquarters for the various merchant families that have brought unimagined wealth to #G Western Karksm#!.\n\nOur control of the #Y Luxterran#! spice @spices! trade has seen #G Tiuban#! receive its own #Y Spice Market#!, the latest district added to the celebrated city of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective]. Even our sworn enemies swallow their pride when it comes to procuring seasonings from our traders, and our merchant fleet must sail all across #G Omniluxia#! in order to sell their wares to those that desire them. The efforts of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] have once again brought glory and gold to the people!

me_azar_33.a.text: It is my privilege and pleasure to serve the Golden Dwarves in this way

me_azar_33_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_20$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_34_desc.text: Celebrations unlike any ever seen in #G Omniluxia#! are taking place within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], for the proclamation of the #Y Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari#!, the #T Golden Empire#! of the #T Golden Dwarves#!, has been made. Against all odds, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] rose from near obscurity and re-established themselves as the predominant power in #G Luxterra#!.\n\nIn this hour of ultimate triumph, the victorious [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] seems restless - something is clearly on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] mind.

me_azar_34.a.text: Honor demands that I destroy the city of Zani the Great - revenge is mine!

me_azar_34_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_azar2_task_18$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_35_desc.text:
By the time that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] entourage reached the walls of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G], it was well into the second watch - there had been unexpected difficulties on the road, and the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] arrived far later than [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] had originally intended to.

The city's streets were not empty at this late hour, however; hundreds of dispossessed citizens, their livelihoods and homes destroyed by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] armies that had taken the former #Y Jarenam#! capital, were lingering in the streets and plazas.

The siege of the former #Y Jarenam#! capital has caused a famine in the region, and despite #Y Dwarven#! efforts to import grain, prices for bread remain very high and many people are beginning to starve. #Y Azari#! soldiers stationed throughout the main squares are somehow managing to keep the peace, but an ominous tension has gripped the city.

me_azar_35.a.text: Press through the mob and head towards the citadel

me_azar_35.b.text: Return for the safety of Tiuban at once!

me_azar_35_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y The Storm About To Break#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_36_desc.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s entourage pressed back the #T Dragkhanic#! crowds and gave the order to disperse. Although the mob was loathe to listen to their demands, cudgels were produced by the #T Dwarves#! and brawls began to erupt in the narrow streets of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G]. The #Y Azari#! Knights fought bravely, slaughtering their attackers by the dozen, but were ultimately forced to take refuge in a nearby plaza. Pressed on all sides by the mob, the #T Dwarves#! forced open the door of an abandoned shop and scrambled inside.\n\nMoments later, a loud explosion shook the earth, causing the roof of the building to collapse, and dozens of heavily-armed rebels poured in from the ceiling. Turning around to face the charge, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] was knocked down to the ground by a crackling bolt of energy - these attackers have mages with them! Someone loudly screamed 'Death to the #T Azar#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]!' and everything became chaos all at once.

me_azar_36_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y Knives In The Alleyway#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_37_desc.text:
The ensuing battle between [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] and the magical assassins sent against [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] caused a large fire to rage, and, whipped up by winds from the #G Intergealian Sea#!, soon spread throughout [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G].

[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] managed to survive the onslaught, but at the cost of one of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] eyes - all things considered, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] was lucky to survive with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] life, but as the flames grew out of control, the #T Dwarves#! were forced to abandon the city. Hours later, standing over a hillside that overlooks [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] watched the unfolding scene below and called for a cleric and strong wine.

'But what about the city, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]? If we do not intervene, countless souls will perish.'

Spitting on the ground, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] gave the order to return to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] - whatever happened to the city on the coast would not be seen by the furious [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle].

me_azar_37.a.text: Order our soldiers stationed here to assist in putting out the fire

me_azar_37.b.text: Damn them all - let the flames cleanse [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName] of its iniquity

me_azar_37_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y Dragkhanic Flames#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_38_desc.text:
This morning, some unwelcome guests arrived at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] with terrible news, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]. The armies of the [GetCountry('AKK').GetName|T] have waged war against our brethen across the sea, and after many vicious campaigns in which our #T Dragkhanic#! kinsmen were defeated, the #T Golden Dwarves#! have sacked the capital city of the [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|T], [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G], and seized it as their own. The ensuing slaughter that took place defies belief - we shall spare you the details - but know that the smoke of the burning city can be seen from #G Morrigon#!.

Yet all is not lost; many nobles from the #Y Jarenam#! Houses managed to escape, and hundreds of refugee ships have sailed across the #G Intergealian Sea#! for the safe harbors of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName|G] - but what a tragedy! The same #T Dragkhanic#! city that launched the invasion of #G Luxterra#! now sees its broken sons and daughters return empty-handed.

The leader of these displaced nobles is a man named [SCOPE.sCharacter('jarenam_magistrate_1').GetName|Y], a man with a bloodline connection to the ancient founders of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName|G], and he has made a bold request to you, my Lord. He asks that we grant him rights to rule over the city of #Y Zemmairthia#! in our name, vowing to serve the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] faithfully. [SCOPE.sCharacter('jarenam_magistrate_1').GetFirstName|Y] promises that he will be the one to reconquer [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G], but only if we can help him.

me_azar_38.a.text: In honor of your ancestors, [SCOPE.sCharacter('jarenam_magistrate_1').GetFirstName], I shall acquiesce

me_azar_38.b.text: Allow the displaced to settle at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName], but grant no favors

me_azar_38.c.text: Kill the refugees and seize their wealth

me_azar_38_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y The Fall of Zemmairthia Jarenam#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_38_tooltip_2.text: #Y We will release the#! #T Jarenam Ulus#! #Y as a #! #G Feudatory#!.

me_azar_39_desc.text:
Word from the city of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName|G], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] - [SCOPE.sCharacter('jarenam_magistrate_1').GetName|Y] has quickly taken over the administration of the city and is doing everything that he can to establish his seat of power. The locals still honor the [SCOPE.sCharacter('jarenam_magistrate_1').GetFamilyDisplayAdjective] name and welcomed their new overlord with open arms.

More refugees are continuing to arrive at the city, bringing tales of woe and devastation - the [GetCountry('AKK').GetName|T] are brutal tyrants and are oppressing our kinsmen with savage delight, enslaving hundreds and killing with a reckless regard for life.

These horror stories have only shorn up the resolve of [SCOPE.sCharacter('jarenam_magistrate_1').GetFirstName|Y] to one day liberate his kinsmen, but for now, he plots and waits.

me_azar_39.a.text: We shall do what we can to make them comfortable in their new home

me_azar_39.b.text: May the gods bring victory to the lost sons of Luxterra...

me_azar_39_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y The Jarenam Ulus#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_39_tooltip_2.text: #Y We will switch tags and play as the#! #T Jarenam Qhaganate#!.

me_azar_40_title.text: Blood of the Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari

me_azar_40_desc.text: A spirit of revelry has gripped the capital of the #T Golden Dwarves#!, who have set aside their usual dour mood in order to celebrate the events of the last few days. A grand ceremony was held within the halls of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] that honors the deeds and achievements of the incomparable [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]. The #T Hebric#! #G War Priests#! have taken omens and have announced that the blood of our ancestors flows freely within the veins of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], whose coming was foretold long ago.

me_azar_40.a.text: Let the world tremble before the Azari!

me_azar_40_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y Blood of the Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_41_desc.text: Our spies report that a #Y Jarenam#! nobleman from [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G] named [SCOPE.sCharacter('jarenam_magistrate_1').GetName|Y] has been granted authority over the city of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName|G] by the #Y Soventeir#! [GetCountry('SOV').GetRulerTitle] and has set up a #Y Jarenam#! court in exile. It seems that [SCOPE.sCharacter('jarenam_magistrate_1').GetFirstName|Y] has familial connections to the region and begged [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetName|Y] for sanctuary; something that was foolishly granted by the #Y Dragkhans#! across the water.\n\nSurrounding himself with refugees from the [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|T], [SCOPE.sCharacter('jarenam_magistrate_1').GetFirstName|Y] has vowed to liberate #G Zemmairthia Jarenam#! from our armies, but we have nothing to fear from this young pup...

me_azar_41_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y Rise Of The Jarenam Ulus#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_azar_41_tooltip_2.text: #Y We will switch tags and play as the#! #T Jarenam Qhaganate#!.

03_azar2_DESCRIPTION.text: The golden orb of the sun rises over the Northern #G Mountains#!, casting its illuminating glow over the #T Great Ziggurat of Tiuban#!, #Y Etemenazari#!. The #Y Dwarven#! Priests greet the fiery globe with sacrifices and prayers, asking for the protection of the gods as they light incense and spill the blood of animals onto the altars.\n\nSuch scenes were unimaginable a few generations ago. The faithful Kings of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], led by the immortal House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective], have restored the prestige and authority of the once-broken #T Golden Dwarves#!, and yet [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] will not be satisfied with half-measures - the #T Golden Empire#! of the #Y Azari#! #T Dwarves#!, the immortal #Y Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari#!, must be reinstituted.

03_azar2_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has reformed the #Y Mahdad Sho-Tan'Maat Ma'Azari#!, restoring the glorious days of old when the #Y Azari#! were supreme.

03_azar2_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: The Golden Empire will be reforged!

03_azar2_task_1_DESC.text: The #Y Mekian#! tribes that live within the regions of #G Western Karksm#! and #G Eastern Karksm#! are illegal occupants of lands that once belonged to the #Y Golden Empire#!. Now that we have found our strength again, thanks to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], the time has come to reclaim what is rightfully ours.

03_azar2_task_2_DESC.text: Now that we have conquered the tribesmen that live within #Y Karksm#!, we must decide what is to be done with these barbarians. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has been of two minds lately, not knowing whether or not to grant the newly-conquered rights or whether [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] should take them away.\n\n#Y We will make a decision regarding the status of the#! #G Karksmi#! #Y cultures#! #Y living within#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T].

03_azar2_task_3_DESC.text: The #Y Zainudian Heresies#! have spread like wildfire through the lands that once observed the proper #T Hebric#! rights - a testament to the studipity of the #Y Karksmi#! tribes, who were easily duped by the promises of false prophets.\n\nRealizing that the favor of the gods is paramount to the victories of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has demanded that our priests preach the true faith in our country.

03_azar2_task_4_DESC.text: The tribes that once inhabited the provinces of #Y Karksm#! are masters of riding camels @camel! into battle - a painful fact of life that our own [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] veterans are all too familiar with.\n\nBut now that we have broken the independent spirit of the locals and have built camel farms throughout our holdings, we should recruit warriors from the countryside to fight in our legions. These desert cavalries will protect their traditional homelands and our eastern possessions from the barbarian kingdoms.

03_azar2_task_4_tt.text: We must have a #T Legion#! with at least #Y 6#! #G Camel#! subunits.

03_azar2_task_5_DESC.text: Long ago, the power of our ancestor reached far past the #Y Karksmi#! badlands into the rolling plains and fertile farmlands of the [GetProvince('(int32)4739').GetArea.GetName|T] and [GetProvince('(int32)4619').GetArea.GetName|G] provinces. Although such actions will put us into conflict with the #Y Zarakens#!, we must take back the cities surrounding the #Y Bay of Kyaxares#!.

03_azar2_task_6_DESC.text: It has been suggested to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] that the people of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] could impose war indemnities upon the elites of the [GetProvince('(int32)4739').GetArea.GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)4619').GetArea.GetName|G] provinces. Our wars against the coastal cities were not insignificant, and we are entitled to do whatever we please with the regions that we have taken.\n\n#Y We will make a decision regarding the status of the cities in the#! #G Bay of Kyaxares#! #Y region#!.

03_azar2_task_7_DESC.text: After many battles fought in the deserts and badlands of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], our camel cavalry can no longer be called a volunteer unit, and they are no longer truly auxiliaries anymore - they are a professional fighting force and a vital component of our military strategies.

03_azar2_task_7_tt.text: #Y Have a#! #T Legion#! #Y in the capital region that has at least#! #G 10#! #T Camel @camel!#! #Y units and#! #G 2#! #Y Distinctions.#!

03_azar2_task_8.text: Golden Camels Of The Karksmi Desert

03_azar2_task_8_DESC.text: The locals living throughout the dried wastelands that comprise the #Y Karksmi Desert#! have mastered the ability to fight from the backs of camels - a skill that would be useful to obtain ourselves one day, especially considering the harsh terrain that we rule over.

03_azar2_task_9_DESC.text: It would be a wise thing for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] to connect its internal highways to the ancient roads that run along the coast of the #Y Eteradica Sea#!. The major cities of the south are deserving of such infrastructure - imagine what ease of travel would do for our merchants and armies!\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has long desired easy access to the sea from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], and this initiative will go a long way in making that dream come true.

03_azar2_task_10_DESC.text: [GetProvince('(int32)4810').GetName|G] is one of the most famous towns within all of [GetProvince('(int32)4810').GetArea.GetName|G], and the so-called '#Y City of Three Sneezes'#!, named because of the overwhelming aroma of the locally-produced spices @spices! that pervades its air, has been chosen as the place where the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] will construct its main military harbor.

03_azar2_task_11_DESC.text: If we hope to contend with the other major powers that have claims throughout #G Luxterra#!, then we cannot afford to ignore our presence at sea; if anything, we must dominate on the waters as well as the land.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has given the order to build a massive one fleet, one that is worthy of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T].

03_azar2_task_12_DESC.text: The importance of [GetProvince('(int32)4810').GetName|G] to our navy cannot be understated; not only is it one of our most capable port cities within all of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], but we also have a #Y Naval Academy#! within the harbor district that is famed for the rigor of its instruction.

03_azar2_task_13_DESC.text: As the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] continues to put together the pieces of its ancient empire, the time has come for the legions of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] to face their greatest enemies yet; the #T Dragkhanic#! invaders of the western #Y Luxterran#! coasts.

03_azar2_task_14_DESC.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has led the forces of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] to everlasting glory once more! The illegitimate [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|R] has been broken before us, and never again will they take back the coasts of [GetProvince('(int32)4617')GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|Y] from our #Y Azari#! brethren again.\n\nIn a devastating blow to the #T Dragkhanic#! pretenders and their ill-conceived dreams of empire, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has proudly reclaimed the great city of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G], the former capital of the [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|R], liberating it from the #T Dragkhanic#! forces and returning it to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T].

03_azar2_task_15_DESC.text:
The impressive [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G] was a worthy choice for Imperial capital - [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] cannot blame the rulers of the [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|R] for building their palaces within its walls - but the reputation of this fair city has been forever linked with the #T Dragkhanic#! #Y Slave Market#! that was built in the port district.

Now that #G Zemmairthia Jarenam#! is in the rightful hands of the #Y Azari#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has decided to pay a visit to the notorious district, in order to witness firsthand the crimes of the fearsome #T Dragkhanic#! raiders.

#Y This will start an event chain.#!

03_azar2_task_16_DESC.text: The region of #Y Central Bhaxnmrechtem#! is divided in half by difficult terrain, and while the [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|R] claimed everything between the mountains and the coast for themselves, the eastern forests and foothills were left to the settled #Y Esquelian#! tribes to squabble over.\n\nDespite its treacherous countryside, many cities have been built throughout #Y Bhaxnmrechtem#!, for the land is rich and fertile and able to sustain thousands of souls. Needless to say, there is much wealth for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] to take from the locals - such is the price of peace these days.

03_azar2_task_17_DESC.text: It is only a matter of time before we have taken all of the lands necessary to reform the #T Golden Empire#! - one by one, the last territories fall into our hands, and it appears that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] is destined to one day establish a new Dynasty.

03_azar2_task_18.text: The Golden Empire Of The Azari

03_azar2_task_18_DESC.text: Who is like [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] - a ruler and warrior that destroys and builds in equal measure, casting judgment upon the wicked and restoring the #Y Azari#! dwarves to their rightful positions as the rulers of the #T Golden Empire#!.\n\nAll hail [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] and may the gods protect the dwarves of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T]!

03_azar2_task_19_DESC.text: Recently, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has decreed that libraries devoted to the arcane arts should be built at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] desires any power that might protect the dwarves of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] from suffering the same miserable fate of their forefathers.\n\n#Y In one year's time, our#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle|T] #Y will gain a new magical trait#!.

03_azar2_task_20_DESC.text: We are in the envious position of controlling most of the spice-producing @spices! cities in all of #G Luxterra#!; if one desires the mouth-numbing #Y Kaffarian#! peppercorn or fragrant #Y Mekian#! saffron in their dishes, then they must deal with our merchants or else sail for the isles of the #Y Snakefolk#!.\n\nIn order to take advantage of this beneficial situation, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has wisely suggested that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] exert control over the spice trade by establishing Guildhouses to regulate its production.

03_azar2_task_21_DESC.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has long desired that the #T Skyreach Stone Altar#!, one of the most sacred #Y Dwarven#! relics, reside within [GetProvince('(int32)4262').GetName|Y]. Even though this seems like a distant dream, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has faith that the gods will somehow bring the altar to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] one day.

ob_order_mission.text: The Shield and the Iron Crown

ob_order_mission_DESCRIPTION.text:
For a century, the knights of the #T Order of Yvius Balthazar#! have carried the light of #T Hellas#! into the harsh north of #G Luxterra#!. Where the #R Drow#! once ruled, their founder raised his banner beside the tribes he had come to save, winning followers with his courage as readily as with his sermons. His brothers inherited a sacred duty: to stand between the northern peoples and the darkness beneath their feet.

But the quarrels of kings have found their way into the chapter houses. As the claimants of #G Herue#! tore their kingdom apart, knights who had sworn the same oath took up arms beneath opposing banners. Defeat followed division, and at #G Kiaguthmajnnorr#! in 996 LC, victory cost the Order both of its #Y Grandmasters#!.

Five years later, two new masters sit beneath the old banners. Beyond their walls, frightened villages await protection, the #T Iron Crown#! remains bitterly contested, and the caves have grown restless once more. The north has not forgotten #Y Balthazar#!. Whether his knights are still worthy of his name remains to be seen.

ob_order_mission_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when we have restored the strength of the #T Order#!, settled its leadership, and established a lasting watch over the north.

ob_order_mission_BUTTON_DETAILS.text: Restore the brotherhood of Balthazar and bring peace to the troubled north.

ob_order_mission_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: The knights of Balthazar must recover their purpose before the north is lost to the quarrels of kings and the darkness below.

03_cymeva_DESCRIPTION.text: Following the deaths of both #Y Calidriel#! and #Y Cymeva#!, the #Y High Elven#! kingdoms of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] and [GetCountry('ATH').GetName|T] coexisted in accordance with the #Y #G Great High Elven Peace#!#!.\n\nThe #Y Cymevans#! under [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetName|Y] have used the last two hundred years of peace to settle parts of #G Northern Eptelon#! as well as send out #Y #R Slaver Ships#!#! to raid the coasts of #Y Arteon#! and #G Eptelon#!. Focusing on rebuilding their economy, forming a professional standing army of elite soldiers, and accruing slaves to do the menial labor so that elven men may join the army, the #Y Cymevans#! are prepared to finally challenge [GetCharacter('(int32)22').GetName|Y] for control of #G Horteon#!!

03_cymeva_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has united the #Y High Elves#! of #G Horteon#!.

03_cymeva_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: We will unite the High Elves under our rule!

03_cymeva_task_1_DESC.text: Even after the #Y #R Great High Elven Civil War#!#! our people considered themselves culturally connected to those in the west. We were all #Y High Elves#! descended from the sons of #Y #R Atheus the Conqueror#!#!! However, centuries of division and isolation has created a unique identity in the more cosmopolitan elves that population the #Y Cymevan#! realm, and it is time to decide if this new culture truly defines who we are.

03_cymeva_task_2_DESC.text: Traditional elven warriors fight in half-plated steel armor, either accompanied with a longbow or with a #Y Trac#!, called a 'Glaive' by the #Y Horteonians#!. Under [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetName|Y] we have established a professional army, so now it is imperative that we select the best of the best to form an elite unite of warriors to serve as shock infantry for the battles to come: the #Y Vaur-Ac Warriors#!.

03_cymeva_task_3_DESC.text: The backbone of our society and our armies, the #Y Hua-roc#! are the various slave peoples who work our estates and serve as light infantry meant to wear down our enemies. Due to our lack of manpower, it might be a good idea to employ they slave-soldiers to assist our more disciplined #G Elven#! regiments.

03_cymeva_task_4_DESC.text: The #T High Elven Peace#! has lasted ever since the death of the two kings that started the #Y #R Great High Elven Civil War#!#!, however, it did not determine a decisive victor. With manpower from our colonies supporting our standing army, we can finally continue the #Y #R Great Elven Civil War#!#! and firmly declare ourselves the victors!

03_cymeva_task_5_DESC.text: With the #Y Atheusians#! defeated, we can finally claim complete control over the entire #Y High Elven Realm of Horteon#!, one of the greatest powers in the history of #G Omniluxia#!!

03_cymeva_task_6_DESC.text: While we are lucky enough to hold the most fertile areas of #G Horteon#!, our lack of men means that we do not have enough to work our vast fields, nor does our noble nature entice us to do such menial labor. By creating large slave estates worked by the #Y Hua-roc#! we can focus on more important and sophisticated crafts.

03_cymeva_task_7_DESC.text: The #Y Pearl of Horteon#!, [GetProvince('(int32)142').GetName|Y], is known across the #Y Herpolian#! and #Y Arteptolian#! seas for producing the finest pearls in #G Omniluxia#!. Local pearl divers and jewelers are some of the best in their craft, and should we help develop their city their exports would be unmatched!

03_cymeva_task_8_DESC.text: [GetProvince('(int32)345').GetName|Y], or the '#Y First City#!', is known as the first #Y High Elven#! city founded by #T Atheus the Conqueror#! himself! Despite the official capital of the empire moving to [GetProvince('(int32)142').GetName|Y], our city has remained an important religious and cultural center for our people.\n\nLet us rebuild the great #Y First City of Atheus#! into a cultural hub of the #Y High Elven#! people!

03_cymeva_task_9_DESC.text: After the end of the #T High Elven Civil War#! what was once the #Y Great Slaver Navy#! was split between the two #Y Elfrealms#! and underfunded. While we've made an effort to rebuild it, recent colonizations and skirmishes with the [GetCountry('ATH').GetName|T] have meant that our navy has taken a backseat to the development of our army.\n\nNow is the time to rebuild #T Atheus#!' great fleet, and look beyong the #G Herpolian Sea#!!

03_cymeva_task_10_DESC.text: Our #Y Eptelonian#! colonies have long chafed under our rule, believing themselves to know better than the rightful descendents of #T Atheus the Conqueror#!. Skirmishes with the [GetCountry('ATH').GetName|T] and the neglect of our navy has given the colonies relative autonomy, with the upstart [GetCountry('HE3').GetName|T] even breaking their ties with us.\n\nIt is time to take direct control over our unruly subjects and show the north who the true rulers of #G Eptelon#! are!

03_cymeva_task_11_DESC.text: With our colonies firmly under our control, all that's left is to subjugate the various divided #Y Eptelonian#! tribes. We shall dominate the continent that refused to bow to #T Atheus the Conqueror#!!

03_cymeva_task_12_DESC.text: While we struggle to defeat the [GetCountry('ATH').GetName|T], it is important not to forget the various #Y Horteonian#! tribes to our north and east. Divided they are weak, however if they were to attack simultaneously it would be a disaster not seen since the #Y Fourth Atheusian-Horteonian Wars#!! We must make sure that our border is well-defended to prevent such attacks.

03_cymeva_task_13_DESC.text: With our border secured, the time has come to finally subjugate the last free #Y Horteonians#! of the north! Let us finally unite the #Y Land of Fire and Ice#! under our rule!

03_cymeva_task_14_DESC.text: The dreaded city of [GetProvince('(int32)264').GetName|Y] has stood as a symbol of #Y Horteonian#! resistance since the #Y Fourth Atheusian-Horteonian Wars#!, mocking our race with its longevity. However, with the #Y Horteonians#! defeated and the city under our control, it is pertinent that we convert this symbol of resistance into one of submission to our rule. The #Y Bulwark of Horteon#! will become our new #Y Eastern Capital#!!

me_cymeva_1_desc.text: Centuries have passed since our people could consider themselves part of a whole #Y Atheusian#! realm. While #Y High Elves#! live long lives, very few if any remain that can still recall the days of the united #Y High Order#!.\n\nIn that time, our people have become more urban, cosmopolitan, and belligerent than our rural western 'brothers'. With war looming on the horizon, many wonder if we should continue to claim the legacy of #Y #R Atheus the Conqueror#!#! or promote our local culture as sons of #Y Cymeva#!.

me_cymeva_1_tooltip.b.text: #T [GetCountry('ACY').GetName] will embrace their unique #E Cymevan#! culture#!

me_cymeva_2_title.text: The End of the High Elven Peace

me_cymeva_2_desc.text:
For close to five centuries our people have been divided between the two #Y Elfrealms#! of #G Horteon#!, stifling our growth and costing us our empire.

No longer shall we accept this status quo!

Messengers have already been sent to the colonies, calling for additional manpower to bolster our forces. Our #Y Horteonian#! subjects as recruited to serve as scouts and auxiliaries. Our armies now march with purpose towards [GetProvince('(int32)142').GetName|Y], seeking to fulfill #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetFirstName]'s#! dream to restore the #Y High Order#! and the #Y Ascendic Empire#! under our rightful rule, as the true successors of #T Atheus the Conqueror#!!

me_cymeva_2_tooltip.text: #R We will declare war on the [GetCountry('ATH').GetName]#!

me_cymeva_3_desc.text:
My lord, terrible news. It seems that the presumptuous and prideful [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetName|Y] has let his greed and ambition get in the way of reason!

The forces of [GetCountry('ACY').GetName|T] now march on our lands, seeking to take [GetProvince('(int32)142').GetName|Y] and reunite the #Y High Order of Atheus#!.

However, this fight is far from over, and we are more than able to defeat this upstart on the battlefield. Their troops are trained as professional soldiers much like in the days of #Y Atheus the Great#!, but what we lack in quality we more than make up in quantity.

Should we defeat the #Y Cymevans#!, there is hope that we could unite the #Y Elfrealms#! of the north under our banner, and finally honor the legacy of #T Atheus#!!

me_cymeva_3.a.text: Rally the troops in the name of Atheus!

me_cymeva_3_tooltip.text: #R We will fight [GetCountry('ACY').GetName] to unite the #E High Elves#!#!

me_cymeva_4_desc.text:
My King, word has come from our overlord, [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetName|Y]! He demands men and gold for his war to unite the #Y Elfrealms#! of #G Horteon#! under his banner!

Obviously our men are eager to serve alongside their countrymen in #G Horteon#!, and I have no doubts of your loyalty to [GetProvince('(int32)345').GetName|Y], but there have been murmurs of dissent coming from both the government and the people.

Speculations that the #Y Cymevans#! see us nothing more as extra manpower have begun circulating, and there are those that would prefer to see our overlord punished rather than succeed.

Of course, the loyalty of the men and of the people is to you, my King. We shall follow you to the battlefield, whether it be against or for the #Y Cymevans#!.

me_cymeva_4_tooltip.a.text: #R We will lead a war of independence against [GetCountry('ACY').GetName]#!

me_cymeva_5_desc.text:
Great #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetFirstName]#!, terrible news from the colonies! It seems that our colony, [SCOPE.sCountry('horteonic_subject').GetName|T], has responded to our call to arms with a declaration of independence!

Normally, crushing their small army would not be a troubling affair, our current campaign against [GetCountry('ATH').GetName|T] means that we cannot afford to stretch our forces too thin!

Great King, I know your wisdom will see us through this turmoil. Should we win this war quickly, the traitors shall be punished!

me_cymeva_5.a.text: They dare rise up against me?

me_cymeva_5_tooltip.text: #R [SCOPE.sCountry('horteonic_subject').GetName] will lead a war of independence against us!#!

me_cymeva_6_title.text: The High Elven Civil War Continues

me_cymeva_6_desc.text: Great King, word has reached us from the far lands of #G Horteon#!! Little information reaches us from this distant land, the extent of our knowledge tells us that it is a cold land with a few human tribes dominated by the two great #Y Elfrealms#! of the #Y High Elves#! that have lived in peace far longer than we can remember.\n\nDespite this knowledge, word has arrived that the two realms now fight for control over the #Y Land of Fire and Ice#! in a bitter struggle that will see only one victor.

me_cymeva_6.a.text: Those pointy-eared snobs are still fighting?

me_cymeva_6_tooltip.text: #R The two elfrealms will clash over who will control the #E High Elves#! of #E Horteon#!!#!

me_cymeva_7_desc.text:
Great Chief! Word comes from the dreaded #Y Elfrealms#! of the south.

Merchants and travelers have been spreading the news that the #Y #R Great Elven Civil War#!#! has continued, and that the #Y Elfrealms#! once again face each other on the battlefield.

The last time they were at odds our people were too disorganized and disheartened to fight, however we have no such luxury now! They have encroached on our territory and taken our people to serve then as slaves. Every opportunity that we don't take now is a chance missed to retake our homeland.

Now seems like an excellent time to strike, if we are able to rally our tribesmen against the #Y High Elves#!, we might yet still have a chance at freeing #G Horteon#!!

me_cymeva_7_tooltip.text: #Y We will gain claims on the #E #R Elfrealms#!#!#!

me_cymeva_8_desc.text: My lord, hundreds of #Y Hua-roc#! have been moving to the various slave estates of the honorable #Y Uoma-arc#!. These great nobles of our country have wisely put these men to work on their various farms and mines, providing crucial nourishment for our soldiers.\n\nAs the #Y Hua-roc#! provide for the #Y Uoma-arc#!, so will they generously provide for our state my king.

me_cymeva_8_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_cymeva_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_cymeva_9_desc.text:
Honorable king, the #Y Alrec-rai#! of [GetProvince('(int32)360').GetName|Y] have come bearing great news! The pearl divers have encountered a large and nearly perfectly spherical pearl worth more than twenty times its weight in gold!

Such an important discovery was assessed for dedication by the local #Y Alrec-rai#!, who determined its qualities to make it fit enough to be dedicated to the great #T Atheus the Conqueror#!!

Such an important find during your reign can only mean your current enlightened rule is blessed by the #Y Ascended#! themselves!

me_cymeva_9_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_cymeva_task_7$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_cymeva_10_desc.text:
Enlightened King, large scale construction on the capital has been completed!

Hosting large districts for the honored #Y Uoma-arc#!, entertainment districts for the common man, and large mills for the #Y Hua-roc#!, our capital has never been more prosperous! Our famous silks now outmatch anything the western #Y High Elves#! could ever hope to produce, and our enlightened #Y Uoma-arc#! are the most intellectual scholars found on the island!

However, the gem of our capital has to the be the impressive #Y Ouvomo District#!. Hosting great temple complexes dedicated to the #Y Ascended#!, this expansive area grants the honored #Y Alrec-rai#! a space to discuss their philosophies. Truly, our city and your rule is one blessed by the #Y Ascended#!!

me_cymeva_10_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_cymeva_task_8$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_cymeva_11_desc.text: Mighty prows distinguish the great fleet that has been assembled on the docks of [GetProvince('(int32)345').GetName|Y]. Their great sails sway in the morning breeze, and their decks are busy with crewmembers preparing them for their future voyages. Inside these vessels carry large cages to store captured prisoners, as well as a lavish cabins for the captain, as only the best would be allowed for an #Y Uoma-arc#!.\n\nWatching his mighty war fleet from a distance, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] sets his sights on lands beyond #G Horteon#!.

me_cymeva_11_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_cymeva_task_9$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_cymeva_12_desc.text: As [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] steps foot on the port of [GetProvince('(int32)450').GetName|Y], he is greeted by the former princes of his colonies. In a historic move, the King has decided to be the first #Y High Elven#! monarch to physically step foot on the island, seeking to symbolize his dominance over the region. However, it is evident to all that #Y Eptelonian#! freedom would be caged alongside the petty kings of [GetProvince('(int32)456').GetName|Y].\n\nProstrating themselves before him, the princes swear fealty to him. Accepting their submission, the King beckons for them to rise.

me_cymeva_12_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_cymeva_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_cymeva_13_desc.text:
From the northern plains, to the southern swamps, all of #G Eptelon#! now bows to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]!

Ever since the #T First Great War of Arteon#! and the expeditions of the #Y Great Slaver Navy#! under #T Atheus the Conqueror#! the #Y High Elves#! have tried time and time again to penetrate the highlands and jungles of this savage land, only to be turned back to the norther coasts. However, no longer are we content to simply raid the interior, now our governor procures us a steady supply of slaves and tribute from the conquered hill tribes of #G Eptelon#!!

Taking notice of our success, many realms of #Y Arteon#! elf and human alike have begun to plot against our rightful control of the island. Perhaps it will soon be time to finish the late #T Atheus#!' wishes and finally subjugate the #Y Land of Eternal War#!...

me_cymeva_13.a.text: Is there truly anyone who can challenge me?

me_cymeva_13_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_cymeva_task_11$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_cymeva_14_desc.text:
Honored king, the #Y Northern Horteonians#! flee from our armies, their captured brethren now joining the ranks of our #Y Hua-roc#!!

Our men have consistently won decisive battle against their chiefs, dividing and conquering as to slowly and securely assure our conquests. Our generals report making it as far as the hills of the #Y Gnomes#!!

The best news to come from this campaign is the fall of [GetProvince('(int32)264').GetName|Y], the #Y Bulwark of Horteon#!! Having repelled our forces for more than five hundred years, this singular settlement has stood as a symbol of #Y Horteonian#! resistance, with its famous port providing the interior with many of their imports. No longer shall their walls halt #Y High Elven#! ambitions, as the mighty citadel is now ours!

me_cymeva_14_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_cymeva_task_13$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_cymeva_15_desc.text:
Enlightened ruler, construction on what was once [GetProvince('(int32)264').GetName|Y] has been completed!

Their infamous walls that once defended against our soldiers now protect our frontier from northern raiders, and their ports now bustle with #Y High Elven#! merchants who have been outcompeteing the local #Y Horteonians#!! Without their imports, the remaining northern #Y Horteonians#! will remain weak and isolated. They shall soon find themselves working as our #Y Hua-roc#!!

The new districts built have provided enough acommodations to attract various #Y Uoma-arc#! and #Y Alrec-rai#! to the city, who have brought many commoners with them. Rebuilding large sections of the city in the #Y High Elven#! style, [GetProvince('(int32)264').GetName|Y] has truly become our #Y Eastern Capital#!!

me_cymeva_15_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_cymeva_task_14$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_cymeva_war_tooltip.text: #R We will declare war on the #E Atheus Dominion#!!#!

03_duggmannrum_DESCRIPTION.text:
The great kingdom of [GetCountry('SV3').GetName|T] is in mourning, as the wise king #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#! now rests with his ancestors in the great #Y Silver Caves#!. His extensive rule oversaw the slow conquest and integration of the lands surrounding [GetProvince('(int32)3883')GetName|E], finally reuniting the former lands of the historic principality of #Y Duggmannri#!, creating a new power in the #G Green Valley#!. With its large population and historical significance as the core of the #G Second Kingdom of Srrørum#!, most in the valley expected the kingdom to make a bid for reunification.

It was this fear that drove the other nations to form coalition after coalition to try and stifle the potential of this rising rival. Instead of retaliating, the wise  #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#! spent the rest of his reign devoted to making diplomatic connections and defending his territory, slowly building up his kingdom and reputation. Near the end of his rule, the former members of the latest coalition, exhausted from years of war, signed the great #Y Eternal Peace#! meant to end all hostilities in the valley. While there continues to be raids and skirmishes along isolated borders, the effectiveness of this treaty has stood as perhaps the greatest accomplishment of the former king.

On his deathbed, the old royal called for his only son, #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#!. Nobody knows what was said in that room, but what emerged from the King's chamber was not the scared young prince that had entered. His visage now resembled that of a man determined to follow a king's dying wish.

Once crowned, #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! made his intentions clear to the court: he alone would be the one to unite the #Y Anvindr#! under his banner.

03_duggmannrum_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has restored #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)65').GetFirstName]'s#! kingdom.

03_duggmannrum_task_1_DESC.text: Before #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! can begin his conquest of the valley, he needs information on his opponents as well as time to consolidate his own armies. Utilizing the diplomatic connections established during his father's reign, #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! sends spies to report on the state of the other realms of the #G Green Valley#!.\n\nMeanwhile at home, the young king begins to mobilize his forces and kingdom for a grand total war against the other nations.

03_duggmannrum_task_2_DESC.text: #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! may be young, but he is a perceptive ruler. Based on the reports from his spies he knows that other nations are plotting against him, so to survive he must introduce an element of chaos to stifle any attempts at cooperation.\n\nFully prepared for war, the King sends out his messengers to every independent nation in the #G Green Valley#! to announce his march on [GetCountry('SV6')GetName|E], breaking the #Y Eternal Peace#! created by the late king #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#!. With this move, the #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! intends on exploiting the disunited nature of the six nations to divide and conquer.

03_duggmannrum_task_3_DESC.text: While our superior army is able to take on any other foe easily, the [GetCountry('SV1').GetName|T] presents a more formidable challenge.\n\nUsing the key he found in #Y Veddtunn#!, #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! is confident in his ability to negotiate with the knights.

03_duggmannrum_task_4_DESC.text: Starting our conquests in the east, we must subjugate the brewers of [GetCountry('SV6').GetName|T] if we have any hope of reaching the #G Eastern Gate#!. Their rich markets and flavorful beer will fuel our economy and our soldier's bellies.

03_duggmannrum_task_5_DESC.text: The scholars of [GetCountry('SV5').GetName|T] will be a tricky opponent to face. However, our sovereign realizes the importance of innovation in this changing world, and their services and records will be needed for his future ambitions.

03_duggmannrum_task_6_DESC.text: The infamous Droi are now one of the last obstacles in our path. Ancient enemies of #G King Hefdarr 'to Togg'#!, they are hated by all in the #G Green Valley#!. Therefore, their conquest is necessary to eliminate all threats to our power, and will be a unifying feat for our new subjects to participate in.

03_duggmannrum_task_7_DESC.text: To protect our exposed eastern flank against elvish marauders we must bring the #Y Guardians of the Eastern Gate#! into our growing realm. Their important soul gem mine of [GetProvince('(int32)4075').GetName|G] might also be important to our nation's development.

03_duggmannrum_task_8_DESC.text: Our conquests have generated a lot of chaos and migrations, we should take this time to consolidate our hold over the #G Green Valley#! and secure our position.

03_duggmannrum_task_9_DESC.text: A scholar himself, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] hopes to learn from #Y Hefdarr#!'s success during the #T Unification Wars#! and implement his policies. This includes enacting numerous meritocratic reforms that will ensure the loyalty and competency of his generals and administrators.

03_duggmannrum_task_10_DESC.text: The #Y Sennmöggen Knights#! are universally hailed as the best quality troops in the valley. Now that we have secured their loyalty we should choose whether to implement them into our armies as leaders or use them as elite guardsmen.

03_duggmannrum_task_11_DESC.text: For nearly four hundred years the armies of the #G Green Valley#! have been employing the antiquated #Y Sennjallurr#! devised by King #Y Hefdarr#! himself. While the formation isn't bad, it has made warfare stale and tedious, halting #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]'s#! advance. \n\nNumerous brutal engagements like the #Y Battle of Bárrlantpiath#! have given #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! and his generals enough experience to recognize the need for change and experiment with new tactics. After drilling their troops for hours in this new formation, #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! is finally ready to unveil the infamous #Y Sennfernnen#! to the remaining kingdoms of the valley.

03_duggmannrum_task_12_DESC.text: While scant few mages have existed in our highlands and in [GetProvince('(int32)3988').GetName|G] for centuries, the widespread distrust of mages in silver dwarven culture has caused the mage community in our nation to be relatively small and underdeveloped. To help grow our small community of ragtag mages, the King has sent diplomats to the great schools of the oppressed #T Humans#! of #G Soveneria#! to bring back mages willing to teach our young talent.

03_duggmannrum_task_13_DESC.text: A powerful symbol of the King's authority, the #Y Gerrbaen's#! capacity and scale have remained at the level of a small city. It is time to expand this wonder to be able to stand as a monument worthy of our great capital!

03_duggmannrum_task_14_DESC.text: Traditional #Y Anvindr#! armies rely on the core heavy infantry to push the enemy back while light cavalry and archers support the frontlines from the flanks. While this has worked to defend our lands for centuries, it has not been the best strategy for the wars of conquest #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! has been waging.\n\nWith the treasure the king has seized from enemy lands, #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! has expanded his small retinue of knights into multiple regiments of heavily armored cavalrymen riding heavily armored steeds. These #Y Sennkallen#! will provide the offensive power #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! needs by smashing through the flanks of enemy armies and crushing their center.

03_duggmannrum_task_15_DESC.text: The once legendary #Y Hthgart Brewery#! has spent nearly 100 years in decline, turning the once bustling markets of [GetProvince('(int32)3947').GetName|G] to shadow of its former self. It's time to honor #Y Hlffstten#!'s legacy and rebuild his city and brewery.

03_duggmannrum_task_16_DESC.text: The academies and universities of [GetProvince('(int32)3988').GetName|G] have long served as the academic heart of the #Y Anvindr#!. Now it is time to give them the proper funding they need to expand their operations and research.

03_duggmannrum_task_17_DESC.text: The mines of [GetProvince('(int32)4075').GetName|G] could become a valuable asset if we are able to use their untapped potential. By expanding them, we can supply our nation with a steady supply of #Y soul gems#! which would be useful to the magical researchers of [GetProvince('(int32)3988').GetName|G].
