03_duggmannrum_task_18_DESC.text: Our people have historically been rural, with herders living in our mountains and serfs working on large estates in the few plots of arable land in our valley. The main inhabitants of our cities have always been the wealthy nobility and the few merchants wealthy enough to live alongside them. However, to compete with the large cities of the outside world we must provide incentives for peasants to come and make our cities more productive!

03_duggmannrum_task_19_DESC.text: The #G Green Valley#!, despite its name, actually has a scarce amount of arable land. With our growing population comes a growing demand for more food, a demand that we must satisfy lest we face famine. Therefore the King has devised a program of state-funded farms to provide the food that our people need.

03_duggmannrum_task_20_DESC.text: While [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName|G] has served well as the capital of a small kingdom, it no longer reflects the power that we now wield. To rebuild his capital into the seat of a dynasty worthy of being the successors to #Y Hefdarr's#! #Y Kingdom#!, #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! plans to import specialists from across the #G Green Valley#! to turn [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName|G] into a city worthy of being named a #Y Sørrborr#!!

03_duggmannrum_task_21_DESC.text: Although the rebuilding efforts have yielded beautiful results, our great #Y Sørrborr#! still lacks the crucial gem to elevate it to the capital of an empire.\n\nGathering the brightest architects and engineers from across his realm, #Y ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! prepares plans to build the most opulent palace in #Y Silver Dwarven#! history to showcase his power and authority both abroad and at home.

03_duggmannrum_task_22_DESC.text: Now that he's unified, reformed, and strengthened his realm, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] plans to follow in the footsteps of #Y Hefdarr#! and reveal his true ancestry, tying himself to a legacy that extends back to the #Y Mythic Age#!!

me_duggmannrum_1_desc.text:
It has been over a year since the death of the former king, yet #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! still remembers his final conversation with his late father:

'#Y My son, I have done all I can for you. My time approaches soon.#!'

Tears ran down the young prince's cheeks. The old man was so frail his words could be mistaken for mumbled whispers.

'#G I'm not ready father. I would be lost without your guidance.#!'

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#! looked over at his son. Although even the young man himself saw a terrified boy not ready for the responsibilities of a king, the shrewd old man saw what he could become.

'#Y Foolish boy, are you not the scholar you claim to be? All the guidance you need has been preserved in the tomes written by your ancestors.#!'

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! wiped his eyes and chuckled. No matter how old he grew his father would still scold him as if he were a child.

'#G Is that why you were always so fixated on conquering #E Veddtunn#!#!?'

The old man paused, lost in thought. Puzzled,  #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! studied his father's face as it made an expression he had never seen before. After a moment of contemplation, #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#! spoke:

'#Y #E Veddtunn#! holds the key my son. The key to reunifying the valley.#!'

'#G How so? There aren't many military manuals we don't already possess here-#!'

'#Y Deep within the secret rooms of the ancient tower resides a record, one that may grant you the legitimacy you need to rule it all...#!'

'#G Rule it all? Father, if you couldn't do it what makes you think-#!'

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#! raised his hand to silence his son's protests. After a brief pause, the old man uttered his final words.

'#Y Go to #E Veddtunn#! and reclaim your birthright. Use the gifts I have left you to reconquer the Silver Kingdom, and go beyond the Western Door. This I ask of you, because I know only you can do it.#!'

...

Although its been kept a strict secret to not arouse suspicion, everyone at court knows what #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]'s#! ambitions are. With excellent information on his enemies and his nation ready to march alongside him, it is time for the entire #G Green Valley#! to learn what kind of king #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! intends to be.

me_duggmannrum_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_2_desc.text:
The same scene repeats in every nation.

Displays of outrage, disbelief, and panic were soon replaced with a concealed smile that revealed their true colors. In truth, the rulers of the six nations did not wait for this day with baited breaths, but with wanton anticipation. Every nation had unresolved conflicts and grudges, some dating back centuries, that they intended to settle on the battlefield. Every nation hoped and dreamed for the opportunity to expand their reach over the #G Green Valley#!. Every nation shared the same first though when they heard #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]'s#! messengers announce his invasion of [GetCountry('SV6').GetName|T]:

'Now's my chance!'

But none of them are #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#!. The young king's ambitions combined with the strength of the nation left to him by his father fuel confidence in his cause and enthusiasm in the ranks.

These fools know nothing of what's to come, let our armies teach them what it means to wage war!

me_duggmannrum_2.a.text: We shall march until the #E Green Valley#! is ours

me_duggmannrum_2_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_3_desc.text:
After centuries of war, the heirs of #G Srrørum#! have been whittled down to a mere six nations from the hundreds that have been lost to history. While nobody truly expected the #Y Eternal Peace#! to last, there were those that hoped it would lead to a more peaceful reunification or a state of coexistence between the remaining realms. Since the fateful invasion of [GetCountry('SV6').GetName|T], these misguided beliefs have been crushed.

Although many small skirmishes and raids had occurred across isolated frontiers during the peace, there hasn't been a true battle in the #G Green Valley#! in over two decades. The armies of the #Y Anvindr#! are filled with young men unexperienced with the horrors of war and eager for glory, and their leaders are equally as blinded by their personal greed to avoid falling into another period of endless war.

Hopefully, this period of war won't be just another footnote in the long history of conflicts in the #G Green Valley#!, and instead be the final great conflict that ends the centuries of division that have claimed the lives of hundreds of thousands of #Y Silver Dwarves#! across the valley.

The most optimistic of the #Y Anvindr#!, namely the officers in the army of [GetCountry('SV3').GetName|T] are calling these conflicts the #Y Second Unification Wars#! in a callback to the conquests of the legendary King #Y Hefdarr#!. Let us hope that they are correct in assuming this will be the last the #Y Anvindr#! see of total war in the #G Green Valley#!.

me_duggmannrum_3.a.text: We shall unite the #E Green Valley#! under our banner!

me_duggmannrum_4_desc.text:
When a messenger arrived asking for an audience with #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! with on behalf of the young king of [GetCountry('SV3').GetName|T], the #Y Srrøbondi#! was hesitant to accept his request. This was the same belligerent man who had trampled what peace there was in the valley with his volatile actions.

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! agrees to the meeting, and sends the messenger back to his king with the good news. Whatever #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]'s#! motives may be, this meeting would serve as an excellent opportunity for the ambitious #Y Srrøbondi#! to finally get involved in the politics of the #G Green Valley#!. Having sworn themselves to the defense of the #Y Silver Caves#! and the #Y Duggmoggen Clan#!, the knights of the #T Order of Sennmoggen#! consider involving themselves in the affairs of other nations a taboo ever since the death of their patron and the final #Y Duggmoggen#!, King #Y Hefdarr#!. If #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! can persuade the other senior members of the order that #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! poses a significant threat to the sacred #Y Silver Caves#!, he might be able to mobilize the knights to carve out his own kingdom.

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]'s#! eyebrows furrow, what was the young king doing?

He was expecting a boisterous tyrant who would demand the knights submit to him, not the relatively soft-spoken young man kneeling in front of him. Kneeling in front of the leader of another nation? Whatever his aims were, #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! had certainly captured the attention of the #Y Srrøbondi#!. The knight let out a hearty laugh.

'#Y Hail fellow, it is good to meet you young #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#!! Whatever it is you're here for I guarantee you won't find it on your knees.#!'

Muffled snickers and whispers surrounded the chamber. The young king, however, looked unphased.

'#G I came looking for a sword.#!'

'#Y A sword?#!'

'#G Yes, every great King needs a sword to both protect him and attack his enemies. I am told that you and your knights are the finest warriors in the valley, and so I came to ask you to be my sword.#!'

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! scoffs. What a ridiculous request! Is this just the enigmatic man's way of asking his order to submit to his nation?

'#Y Humor me, o great king. Why should we?#!'

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! looked around the room. It was not yet time.

'#Y Perhaps I may convince you over dinner?#!'

Amused, the #Y Srrøbondi#! chuckled.

#G Of course, you must be weary from your journey after all. I assure you we have enough chairs that you need not kneel for this meal.#!'

...

Later that night, long after the merriment and laughs that accompanied tonight's meal, the two men conversed alone in the #Y Srrøbondi's#! office.

'#G Thank you again for the meal, Srrøbondi#!'

'#Y Please, call me #E [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#!. I should be the one thanking you for being an excellent guest. I much enjoyed the stories about your time in [GetProvince('(int32)3947')GetName|E]#!'

'#G The only thing those merchants love more than coins is beer, I can guarantee you that!#!'

The two men shared a laugh, which #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! soon followed with a question:

'#G Have you thought of my request?#!'

A brief look of confusion flashed across #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]'s#! face, followed by one of recognition.

'#Y Young King, I believe you have yet to convince me to give up our sovereignty#!'

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! frowned,

'#G It's not an annexation if that's what you thought I was offering. It'd be more akin to an alliance. You lend me you armies and I protect you lands from the western nations.#!'

'#Y What would we have to gain from an alliance with you? You're reputation would suggest you don't do well with treaties#!'

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! winced. The #Y Srrøbondi#! wasn't wrong. It seemed that the only way to convince him would be appeal to the #Y Order#!'s oaths. The King called in one of his servants and brought out a large red book, presenting it to #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#!.

'#Y What is this?#!'

'#G An argument, for the alliance#!'

Confused, #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! opened the book, and began to read.

me_duggmannrum_4.a.text: I hope the #E Srrøbondi#! can recognize my birthright

me_duggmannrum_4_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

When a messenger arrived asking for an audience with #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! with on behalf of the young king of [GetCountry('SV3').GetName|T], the #Y Srrøbondi#! was hesitant to accept his request. This was the same belligerent man who had trampled what peace there was in the valley with his volatile actions.

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! agrees to the meeting, and sends the messenger back to his king with the good news. Whatever #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]'s#! motives may be, this meeting would serve as an excellent opportunity for the ambitious #Y Srrøbondi#! to finally get involved in the politics of the #G Green Valley#!. Having sworn themselves to the defense of the #Y Silver Caves#! and the #Y Duggmoggen Clan#!, the knights of the #T Order of Sennmoggen#! consider involving themselves in the affairs of other nations a taboo ever since the death of their patron and the final #Y Duggmoggen#!, King #Y Hefdarr#!. me_duggmannrum_5.a.text: The Order will grant the #E True King#! our strength

me_duggmannrum_5.b.text: The records must be a fake!

me_duggmannrum_6_desc.text: After a few tense weeks, the people rejoice when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] returns to [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName|G] triumphant!\n\nThe King holds a grand feast will all his nobles and several of the Knights that accompanied him home to celebrate his friendship with his new vassal, #Y Grandmaster#! [GetCountry('SV1').GetRuler.GetName|Y] of the #Y Sennmöggen#!!

me_duggmannrum_7_desc.text: Leaving the #Y Grand Master#!'s Castle, the young King flies into a fit of rage.\n\n'He defies me and doubts my lineage? I will force him to recognize me as the true king.'

me_duggmannrum_7.a.text: Let us show the Sennmöggen the might of the True King!

me_duggmannrum_8_desc.text:
A relatively new kingdom based on an ancient practice, #T Jórrvetali#! was founded by the merchant council of [GetProvince('(int32)3947').GetName|G], an ancient city with roots dating back to the #Y Mythic Age#!. In fact, legends say that back when the majestic city was but a small settlement a pair of brothers were the first in #G Omniluxia#! to discover a magical drink popular amongst all dwarves: #Y Beer#!!

In the last century, the city has become famous for its expansive merchant districts and innumerable taverns that serve every kind of alcohol known to dwarvenkind. Famously, #Y Hthgart the Brewer#! founded his famous brewery in the city nearly a century ago. Credited with inventing fifty new types of ales, the brewery's claim to fame was its delicious #Y Hthgart Ale#!, said to be the greatest beer in all of #G Omniluxia#!.

Since the great brewer's death the city has been in decline, as numerous wars and bad investments have taken their toll on the infrastructure and people. Under our rule, we will use their position as the mercantile heart of the #G Green Valley#! to restore the great merchant city to its former glory!

me_duggmannrum_8_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_4$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_9_desc.text:
Fulfilling his dying father's wish, young #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetName]#! has finally taken the ancient library of #Y Veddtunn#!!

Said to contain information on nearly every topic known to the #Y Silver Dwarves#!, the tower itself hides many secret tombs from curious scholars within its labyrinthian corridors and chambers. So vast is the library and its catacombs that it is not uncommon to hear stories of new chambers being rediscovered with the bones of long-dead scribes.

Accompanied by a retinue of his loyal guard and with only a small note left by his father to guide him, #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetName]#! begins his descent into the catacombs in search of the ancient treasure that is the key to the unification of the #G Green Valley#!.

me_duggmannrum_9.a.text: Let's try not to run into any cobwebs

me_duggmannrum_9_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_5$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_10_desc.text: Ever since Duke #Y Harttol 'to Ommor'#!s treachery and defeat at the #Y Battle of Driorum#! during the #Y Great Zanni Invasion#! all of the #Y Anvindr#! have despised the Droi who followed their leader against the Defender of the #G Green Valley#!, King #Y Hefdarr#!. Isolated and hostile to the all of the realms of the valley, their subjugation both removed an obstacle to our rule and served as a rallying cry for our subjects.\n\nAs the saying goes:

me_duggmannrum_10.a.text: A dwarf neither forgives nor forgets

me_duggmannrum_10_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_11_desc.text: The Defenders of the #G Eastern Gate#!, the #Y Khundavli#!, are strong fighters that carry on the legacy of the great #Y Ulffgrdd 'to Jallurr'#!.\n\nThrough decisive victory alone we have bested them, thus, to honor their spirit we must carry on this title and take on the mantle of Defenders of the #G Eastern Gate#!!

me_duggmannrum_11_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_7$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_12_desc.text:
With our conquest of the #G Green Valley#! completed, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] can now focus on maintaining stability in his realm.

Imitating the great #Y King Hefdarr#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] tours his new realm, giving generous donations to the peasantry and assuring the loyalty of the local nobility.

Through his journeys, his hold over the #G Green Valley#! strengthens. His #Y Kingdom#! finally stable and at peace, he intends to rebuild the realm in his image!

me_duggmannrum_12_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_8$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_13_desc.text: With access to the brightest and most ambitious young talent in his kingdom, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] can put these loyal new men to work managing the realm and his campaigns!

me_duggmannrum_13.a.text: Another step towards the restoration of Srrørum!

me_duggmannrum_13_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_9$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_14_desc.text:
It's a stormy evening when the King meets with the #Y Grand Master#! of the #Y Sennmöggen#! a second time.

[GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetName|Y] kneels upon greeting his liege, acknowledging the young king's power, rising when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] commands it.

Due to the ongoing conflicts, the meeting is brief, and formalities are skipped. The King only has one goal: to add the #Y Sennmöggen#! as an asset to assist him in his wars.

After discussing the matter with the #Y Grand Master#!, the King declares that:

me_duggmannrum_14.b.text: 'The Sennmöggen will be my personal guard'

me_duggmannrum_14_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_15_title.text: The Grand Master Joins the Court

me_duggmannrum_15_desc.text: It's a warm summer evening when the King is surprised by the arrival of his favorite vassal at his court. After greeting him warmly, both men sit and feast together as the dining hall is filled with cries of joy and celebration. After the meal, the #Y Grand Master#! stands up to make an announcement. After years of working closely with his sovereign, he has decided to officially cede the lands of the #Y Order#! to the King, and join his court as his chief military advisor to be able to fully support his dream of restoring #G Srrørum#!. A brief silence is followed by a great roar of approval, and the two men spend the rest of the evening laughing and celebrating the arrival of 'to Sath'.

me_duggmannrum_16_desc.text:
Following pyhrric victories such as the #Y Battle of Bárrlantpiath#!, King [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] and his generals have been experimenting with new tactics to replace the outdated #Y Sennjallurr#!.

While the old tactic was effective due to it's simplicity, it wasn't maneuverable enough to allow for an overwhelming victory. In this environment, the #Y Sennfernnen#! was born.

The '#Y Iron Squares#!' splits the army into smaller units of fifty heavily armored pikemen that move across the battlefield semi-autonomously, protecting themselves from cavalry and giving them more maneuverability than the stiff #Y Sennjallurr#!.

Drilling his armies in this new formation, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] was able to win crushing victories such as the #Y Battle of Driorum#!.

me_duggmannrum_16_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_11$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_17_desc.text: While the #Y Anvindr#! have been historically suspicious of magic for good reason, King [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] recognizes their worth in both battle and at his court.\n\nThe dragkhanic [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T] has some of the most advanced magical schools in all of #Y Omniluxia.#! Ensuring good relations with this powerful state while importing many of their ambitious young mages will help kickstart the development of our own magical research and corps.

me_duggmannrum_17.a.text: Let us hope these Dragkhans cause no trouble...

me_duggmannrum_17_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_12$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_18_desc.text:
The #Y Gerrbaen#! is a large complex of farms and gardens etched into the nearby #Y Green Hills#! that give [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName|G] its name. Construction began under #Y King Hefdarr#!, and the wonder was finally completed under his successor. Having fallen somewhat into disrepair during the last few centuries, its revitalization under [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has restored it to it's intended majesty! Alongside it's existing impressive structures, newer expansions have been added to ensure [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s influence is felt on such an important monument.

Atop the mighty hill stands the #Y Konungien#!, or royal gardens, a space restricted to the royal family of [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName|G]. The few groundskeepers who have seen it report seeing exotic animals, and even wilder accounts say that the king keeps wild #Y Fai#! as his pets.

The remainder of the monument is enjoyed by both nobles and commoners, and seend as a symbol of the power and generosity of the kings of [GetCountry('SV3').GetName|T].

me_duggmannrum_18_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_13$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_19_desc.text: Feared armored knights, many soldiers flee once they catch a glimpse of the silver masks of the #Y Sennkallen#!!\n\nStaffed mostly by nobles, this heavy cavalry contingent helped end the #Y Second Unification Wars#! as it crushed most cavalry pitted against it. These #Y Iron Horsemen#! were crucial in winning later battles such as the #Y Battle of Púkklantenath#!, as they decisively won the day by smashed into enemy flanks!

me_duggmannrum_19_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_14$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_20_desc.text:
[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] looks over the rejuvenated [GetProvince('(int32)3947').GetName|G] from his royal camp on a nearby hill.

The markets and bars buzz with activity as carts filled with goods from across his realm flood into the reborn city. At the center of it all stands the great #Y Htgarth Brewery#!, its once-dormant chimneys now filling the air with smoke and a sweet aroma.

The King smiles as he beckons for his entourage to follow him into town.

me_duggmannrum_20_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_15$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_21_desc.text:
The '#Y City of Scholars#!' hosts large academies, forums, and villas surrounding the mighty #Y Veddtunn#!, a library containing knowledge stretching back to the #Y Mythic Age#!! The newest additions to this great library have scholars from across the #G Green Valley#! migrating to the #Y Ringed City#! in search of knowledge and ancient treasures.

A scholar himself, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] encourages the nobles of his realm to send their sons to be educated at the academies of the #Y 'City of Knowledge'#!.

'After all', he says, 'a great statesmen should also be a great philosopher.'

me_duggmannrum_21_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_16$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_22_desc.text: For years the scholars of [GetProvince('(int32)3988').GetName|G] have tried in vain to obtain the soul gems of [GetProvince('(int32)4075').GetName|G] for magical research. Constantly repulsed by the hostile #Y Khundavli#!, most gave up on the endeavor and abandoned what little magical research was available in the valley.\n\nWith the acquisition of both territories, these same scholars are now free study these esoteric gems for the benefit of our kingdom!

me_duggmannrum_22.a.text: You say there are souls in these gems?

me_duggmannrum_22_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_17$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_23_desc.text:
Serfdom has historically been the backbone of our realms, with most of our population living in rural villages or manor estates. However, this system does not fit in the #G Srrørum#! imagined by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y].

He argues that if the #Y Silver Dwarves#! are to compete with the stories of the grand cities of the #Y #R Zanni#!#!, our people must recreate the sprawling urban centers of the #T First Kingdom of Srrørum#!. With the influx of serfs comes the increased available labor and merchants to fuel our local economies and workshops, bringing riches to our realm.

Alongside this migration comes a somewhat more sinister goal. The movement of these people breaks down their traditional familial ties and ends cycles of violence, while slowly etching at the powerbase of powerful landed nobility. If these urbanization trends continue, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] could find himself ruling as the absolute monarch of a kingdom reminiscent of the #T First Kingdom of Srrørum#!!

me_duggmannrum_23.a.text: Let the great cities of the valley rise!

me_duggmannrum_23_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_18$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_24_desc.text: An unseen side effect of the recent urbanization are the growing demands to feed the growing populations of the cities and make up for the depleting workforce of the rural farmlands.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] seeing the need to feed his people, has had to redistribute lands to local farmers and providing them with more funding to increase their crop yields. While this does come at a great expense to our kingdom, these new farmers will act as the backbone of our urbanization.

me_duggmannrum_24.a.text: Ours is a people of the soil

me_duggmannrum_24_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_19$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_25_desc.text:
Busy streets and markets buzz as the King's entourage travel through the city. #T Wealth#! once unimaginable to the common people now exists in abundance, as the aroma of fresh bread and hot iron fill the morning air. The new market district of the city is so expansive that new merchants flood the streets everyday, and the bazaars constantly bustle with activity.

Nearby the large stone temple districts coincide with the housing districts, and freemen freely interact with monks as they pay a visit to the local shrines.

Higher in the hills the nobility live in larger mansions brimming with luxuries unimaginable only a few years ago. During the night the city glows as street lights cast a warm inviting glow to any visitors wandering the nearby mountains.

Once closer to a small hamlet, our city has now become a true #Y Sørrborr#!, a #Y Great City#! of the #Y Silver Dwarven#! world! All that remains is a finishing touch.

me_duggmannrum_25_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_20$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_26_desc.text:
'Beautiful', gasps the King.

 The grand palace of his royal majesty [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] now stands completed, overlooking the great #Y Sørrborr#! of [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName|G], the finishing piece to a beautiful tapestry.

Built in the #Y neo-Hefdarric#! style, the palace complex features more than a thousand five-hundred rooms filled with elaborate paintings, unique designs, and grand statues of ancient #Y Silver Dwarven#! heroes. The various dining areas host live musicians, who entertain guests that feast with the great king.

Outside the palace is a road that leads directly to #Y Konungien#!, elaboratly decorated with all mannor of well-kept flowers and hedges.

Intended as symbol of power to his nobility, the finished result certainly delivers what was promised to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]. With this final step, the king feels prepared to declare the restoration of the #Y Kingdom of the Silver Dwarves#!!

me_duggmannrum_26.a.text: A powerful symbol of a powerful King!

me_duggmannrum_26_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_21$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_27_desc.text:
Looking over his prosperous realm, King [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] is finally prepared to announce the restoration of an ancient legacy. He holds a grand celebration in his capital that lasts five days, culminating in a coronation ceremony in his new palace at [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName|G]. However, before [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetName|Y] can place the crown atop his head, the King motions for him to give him the crown, which he takes and holds above his head. As the crowd murmurs, he proclaims:

'When I donn on this crown I cast off my previous identity as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] and claim my true heritage:'

'I am #Y Hefdarr II#!, lost descendant of the #Y House of Duggmöggen#! and the true and rightful King of the #Y Third Kingdom of Srrørum#!, a realm that expands from the Western Door to the #Y Silver Caves#!!'

'My armies will march across mountains, forests, and deserts until my people once again extend from the #G Green Valley#! to the #G Dragon's Pass#!! Our cities will be grand and our coffers full, and I will bring the #Y Silver Dwarves#! into a Golden Age of prosperity unseen since the #Y Mythic Age#!!'

As silence dominates the great hall, #Y Hefdarr II#! places the crown atop his own head and sits on his throne. Shouts break the silence, cheering

me_duggmannrum_27_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_duggmannrum_task_22$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_duggmannrum_28_desc.text:
Weeks of consistent expeditions into the catacombs have bore no fruit, and doubt begins to sprout in the mind of the young king.

'#G What was he even looking for?#!'

'#G How does he even know this would help unify the valley?#!'

'#G How does he know this even exists?#!'

'#G What if my father was wrong?#!'

#Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! pauses for a second, shocked he would lose faith so easily in a man who spent his life ensuring his son would succeed. The relic must be close, the only question remains is: what is it?

'#Y Sire, we've found something!#!'

Intrigued, #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! follows the man through a small crack his men created through a hidden doorway, entering a small chamber with a handful of tomes. Inside, his men are all looking through a thick red book, murmuring anxiously.

Upon seeing their king they bow and give him some space to inspect their find. On the outside the book is nothing special despite being in surprisingly good condition for an older tome. #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! opens the book and begins to read.

'#G This cannot be...#!', he mutters. His eyes examine the page as if looking for something to verify his suspicions.

This was it, the key. The secret his father hid from him, or rather, the rumor he had believed in all his life. Although it could be a fake, the book contained the imperial seal of the legendary #Y Hefdarr#! himself, a symbol nearly impossible to replicate as the item was lost centuries ago. Reading through the book again confirmed it for him, #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! was a descendent of the mythical king himself.

03_dune1_DESCRIPTION.text:
Ever since the fall of the #Y 30th Dynasty#! and the capture of [GetProvince('(int32)2805').GetName|G], the native #Y Baetepians#! have never ruled more than small kingdoms in the #G Upper Baetep#!, subjects in their own homeland. While the #Y Lower Baetepians#! saw greater assimilation into #Y Geallian#! society, the #G Upper Baetepians#! under the new #Y 31st Dynasty#!, the #Y Djedhid#!, fiercly defended their independence, only seeing brief periods of subjugation.

Despite their numerous attempts to retake their homelands, the various Upper #T Baetepian#! Kingdoms have failed to reclaim the provinces of #G Lower Baetep#!, as the occupying #Y Geallian#! forces always fought fiercly to protect one of their most valuable provinces. However, the Invasions of #Y #R Jarenam the Formidable Dragon#!#! and the unpopularity of the #R #E Sertemic Dynasty of Baetep#!#! have opened up a new opportunity for the inhabitants of the south.

Allied together in a common cause, the once-rival states of [GetCountry('DUN').GetName|T] and [GetCountry('AGE').GetName|T] now seek to place [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName|Y] on the #Y Pomegranate Throne#!!

03_dune1_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has reclaimed the #Y Baetep#! for the #G True Pharons#!.

03_dune1_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: We shall reclaim the Pomegranate Throne!

03_dune1_task_1_DESC.text: Centuries of infighting and backstabbing amongst the members of the #Y Djedhid#! family have long since extinguished any hope of fulfilling the dreams of the founders of what became the [GetCountry('DUN').GetName|G] and the [GetCountry('AGE').GetName|G]. These meaningless wars amongst brothers has prevented the claimants of the #Y Pomegranate Throne#! from retaking the #Y Baetep#! from the foreign invaders!\n\nNo longer must this be the case! With the rise of the wise [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName|Y] and the forward-thinking [GetCharacter('(int32)47').GetName|Y], talks have begun about the possibility of a politival marriage that could finally unite the fractured house.

03_dune1_task_3_DESC.text: As the living avatar of #Y #G Khewer#!#!, [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName|Y] holds the responsibility of ensuring her connection to the divine is stable and provides victory for our troops in battle!

03_dune1_task_4_DESC.text: While we are confident our combined forces can thrash the cowardly #Y Sertem#!, it is important that we protect our valuable cities from possible incursions into our territory.

03_dune1_task_5_DESC.text: The time has come! With our alliance to the ruler of [GetCountry('AGE').GetName|Y] secured, let us run down the #Y usurping#! dogs who have stolen our homeland!!

03_dune1_task_6_DESC.text: At long last the #Y Baetep#! is once again ruled by a native dynasty! Finally, the #G True Pharons#! of the #T 31st Dynasty#! can reclaim their title and sit upon the #Y Pomegranate Throne#! once more!

03_dune1_task_7_DESC.text: The rowdy [GetCountry('BEL').GetName|T] #Y Gold Dwarves#! that live in the south are known to be sellswords, willing to lend their considerable strength to anyone willing to pay their prices. Perhaps we should send inquiries to their King, asking if they would be willing to join us in our wars.

03_dune1_task_8_DESC.text: Vowing to the gods of war that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] will take slaves for the #G [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has commanded that vast quantities of iron be imported into [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y] in order to build chains and fetters for our prisoners.

03_dune1_task_9_DESC.text: The farmlands of #G Apesh#! are one of the few places in #Y Luxterra#! where tobacco grows, and the revenues that the state makes from selling this trade good are integral to our survival.

03_dune1_task_10_DESC.text: Thousands of years ago, the #G Pharons#! of #Y Baetep#! built pyramids and temples throughout their realm, utilizing tens of thousands of slaves and laborers to achieve these timeless feats of architecture. Although building a foundry in our capital pales in comparison to erecting a masterwork like the #T Djeba Temple#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has decreed that our soldiers must set aside their swords and pick up shovels this campaign season.

03_dune1_task_11_DESC.text: Without the life-giving waters of the #Y Tetepen River#!, no kingdom or empire would have ever survived in the harsh deserts of #T Baetep#!. We must take advantage of the river's bounty and build as many farms as we can throughout our realm.

03_dune1_task_12_DESC.text: Although our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has grandiose plans for the future of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|G], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] will always have a soft spot in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] ancestral home, the city of [GetProvince('(int32)3735').GetName|Y], and has a plan to beautify the ancient town with a brand new #G Forum#!.

03_dune1_task_13_DESC.text: The dates @dates! that our people produce are renowned throughout #Y Luxterra#! for their sweetness and flavor, making them a prized commodity. We must ensure that our production of these delectable fruits meets the demands of our citizens and traders by building a special marketplace in our capital, where the best of our harvest can be sold to the highest bidder.

03_eptelon_generic_DESCRIPTION.text: #Y The island of#! #Y Eptelon#! has been viewed as a backwater for centuries - overshadowed by the civilizations on #Y Arteon#! to its west and the #Y Austropetolian Archipelago#! to its south, these days #G Eptelon#! mostly serves as a training ground for raiders, pirates and mercenaries to hone their craft before moving on to more dangerous contracts.\n\nIn the days since the #R Great Collapse#!, various factions have fought over bits and pieces of the island; #T Artheousan#! colonizers in the west, #T Ascendic#! #G Elven#! invaders along the northern coasts, and the native tribes in the south all struggle against each other for control, but so far, no state has emerged as the clear hegemon. The #G Beleaguered Isle#! awaits a hand to lead it towards greatness.

03_eptelon_generic_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be considered complete when we have destroyed our enemies and formed #G Eptelon#!.

03_eptelon_generic_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: The time to unite #G Eptelon#! is at hand!

03_eptelon_generic_task_1_DESC.text: #G Eptelon#! punishes the ill-prepared. The island's highland interior is a maze of dense forest and jungle, where warriors who do not know the terrain simply vanish. Whatever power seeks to master this island must first master the art of surviving it. Train the levies, stock the armories, and harden the men for one of the toughest battles they will ever face.

03_eptelon_generic_task_2_DESC.text: The #R Great Slaver Navies#! do not distinguish between native, colonist, or conqueror - they see only bodies, chains and coins. For generations these fleets have raided #G Eptelon#!'s coasts freely, taking whoever is unfortunate enough to be caught near the water.\n\nThat ends now. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has called for watchtowers to be constructed on the headlands, and is encouraging our men to turn the tides and start taking slaves of their own.

03_eptelon_generic_task_3.text: The Goods Of The Fractured Isle

03_eptelon_generic_task_3_DESC.text: #G Eptelon#! is filled with abundant natural resources, some rarer than others, but the island does not have any real trade network - it is time that we change that. Let us set up the infrastructure to begin trading #G Eptelon#!'s wealth.

03_eptelon_generic_task_3_hept_DESC.text: Our future lies not solely on #G Eptelon#!, but with any place that will purchase the many goods we will carry away from here; spices @spices!, timber @wood!, dyes @dye!, and so much more. But before our trade ships can sail to foreign markets, we need a port to which they can return.

03_eptelon_generic_task_4_DESC.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] believes that it is finally time to destroy our enemies and drive them from lands that we have claimed as our own. Every province we conquer must be a staging ground for what comes next - we cannot stop now.

03_eptelon_generic_task_sum_khaya_DESC.text: [GetProvince('(int32)653').GetName|Y] has a reputation that precedes it across every trade lane in the #T Central Omniluxian Sea#!...the dreaded #R 'City of Thieves'#!, a slum-port crammed with war refugees, mercenaries and pirates. No one knows who truly rules the city - is it the pirate gangs operating in its harbor district, or the mercenary companies that have taken over entire districts for themselves? It might be worth finding out for ourselves what is actually going on down there.

03_eptelon_generic_task_5a_DESC.text: For generations, the #Y Eptelonian#! tribes have fought each other as readily as we have fought the foreign invaders - a fact that the colonists learned to exploit. But the time of that weakness is past; a single [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle|T] must rise who can make the other chieftains bend the knee. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has sworn a sacred vow that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] will unify our people before destroying the colonists.

03_eptelon_generic_task_6a_DESC.text: [GetDeityDefinition('omen_tybin').GetName|G], the bloodthirsty #Y Taker of Cities#! that delights in sacking and pillaging, has a shrine devoted to him near #Y Lake Sevan#!. Priests from [GetProvince('(int32)586').GetName|Y] have traveled to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y] with a message for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] - [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] must make a pilgrimage to the lake as soon as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] is able.

03_eptelon_generic_task_elder_mark_DESC.text: The shamans speak of a relic from the First #T Occupation#! - the #T Elder's Mark#!, a carved war-standard carried by the chieftain who first united the #Y Eptelonian#! tribes against the initial wave of #Y Atheusian#! slavers. It was believed to be lost when the invaders burned the great inland settlement at [GetProvince('(int32)748').GetName|Y], but the oral histories have never stopped tracking its possible whereabouts. Three generations of scholars and wandering shamans have left fragments of its trail. Assemble the pieces. Find the Mark. Let it be seen again.

03_eptelon_generic_task_tribal_council_D.text: For centuries, our gods have desired solitude and have withdrawn themselves from the world, but the stirrings on our island have awoken them from their slumbers and they yearn for greater influence.\n\n [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] claims to have been visited by the gods in a dream, where they demanded that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] construct a magnificent temple, the #T Eptelen#!, that will serve as the heart and home of our religion.

03_eptelon_generic_task_5b_DESC.text: The #Y Ascendic#! philosophy teaches that mastery of self must precede mastery of others - and this principle applies to nations no less than individuals. Before the colonial arm of the #T Atheusian Legacy#! can expand across #G Eptelon#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|Y] must demonstrate that its own house is in order.\n\nWith the #Y Black Pearl of Atheus#! in our possession, our work here is all but finished.

03_eptelon_generic_task_6b_DESC.text: Before we can consider looking outward, we must make sure that everything on the home front is secured. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has reasons to believe that there are elements in the court that are plotting against [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] - this cannot be allowed.

03_eptelon_generic_task_7b_DESC.text: The #Y Atheusian#! model of colonial governance is the citadel; a fortified administrative center that projects military authority while housing the administrators, scholars, and philosophical practitioners of the #Y Ascendic#! doctrine. Three such fortresses established along the #G Eptelonian#! coast, properly garrisoned and stocked, would transform this colonial experiment into something permanent.

03_eptelon_generic_task_8b_DESC.text: #G Eptelon#! must not be viewed as a contested frontier, but a future #Y Ascendic#! possession. In order to secure the #T Atheusian Legacy#! of conquering those weaker than us, we must send out the call to #Y High Elves#! abroad - we need soldiers for our armies, citizens for our cities. A bright future awaits those willing to seize it!

03_eptelon_generic_task_5c_DESC.text: There is the ill-conceived belief amongst some civilized people that #G Eptelon#! is a cultural backwater, with nothing that is worwth mentioning in polite society. In order to prove these naysayers to be the fools that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] knows them to be, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] is calling for a vast building campaign in our capital, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y].

03_eptelon_generic_task_6c_DESC.text: Our central location allows us to access to lucrative trade markets in #G Arteon#!, #G Horteon#! and even the #G Austropetolian Archipelago#!. We should take advantage of this and do what we can do increase our trade connections abroad, while making sure that we have a proper market in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y].

03_eptelon_generic_task_7c_DESC.text: Our earliest ancestors hired mercenaries to win their wars - at least that is how the stories go. While it must have been nice to pay men to die for them in battle, this generation must learn how to defend itself. We must turn our sons into soldiers - the levies must be prepared for whatever comes their way.

03_eptelon_generic_task_8c_DESC.text: No one could have ever foreseen that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective|Y] people of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|Y] would be the ones to conquer large swathes of #G Eptelon#!, and yet here we are. Could such a thing have been possible without the leadership of the incomparable [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], who has carried our realm to the heights of glory?

03_eptelon_generic_task_9_DESC.text: We hold portions of #G Eptelon#!, and yet there remains more to conquer. Let us finish the work we have begun and claim the entirety of the island for ourselves.

03_eptelon_generic_task_10_DESC.text: Three decades of intermittent warfare have left #G Eptelon#!'s cities cracked, their populations thinned, their wells unclean and their granaries half-empty. Realizing that we could lose everything that we have fought so hard to gain, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has vowed to rebuild the island.

03_eptelon_generic_task_11_DESC.text: #G Eptelon#! is an island, surrounded by stronger islands - this simple fact determines everything about our long-term security. A land power controls roads and walls, but an island power controls the water around it, and if it does not control its own oceans and rivers, it controls nothing.\n\nForty warships - enough to make any fleet hesitating on the horizon reconsider its options - must be built, crewed, and stationed in our harbors before this island can claim to be truly sovereign.

03_eptelon_generic_task_12_DESC.text: The seat of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective|Y] power on #G Eptelon#! must be made unassailable - not because we fear immediate attack, but because an unfortified capital is an invitation to disaster.\n\nEvery order, every summons, every law that comes from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] will carry more weight if the walls of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] citadel could withstand a siege. It will be an expensive undertaking, but it will be worth it.

03_eptelon_generic_task_12_tooltip.text: Fortify the capital with walls, garrisons, and state infrastructure.

03_eptelon_generic_task_13_DESC.text: For the first time in living memory, #G Eptelon#! is slowly turning into a powerhouse. Under the guidance of the legendary #T House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective]#!, #G Eptelon#! has finally found its shape. All that remains is to name it.

03_eptelon_generic_task_14_DESC.text: The decision stands before us and history is about to be made. #G Eptelon#! exists now not as a contested prize or a fragile colony but as a unified whole, with all the weight of law and territory and name behind it.

03_eptelon_generic_BUTTON_DETAILS.text: Build a foothold, secure our home region, and unite Eptelon.

03_jaraharum.text: The Dolin of the Great Silver Hold

03_jaraharum_DESCRIPTION.text:
For nearly four hundred years we have been at peace with our #G Kana'i#! neighbors, however, with recent events have complicated our relationship with our goblin allies. Our new king, #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! of the House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective], has his ambitions set on expanding his kingdom, much to the chagrin of many nobles comfortable with the status quo and distrustful of his rule.

Since he was a child, #Y Ivarr#! had always been strange, preferring the few #Y Goblinic#! advisors and caretakers over dwarven ones. His rule was marked by unpopular conscription and tax laws across the kingdom, and he has passed many centralizing reforms that have been seen as tyrannical by many members of the nobility.

Provoked, dissenting nobles have called for a meeting with the most prominent #G Kana'i#! goblin chiefs in hopes of gaining their support for a coup against the tyrant king. Despite how cunning they may think they are, King #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! is not blind to their ambitions, and hopes to curtail their power before they're able to make their move.

While [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] may be a minor player in the current politics of #G Southern Morrigon#!, this may soon change depending on the outcome of this struggle. Whoever is able to gain control of the #Y Great Silver Hold#! may be able to harness the power of a united #G Dragon's Pass#! to expand across the continent!

03_jaraharum_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has established its dominance over the #G Dragon's Pass#!.

03_jaraharum_task_1_DESC.text: Despite his reclusive nature and eccentric personality, the young King of the #Y Dolin#! is acutely aware of the danger he is in. Isolated from all but a few nobles, the King is aware of their plots against them, and to combat their plays for his throne he must ensure he has loyal subjects in key positions to wipe out all threats to his power.

03_jaraharum_task_2_DESC.text: With the threats to his power removed, the King can now use the full force of his kingdom as he pleases. However, in order to reach his true ambitions, King #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! must first control the entire #G Dragon's Pass#!.

03_jaraharum_task_3_DESC.text: Now that we have united the #G Dragon's Pass#!, we must consolidate our hold over our recently conquered subjects and use them to add to our strength. We must make a grand army of #Y Goblins#! and #T Dwarves#! that will be capable of handling the wars to come and enforcing the King's will over the entire realm!

03_jaraharum_task_4_DESC.text: Now that the King has consolidated his realm, he can begin to pursue his magical ambitions. A gifted sorcerer, #Y [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! looks for a place where he can hone his skills, innovate, and discuss magic with other wizards away from prying eyes in the capital.\n\nSurveying his lands, he has come across the perfect candidate for such a place: a small settlement called [GetProvince('(int32)5561').GetName|Y]. With a deposit of soul gems and a small mage community, the King invites gifted talent across the realm and abroad to come to his newly built town and academy.

03_jaraharum_task_5_DESC.text: With all the necessary pieces in place, the King now only needs one more thing before he is able to realize his ambitions; the #Y Shoishoni#! mages of [GetProvince('(int32)4187').GetName|Y]. Their wizards are the only ones in #G Omniluxia#! known to research the rare '#Y Soul Stealing#!' abilities of the #Y Goblins#!. Their work will be instrumental to our young King's plans.

03_jaraharum_task_6_DESC.text: Finally, the #Y #R Tyrant King#!#! now possesses all he needs to achieve his magical ambitions. However, the dark power he hopes to wield require a sacrifice, one that would satisfy the twisted urges of #Y #R Melodias#!#!.

03_jaraharum_task_7_DESC.text: Now possessing the power he so desired, the young King #Y Ivarr 'the Devourer'#!, now has the armies and the power he needs to create an empire emitting from his mountain capital, with him as its #Y Emperor#!. The armies of this #Y Immortal Empire#!, or #Y Ekkdejakheim#!, will march down from its mountains and take its role as the ruler of #Y South Morrigon#!!

03_jaraharum_task_8_DESC.text: With the great meeting approaching soon, the most influential nobles of the realm have gathered to discuss the overthrow of the #Y Tyrant King#!. Everybody knows he is planning something, however the erratic and unknown nature of his plans are what worry the nobility. Alone, even with their personal forces, they cannot hope to stand against the King, however, with some external help they do stand a chance.\n\nThe neighboring #G Kana'i#! are sympathetic to the nobles' cause. If the nobles are able to convince them to help, they should finally have enough manpower to overthrow the #Y Tyrant King#!.

03_jaraharum_task_9_DESC.text: With the King overthrown, the remaining nobles now must decide how to govern this #Y Kingdom without a King#!, and determine their relationship with their #Y Goblin#! allies.

03_jaraharum_task_10_DESC.text: While our #Y Goblinic#! allies can adapt to city life well, their homelands have been historically rural. In order to civilize and develop their lands, our confederacy has decided to invest into a number of promising villages to create '#G Sister Cities#!' that will develop and grow side-by-side.

03_jaraharum_task_11_DESC.text: While our people are prospering, we must ensure that they are safe from the enemies that surround us. While the #Y Droishu Hobgoblins#! of [GetProvince('(int32)4721').GetName|Y] are historically hostile to us and our #Y Goblin#! allies, we both have a common enemy in the belligerent [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T].\n\nIf we were to ally, we could rely on their strength in our future wars.

03_jaraharum_task_12_DESC.text: Historically suspicious of magic, our people have seen its effectiveness by observing our #G Hobgoblin#! allies in battle. Some #Y Shoishoni#! mages are interested in teaching us, however we have no academies for them to teach at.\n\nSurveying our realm, there is one possible candidate that stands out among the rest: the small village of [GetProvince('(int32)5561').GetName|Y]. Its relative proximity to [GetProvince('(int32)5562').GetName|Y] and deposit of #Y Soul Gems#! make it an attractive location for possible scholars. With a little investment, it could become a thriving city filled with magical academies!

03_jaraharum_task_13_DESC.text: With our #Y #G Hobgoblin Allies#!#! by our side, we can confidently march on the #Y #R Sovenerians#!#! and secure the #Y South Gate#!. If we can defeat the Empire's forces in battle, we might be able to claim a slice of #G Kainaxarthos#! for the Confederacy!

03_jaraharum_task_14_DESC.text: Due to the close proximity of our two cultures, many #G Kana'i#! have adopted #Y Dolin#! culture and vice versa. While some elders object to this fraternization, the growing number of educated nobles believe that we can learn something from our #Y Goblinic#! allies.\n\nWe should make further efforts to integrate and understand our allies!

03_jaraharum_task_15_DESC.text: With more and more #G Kana'i#! adopting our customs and culture, it's only natural that their nigh demonic #R Melodian#! faith has begun to adopt elements from the #T Hebric#! faith! By employing a #G Kana'i#! #T High Priest#!, we may be able to encourage these practices, saving our friends from #R Melodias'#! whispers.

03_jaraharum_task_16_DESC.text: Our mountains hold a significant amount of minerals and metals that are craved by all nations across #G Morrigon#!. To use this untapped potential, we should invest into these rural territories.

03_jaraharum_task_17_DESC.text: The #Y Inner Dragon's Pass#! has seen many armies pass through it, be they #Y Goblin#!, #Y Human#!, #Y Dragkhan#!, #G Hobgoblin#!, or even #Y Dwarven#!, with their journeys typically causing destruction to the native inhabitants. Now that we control all of the #Y Inner Dragon's Pass#!, we must make sure that enemy armies cannot enter our lands so easily. Creating defensive fortifications on both the North and South Gates of [GetProvince('(int32)5551').GetName|Y] and [GetProvince('(int32)4460').GetName|Y] would be an excellent way to defend our borders.

03_jaraharum_task_18_DESC.text: The mountainous nature of the #Y Inner Dragon Pass#! means that there is few if any arable land throughout our entire realm. To be able to feed our growing population we must import and store large quantities of food lest we face widespread famine.

03_jaraharum_task_19_DESC.text: Our city is known as '#Y The Great Silver Hold#!' across the #G Dragon's Pass#! and the #Y Dragon Lands#! due to its silver-lined walls and near-endless supply of precious metals that rivals the #Y Sacred Caves#!. However, with our newly developed riches we should invest in making our city a true underground metropolis and the premier trading hub of #G Southern Morrigon#! worthy of the title of '#Y Sørrborr#!'.

me_jaraharum_1_desc.text:
The traitorous nobles proudly burst into the throne room only to be met by laughter. Their personal forces look at each other in confusion as the so-called #R Tyrant King#!'s laughter echoes through the hall.

The now confused nobles demand an answer, only to be met with the axes.

Hours pass and nobles concerned with the plot's success as well as various loyal subjects of the king wait impatiently outside of his throne room, with those who cannot take the suspense frantically searching for a way to enter the great chamber. Finally, after what seemed like days to some, [GetCharacter('(int32)160').GetName|Y] emerges from his throne room he prepares to orate as a crowd of curious servants, worried noblemen, and eager soldiers await his words.

But those words never come.

The triumphant #R Tyrant King#! simply raises one hand, facing his palm towards the crowd, a motion that declares his acquisition of absolute control over the room. Holding the pose for what seems like an eternity, the King steps aside to softly issue a series of commands to his #G Marshal#!. Thus, began the #R #E Great Purge#!#!.

me_jaraharum_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_2_desc.text:
The #Y Goblin chiefs#! arrive in awe of the size of the legendary #Y Mountain Hold#!, and are greeted by the King with great splendor. They dine in a great hall in the palace and discuss pleasantries and stories across the table. Once everyone has had their fill as the guests awkwardly attempt to engage in conversation with the silent sovereign. His standoffish behavior insults many of the proud chiefs, who in turn refuse to converse.

Once the embers of any conversation pitter out, [GetCharacter('(int32)160').GetName|Y] calls over an attendant, softly issuing them a command. The confused chieftains look in shock and anger as the #R King's Guard#! outnumbers and surrounds the dinner table. All night the King has used a #Y Goblin#! interpreter to speak with his guests, but now the King makes an announcement in #B Oli'le Kana#!:

'The #G Treaty of Two Friends#! has defined our relationship with you #G Kana'i#! for centuries, protecting us both from outsiders and strengthening the bond between our two peoples. However, with new, stronger enemies rising around us, this archaic document is now more of a hindrance to our potential than a guarantor of peace.'

'My #Y Kingdom#! shall end all infighting, intrigue, and selfish desires, a land where I will rule supreme and act as judge and jury, destroying those who have wronged me and rewarding those loyal to me.'

'My #T Dwarves#! are strong, but we are outnumbered in this battle, we will need your strength whether you lend it to me willingly or not.'

The King procures a document, a copy of the ancient treaty itself. After watching as the King rips the copy and tosses it into a nearby fireplace, the chiefs leave discuss amongst themselves.

me_jaraharum_2.a.text: Let us hope they accept the King's mercy

me_jaraharum_2_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_3_title.text: The Tyrant King Demands Our Subjugation

me_jaraharum_3_desc.text:
The #G Kana'i#! chieftains argue many hours over a unified response to the king's aggression, however their tribal, clan, and social divisions make agreement on anything nigh impossible. After many hours of discussion, the chiefs return home to their respective tribes, holding a large meeting where they ask the clan chiefs and elders for their wisdom.

The young warriors are eager to prove their worth in battle, and distinguished war leaders yearn to ride their chariots into battle against the #Y Dolin#!!

However, the elders argue against this hot-headed approach, warning that the tribe might lose everything if the armies of the King defeat us in battle.

In the end, the decision is up to the Chief.

me_jaraharum_3_tooltip.a.text: #R We will become subjects of the King!#!

me_jaraharum_3_tooltip.b.text: #G We will fight against the Tyrant King!#!

me_jaraharum_4_desc.text:
With #Y Dolin#! and #G Kana'i#! soldiers now fighting together under [GetCountry('SV0').GetName|T], [GetCharacter('(int32)160').GetName|Y] can now prepare for his invasions of the lands of the #T Hobgoblins#!.

Vicious fighters, the various #G Hobgoblin#! tribes have different specialities that would have been easy to exploit if they were divided, however the powerful [GetCountry('HOB').GetName|T] horde now controls the entire might of the #Y Droitrai#!.

Eager #G Kana'i#! war leaders have petitioned the King to invest into chariots for the #Y Goblinic#! contingents of the army, as well as relying more on them as their wave tactics have proven effective against #G Hobgoblin#! raiders in the past.

However, #Y Dwarven#! commanders urge the kind to stick to tried and true methods: emphasized use of dwarven heavy infantry and siege tactics. They argue that our tight formations and stronger armor will overpower the loosely coordinated #Y Driotrai#!, who will flee to neighboring forts where our forces can starve them out.

Both doctrines have their benefit, however one must be favored over the other.

me_jaraharum_4_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_5_desc.text: Once a small settlement, the #Y Wizard City of#! [GetProvince('(int32)5562').GetName|Y] now boasts a small community of #Y Dwarven#! apprentices, #G Hobgoblin#! mages, and various merchants, shopkeepers, craftsmen and more!\n\nWhile this development is impressive, what is important to [GetCharacter('(int32)160').GetName|Y] is that he now has a space to conduct his research, clearing a room in the #Y Magic Academy#! for himself where he spends hours pouring over texts and grilling more experienced mages for their knowledge.

me_jaraharum_5.a.text: Make a space for my work!

me_jaraharum_5_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_5$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_6_desc.text: The capture of [GetProvince('(int32)4187').GetName|Y] is a monumental victory for the King! While his forces and people celebrate the wealth incoming from his new territories, the King is overjoyed when his generals present him with the greatest prize: tomes.

me_jaraharum_6_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_7_desc.text:
In the age of #Y King Calthorr Hrunn#!, his majesty assigned his firstborn a #G Kana'i#! goblin maid. Losing his mother at a young age, this maid served as a motherly figure for the young heir, as his father mourned the loss of his queen during his formative years. To put him to sleep, she would secretly share with him stories of the #Y #R Old Faith#!#!. 

The prince loved these grand tales of the feats of #G Wishtheon#! and jealous actions of the #Y Mother Earth#! who cursed the goblins and banished them to the caverns of the world. The salvation of their people at the hands of #Y #R Melodias#!#!, who took pity on them and gifted them with the ability to absorb #Y man'a#!, or life energy. He especially adored stories of great heroes, men whose #Y man'a#! allowed them to face #G Dragons#!, #T Hobgoblins#!, and even hordes of the #Y #R Kumama#!#!, great scaled beings of immense strength.

As the prince grew up, he would attempt to gather a retinue of #G Kana'i#! goblins like his maid to learn more about their culture and their abilities, entranced by the idea of a 'soul' and their customs. This caused rumors to spread around the court, and soon the King forced his heir to replace his retinue with one of #Y Silver Dwarves#!. However, the young King never really fit into #Y Dolin#! society, further isolating himself and amassing tomes on #Y Goblinic#! physiology and beliefs, until his ascension to the throne.

...

A year has passed since the king left his queen in charge of the country's affairs, and a month has passed since the queen has gone to see the King, hoping to convince him to return lest his enemies plan to seize his throne.

However, to the despair of those who plotted against him, the King has sent word that he would be returning to his castle, emboldening his loyalists to seize them and hold them prisoner.

At last the King returns. Despite their relief, those who support him find the presence of their liege unnerving.

He seems colder, calculating his every move, with his eyes seemingly peering into their souls.

Looking around, the nobles don't see the Queen alongside him, but none dare bring up such a topic to the King. Instead, they greet their overlord with smiles, and attempt to affirm their loyalty by presenting their captives to him.

The prisoners look up in defiance, expecting to die as martyrs against the King's axe. Looking up, they are met with a cruel smile and a small dagger.

Their confusion turns to horror as the king digs his knife into the first prisoner.

He screams as the King plunges his hand deep into his chest, only removing it to reveal his gruesome prize: #Y #R his heart#!#!.

Still pumping, the king greedily scarfs down his disgusting viand as all in his court look on in horror.

Suddenly, the King falls unconscious, unmoving. Nobody moves.

Those who heaved a quick sigh of relief reclaim their terror as he begins to rise, laughing like a maniac.

Every movement he makes seems to give him strength, his muscles seem to be bursting with mana and power, vitality returns to his beard, and his voice grows deafeningly louder. The King continues his feast.

Thus, begins the legend of the #Y #R Immortal King#!#!, the #Y #R Soul Eater#!#!.

me_jaraharum_7_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_8_desc.text: #R #E The Devourer#!#! has become a name akin to #R #E Melodias#!#! amongst the residents of #G Morrigon#!, as tales of his cruel conquests and unholy abilities have spread with refugees to the north.\n\nRuling from the impenetrable #Y Mountain Hold#!, the #Y Immortal King#! of [GetCountry('SV0').GetName|T] is the undisputed ruler of #G Southern Morrigon#!. With his hordes growing hungry for more plunder and his personal appetite unsatiated, his greedy eyes now look north, towards the wealthy kingdoms of #Y Northern Morrigon#!!

me_jaraharum_8_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_7$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_9_desc.text: While we thought few would respond to our cry to help, messengers have arrived to the key nobles involved in the plot proving us wrong.\n\nWorried about the #R Tyrant King#!'s rhetoric towards their people and seeking allies against the encroaching empire surrounding them, many #G Kana'i#! Chiefs and War Leaders have pledged their warriors to our cause, promising to meet outside the city within the month!

me_jaraharum_9_tooltip.text: #Y The Chiefs will soon arrive to begin the Coup!#!

me_jaraharum_10_desc.text:
With the last of the chiefs arriving at the meeting location, a small council is formed made up of rebellious nobles, influential ministers, #G Kana'i#! Cheiftains, #Y Goblinic#! War Leaders, and #Y Dwarven#! captains, with the objective of defining a plan to take down the #R Tyrant King#!.

The captains lay forth a plan to ambush the royalist forces by sending in spies to open the gates to the capital. Many #G Kana'i#! cheiftains and war leaders mumur in agreement and raise their weapons in approval of this plan, hoping to face the mighty palace guards and prove their worth in battle.

When the noise dies down, the nobles and ministers, somewhat squeamish at the thought of mass bloodshed and trying to protect their holdings, instead suggest that a small party of individuals assemble and capture the #R Tyrant King#! in his sleep. Using their connections and status, they promise they can help the party move around the palace undetected.

The #G Kana'i#! seem to disapprove of this plan, but a few warriors seem eager to prove their bravery and join this party, while the captains state that their preparations are more fool-proof than a nobleman's connections.

After hours of heated debate, a plan is finally decided upon:

me_jaraharum_10.a.text: Our forces will take the Capital by surprise!

me_jaraharum_10_tooltip.a.text: #Y The Captains will attempt to execute a surprise attack to capture the capital!#!

me_jaraharum_10_tooltip.b.text: #Y The Nobles will assemble and attempt to assist a small party to capture the King!#!

me_jaraharum_11_desc.text:
Both #Y Dwarven#! and #Y Goblin#! warriors alike cry out in victory across the newly captured capital! Victory belongs to the #Y War Council#!!

The #R Tyrant King#!'s forces were completely taken by surprise and slaughtered by our warriors, with the King himself brought to receive justice at the hands of the council. Deemed guilty of conspiring against the nobles of the realm as well as earning the ire of the people and the allied #G Kana'i#! Cheiftains, the diposed despot is sentenced to banishment. Leaving the caverns of the #Y Inner Dragon's Pass#! forever with only a few belongings, it is said that he has traveled back to the lands of the #Y Anvindr#!.

However, not all is well in our new capital, as #Y Goblin#! and #Y Dwarven#! warriors alike have stooped to pillaging our city, killing civilains and looting homes. While our council swiftly dealt with these marauders, the damage has already been done. We can only try to recompense the victims of the slaughter.

me_jaraharum_11.a.text: Victory always comes at a cost

me_jaraharum_11_tooltip.text: #Y We have taken the capital and exiled the #R Tyrant King#!, but must provide relief to pillaged families.#!

me_jaraharum_12_desc.text:
The crowds initial cheers die down as the party makes it's way to the #Y War Council#!. By the look of them it's obvious why: the #R Tyrant King#! is not in their captivity.

It seems that upon the expedition's departure, one of the nobles got cold feet and alerted the King of the plot. Knowing his weakened position, the King fled the palace with as many loyal servants, nobles, and soldiers as he could. When the expedition finally arrived they were greeted with an empty room and a panicked city.

Suddenly, messengers burst into the tent, bringing urgent news of the #R Tyrant King#!. The #Y War Council#! listens intently as the young man recounts rumors of how the King has been gathering loyal subjects across the more rural areas of the realm to help him reclaim his throne from the traitorous nobles.

Scouts corroborate the young messenger's information, and the #Y War Council#! prepares for battle with the final forces of the deposed king!

me_jaraharum_12_tooltip.text: #R The #E Tyrant King#! will rise up to reclaim his throne!#!

me_jaraharum_13_desc.text:
With the realm pacified but still unstable, the various nobles of the #Y Kingdom#! have decided to convene once more and discuss the creation of a new government.

Monarchists, anti-monarchists, republicanists, and everyone in between argue over the future of the government for months, however, their discussion is interrupted by the arrival of various #G Kana'i#! Chiefs.

After returning home from the battle, the #G Kana'i#! returned to infighting over minor disagreements, only barely able to fend off foreign raids with help from our forces. Seeing the disunity of their people and remembering the great buildings and wealth of the #Y Dolin#! they witnessed in [GetProvince('(int32)5562').GetName|Y], various Chieftains gathered together to discuss a permanent peace.

They propose a union between the #G Kana'i#! tribes and the #Y Dolin#! #Y Kingdom#!, a sort of Confederacy where the #Y Kingdom#! and the independent tribes will have autonomy to handle their domestic matters while a central council of chiefs and nobles serve to represent their interests in foreign affairs as well as act to maintain peace between the various states in the federation. They believe the longer-lived and wealthier #Y Dolin#! could help serve as architects of such a state.

Discussion following the proposal is fierce, with talks almost breaking down several times. Despite all these setbacks, a formal constitution, called the #Y Sørrskragr#! or #Y Kanawaike#! was written and accepted by all chiefs and nobles. Defining their government, powers and legislature, the parchment now just requires the signatures of all delegates at the meeting and an official name of the Confederation.

The #G Kana'i#! propose a compromise, stating that since the capital of the federation should be in [GetProvince('(int32)5562').GetName|Y] while the name should be in their tongue. They promise that the name they have chosen is significant to their past, as it continues the legacy of a great Confederation of their past.

The #T Dwarves#! argue that since their kingdom is the most wealthy and influential constituent of the Confederacy, they should receive both the rights to the capital and the name.

After much debate, the delegates make an agreement and sign their names, founding the Federation of:

me_jaraharum_14_desc.text:
#Y Council#!! The #Y Sister City#! decrees have been successful! Our #Y Goblinic#! subjects have seen large urban centers rise throughout their lands, elevating them out of poverty and savagery, putting them on track to be economic equals to the #Y Mountain Hold#!!

Tribesmen once forced to hunt dangerous cavernous fauna and scrounge for mushrooms now purchase meat at one of the city's bazaars! Craftsmen once forced to spend hours in crude forges making bronze speartips now made iron armor in their city's blacksmith guild. The chiefs are pleased with their newfound wealth, with many directing their kinsmen into nearby cities or establishing estates in the #Y Dolin#! style!

Thanks to the council's guidance, our people now thrive!

me_jaraharum_14.a.text: Our federation is only as strong as its weakest link

me_jaraharum_14_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_15_desc.text:
#Y Council#!! Word has arrived from our #G Hobgoblin#! allies!

Seeing a weakened [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T] as beneficial for its own interests, they have sent us some auxiliaries to help us in our fight against the #R Sovenerians#!!

From the skilled #Y Jishani#! and #Y Ahualtzi#! hill fighters to the skilled #Y Urhuk#! horsemen, this fearsome company of men will surely guarantee victory against our #R Sovenerian#! enemies!

me_jaraharum_15_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_11$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_16_desc.text:
Once a small rural town, the new #Y Wizard City of [GetProvince('(int32)5561').GetName|Y]#! has been completely transformed over the last few months.

Incoming #Y Shoishoni#! mages have attracted many interested pupils to seek their knowledge. Much of the local populace slowly grow accustomed to the often helpful wizards, releasing some of their deep-rooted suspicion of magic and working with the magicians to fill markets with food and materials that help support this burgeoning magical community.

The crown jewel of this underground city is the #Y Mage Academy of Jorrmundabi#!, where young pupils and older mages alike gather to discuss, research, and teach magic and as well as other more academic subjects. The incoming #Y Shoishoni#! in particular are fascinated with the goblins' ability to absorb mana through the consumption of hearts, a topic they prioritize in their research.

me_jaraharum_16_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_12$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_17_desc.text: As our warriors return home, it is clear to all who see their caravans that the power dynamic between us and the #R Dragkhans#! has changed irreversibly! Once enslaving our kinsmen, #Y Dwarven#! and #Y Goblin#! alike, it is now them who find themselves in cages, sold to the highest bidder in #Y our#! slave markets!\n\nHaving their independent spirit thoroughly broken, it will be some time before the #R Dragkhan#! tribes under our control muster enough courage to defy our rule. In the meantime, let us enjoy the spoils of our conquest!

me_jaraharum_17_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_13$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_18_desc.text:
While many aspects of #Y Dolin#! culture are now prevalent in #G Kana'i#! society, a recent trend as emerged amongst the younger members of the #Y Dolin#! nobility: the popularity of #G Kana'i#! cloaks.

Typically made of the pelt of a rare animal, these cloaks are expensive to create and often only worn by chiefs or men of high status. Forgoing traditional #Y Dolin#! felt cloaks, many young nobles have begun to associate the expensive commodities with status and nobility, much like their #G Kana'i#! compatriots.

This phenomena sparked an interest in the #G Kana'i#! tongue and history for many young historians which has seen the introduction of new loanwords into Srrøskku, the language of the #Y Silver Dwarves#!.

Further interest into #G Kana'i#! culture has elevated their status to equals for many #Y Dolin#!, who interact with the many #Y Goblinic#! workers, smiths, farmers, nobles, servants, and craftsmen now found in the capital!

me_jaraharum_18.a.text: I'm more of a cape guy, but the pelt looks nice?

me_jaraharum_18_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_14$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_19_desc.text:
