Our new #G Kana'i#! #T High Priest#!, a man educated in the #T Hebric#! faith, has been... somewhat successful in his endeavors to convert his compatriots to the true faith.

#T Hebric#! remains a primarily dwarven faith, and a divided one at that, due to its traditions of ancestor worship and its emphasis on the #T Dwarves#! being the chosen people. However, there are a few instances of non-dwarven converts who have found its ancestor worship comforting, praying to great heroes in their past.

Our dear #T High Priest#! has managed a similar feat. Many of his followers now worship the #Y #Y Great Peacemaker#!#!, a hero of the #G Kana'i#! people from the days of #Y Dolln#! himself! While it's not necessarily #T Hebric#! as we understand it, this #Y Syncretic Faith#! is certainly much better than their traditional #R #E Melodian#!#! worship.

me_jaraharum_19.a.text: As long as they're worshipping the ancestors I suppose?

me_jaraharum_19_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_15$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_20_desc.text: The mines flourish alongside our trade! Serfs and captured slaves alike work tirelessly to build our economy from the precious minerals that are now revealed to us through the labor of our subjects!\n\nTraders wide and far now arrive at our cities and our markets to buy our goods. Craftsmen and blacksmiths hammer away at armor, tools, weaponry, and more made from the wealth provided to us from these new mines!

me_jaraharum_20_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_16$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_21_desc.text: Once we were simply another passage to enemy territory, now as we stand united against a common enemy, nobody will be able to stop us! With both gates fortified, any invader seeking to pass through the #Y Inner Dragon's Pass#! will be met with twelve meters of #Y Dwarven#! concrete and a flurry of arrows descending upon them!

me_jaraharum_21.a.text: How happy are those whose walls already rise!

me_jaraharum_21_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_17$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_22_desc.text: With our realm on the brink of starvation, the incoming food supplies seem like a gift from the ancestors to our subjects!\n\nFestivals are once again held in [GetProvince('(int32)5562').GetName|Y], where the happy attendants are able to dance and drink to their hearts' content once more!

me_jaraharum_22_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_18$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jaraharum_23_desc.text: #Y The Mountain Hold#!, as outsiders call it, is a massive complex of stone houses, markets, and palaces. Our new expansions have added several new housing and market districts, making is a central hub to commerce in the #Y Inner Dragon's Pass#!.\n\nAny and all adventurers that wander through our caverns now make a stop at our adventurer guild halls, and our streets are filled with #Y Dolin#! and #G Kana'i#! living side-by-side. Ours is truly what one would call a #Y Sørrborr#!, or one of the #Y Great Cities#! of the #Y Silver Dwarven#! world, a title bestowed to only a handful of cities. Those that gaze upon our lit streets and temple complexes declare it the greatest in the world, and those who do not are envious of its glory!

me_jaraharum_23_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jaraharum_task_19$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_jarenam1_DESCRIPTION.text:
Despite the impressive conquests of the young #T Jarenam the Formidable Dragon#!, his relatively early death has left his empire unstable. As his generals and tribal heads fought over control of the empire, the #Y Phanicians#!, #Y Baetepians#!, and #Y Etaredicans#! slipped away from the empire's grasp, with many thinking this was the end. However, the ascendant #G House of Totrazi#! managed to consolidate their hold over the throne and the empire through guile, cunning, assasination, and brute force.

 However, now the head of the #Y Totraz#!, [GetCharacter('(int32)18').GetName|Y] presides over an empire of discontented subjects from the various cultures and religions present in his empire to scheming nobles planning to take his throne. Through his guidance alone the [GetCountry('JRE').GetRuler.GetName|Y] shall either ascend once again, or crumble into pieces.

03_jarenam1_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has restored #Y Jarenam#!'s empire.

03_jarenam1_task_1_DESC.text: Although #G Qhagan#! [GetCharacter('(int32)18').GetName|Y] has made efforts to unite his fractured empire, notably by marrying an #Y Eteradican#! noblewoman, [GetCharacter('(int32)19').GetName|Y], his many diverse subjects still chafe under his rule.\n\nAsking for advice, his generals and tribal heads suggest uniting them against a common enemy. Calling upon his nobles to supply him with #G Jazari#! horsemen, the mighty #R Qhagan#! prepares to raise a great host to fight his enemies!

03_jarenam1_task_2_DESC.text: Despite all odds our #G Qhagan#! has managed to subjugate the hordes of the #Y Etaredicans#! and has brought stability to #R Jarenam's Empire#!!\n\n With his grip on the empire firm, the #G Qhagan#! can now work on truly strengthening his hold on #T Western Luxterra#!!

03_jarenam1_task_3_DESC.text: Our military strength relies on horses, and we must take steps in order to ensure that we remain a top-tier power when it comes to fielding armies.

03_jarenam1_task_4_DESC.text: My [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], it has been suggested that we build more #Y Marketplaces#! in [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G] - the amount of trade we do with slaves could be greatly expanded.

03_jarenam1_task_5_DESC.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] does not wish for our Empire to be a military dictatorship devoid of culture, but a beacon of #T Dragkhanic#! civilization that surpasses all that came before us. Let us do what we can to attract master craftsmen to our capital city in order to make this dream a reality.

03_jarenam1_task_6_DESC.text: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle|Y] has decided to improve the infrastructure of the capital by building a large commercial district, one that will supply the tradesmen of the city with the raw goods they need to build. On top of this, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|T] has also called for daily wine and bread to be distributed to the people as a gesture of good will from the #G House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective]#!.

03_jarenam1_task_7_DESC.text: As a nation, we are blessed with some of the finest farmland within all of #Y Luxterra#!. Let us reap #G Anona#!'s bounty by building farms across our realm, so that the people might always have bread, meat and cheese.

03_jarenam1_task_8_DESC.text: The stallions that are found in [GetProvince('(int32)4226').GetName|Y] are exceptionally sturdy creatures, and it has been suggested by our farmers that we breed them with the fast steppe horses from [GetProvince('(int32)4628').GetName|Y].

03_jarenam1_task_9_DESC.text: Not only must we dominate the lands of #G Luxterra#!, but we must be sure to be the masters of the #Y Intergealian Sea#! as well. But we cannot entrust such a vital task to anyone - we will need a strong skilled to lead our fleets.

03_jarenam1_task_10_DESC.text: Our military commanders in [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|Y] have approached [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] with a curious proposition; if we can pay the upfront costs, they will take the strongest slaves living within the capital and train them as warriors.

03_jqf_DESCRIPTION.text: Although the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T] has graciously granted the refugees from the fallen city of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G] sanctuary, an incident at the royal court in [GetCountry('SOV').GetCapital.GetName|G] would prove to be the prelude to a #T Dragkhanic#! #Y Civil War#! - one that will have ramifications for all of #G Omniluxia#!.

03_jqf_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] successfully challenges [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetName|Y] for control of the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T] before launching an invasion of the western coast of #G Luxterra#!.

03_jqf_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: Zemmairthia Jarenam, I shall reclaim you...

03_jqf_task_1_DESC.text: In an effort to further integrate [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] into the royal court at [GetProvince('(int32)4864').GetName|G], the newly-crowned [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName|G] has been asked to marry a princess from the [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective] House.\n\n#Y This task will be#! #R bypassed#! #Y if our#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle|T] #Y is married.#!

03_jqf_task_2_DESC.text: After the shameful behavior of the [GetCountry('SOV').GetRulerTitle] during the wedding ceremony at [GetProvince('(int32)4864').GetName|G], many angry noblemen are sending secret messages of support to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y].

03_jqf_task_3_DESC.text: Now that [GetProvince('(int32)4864').GetName|G] has fallen to the Qhaganate forces and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has satisfied [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] honor, our army can prepare for the invasion of #G Luxterra#!. The triumphant [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] shall not rest until [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G] has been retaken!

03_jqf_task_4_DESC.text: There are many mercenaries living within the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T] that would slit their brother's throat for a gold coin, and these are exactly the type of sellswords that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] will need for the work that lies ahead.

03_jqf_task_5_DESC.text: The time has come for us to challenge [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetName|Y] for power - as the true [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective], we cannot allow an unworthy #Y Emperor#! to rule over [GetProvince('(int32)4864').GetName|G].

03_jqf_task_6_DESC.text: The triumphant armies of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] have laid low all challengers to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] power, and a new era is proclaimed - all hail the #Y Dragkhanic Empire#!!

me_jqf_1_desc.text:
After many anxious weeks of correspondence between [GetCountry('SOV').GetCapital.GetName|G] and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], the day of the proposed marriage between [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] and his bride, [SCOPE.sCharacter('soventeir_princess').GetName|Y], is finally at hand.

The [GetCountry('SOV').GetRulerTitle] insisted on being the one to give away [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetHerHis] niece, [SCOPE.sCharacter('soventeir_princess').GetFirstName|Y], but unfortunately for all involved, [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetName|Y] began celebrating early in the day and was very inebriated during the ceremony. Once the rites were completed and the feasting began, [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] continued to drink unmixed Hazalar wine, and as the strong liquor began to do its work, the topic at dinner turned towards uncomfortable things, like the recent #Y Fall of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName]#!.

Reaching for a haunch of roasted lamb, the [GetCountry('SOV').GetRulerTitle] stifled a belch and began chuckling. 'I can't help but notice that you have done quite well for yourself, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], despite living a life defined by failures.' Rudely pointing towards [SCOPE.sCharacter('soventeir_princess').GetFirstName|Y] with a silver fork, [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] laughed out loud. 'A beautiful princess from the Royal House and the city of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName|G] to rule over as a personal fief...not too bad, young man. If your #Y Jarenam#! kinsmen knew that such hospitality awaited them in the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T], then I would half-expect to see a thousand ships filled with cowards sailing over the horizon.'

A deadly silence fell at the dinner table, interrupted only the droning strings and clanging cymbals of the court musicians. Rising to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] feet, face choked with rage and feeling the eyes of all present upon [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] half-bowed, hand on the hilt of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] sword.

me_jqf_1.a.text: Forgive me, but it is time for me to leave, your Majesty...

me_jqf_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jqf_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jqf_2_desc.text:
Over the last few weeks, many minor nobles and their retinues have privately approached [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] to share their grievances against [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetName|Y].

Many of these elites were present at the royal wedding at [GetCountry('SOV').GetCapital.GetName|G] at witnessed the boorish behavior of the [GetCountry('SOV').GetRulerTitle], which apparently was the last straw for many of them. Although such treasonous conversations are punishable by death, many of these disgruntled noblemen have promised to support [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] militarily if he seeks to punish [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], and a few cohorts of troops have quietly made their way to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] in preparation for the next move.

Weapons and gold have been smuggled into [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] over the last few weeks, and everyone is waiting for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] to give the word...

me_jqf_2.a.text: My honor demands retribution...and I shall have my revenge

me_jqf_2_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jqf_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jqf_3_desc.text: When the treacherous [GetCountry('AKK').GetAdjective] #T Dwarves#! drove our people from the city of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G], they thought their victory over the [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|T] was complete.\n\nLittle did they know that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] was destined to not only topple the corrupt ruler of the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T], but that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] would return at the head of an invading army. Now, as the warships of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] set sail for #G Luxterra#!, the #Y Invasion of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName]#! has begun.

me_jqf_3.a.text: I shall not rest until I have reclaimed my birthright!

me_jqf_3_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jqf_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jqf_4_desc.text: Now that a #Y Mercenary Company#! has been employed by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], the city of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName|G] is on edge, as many wonder for what purpose the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has hired sellswords.\n\nIt has been reported to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] that [GetCountry('SOV').GetAdjective] spies have taken note of these developments and are sending reports back to [GetCountry('SOV').GetCapital.GetName|G], but [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] does not seem bothered by this.

me_jqf_4.a.text: The appointed hour is almost at hand...

me_jqf_4_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jqf_task_4$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jqf_5_desc.text: The hour of war is at hand! Now that the clandestine preparations have been completed, the rebellious armies of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] have launched attacks against the [GetCountry('SOV').GetAdjective] border outposts, killing garrisoned troops and setting villages to the torch. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has vowed to seize the capital of [GetProvince('(int32)4864').GetName|G] or to die in the attempt.\n\nThroughout [GetProvince('(int32)5067').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G], the allies of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] have declared for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] and joined our cause. As the #T Dragkhanic#! levies march out from the gates of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName|G], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] rides at the front of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] army, grimly determined to meet whatever fate awaits [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim].

me_jqf_5.a.text: The dice are thrown...may Talona grant us victory

me_jqf_5_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jqf_task_5$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_jqf_6_desc.text:
After many years of desperate fighting that was fueled by pure ambition and hatred, the armies of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] have achieved total victory over the enemies of the newly-proclaimed [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T].

In a stunning series of events, the bold [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] not only avenged [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim]self against the foolish [GetCountry('SOV').GetAdjective] #Y Emperor#!, but was able to raise an armada that reconquered [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G] - immortal accomplishments that shall be celebrated by the #T Dragkhanic#! people until the end of days.

Now that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has conquered an Empire that spans two continents, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] must decide where the capital will be - should the seat of power remain in #G Morrigon#! or should it return home to the shores of #G Luxterra#!?

me_jqf_6.a.text: [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName] has always been our true home

me_jqf_6.b.text: We shall move our capital to [GetProvince('(int32)4864').GetName]

me_jqf_6_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jqf_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg_DESCRIPTION.text:
In the years following the #Y Great Collapse#!, the lands of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetCulture.GetName|Y] suffered greatly, with ruinous tsunamis destroying much of the civilizations of the #Y Cental Omniluxian Sea#!. The mighty #Y Snakefolk#! that had once ruled over a massive Empire now found their strength reduced to two cities; [GetProvince('(int32)5607').GetName|G] on the southern island of #G Kraklaz#! and [GetProvince('(int32)5694').GetName|G] far to the northwest.

And yet life must go on. But as the battered #Y Ular-Pria#! began to slowly rebuild the shattered pieces of their lives, an unscrupulous warlord on the island of #G Kraklaz#! conquered his broken kinsmen during their weakest hour and formed what is now known as the [GetCountry('UPJ').GetName|T] - a tyrannical monarchy ruled by [GetCountry('UPJ').GetRuler.GetName|Y] that seeks to enslave all other #Y Snakefolk#!. Those fortunate enough to escape the growing power of the Euryaleans have naturally gone to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], and the two cities stand in opposition to each other.

The pre-Collapse prophecies of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] sing of a time 'when there shall be two and then there shall be one', and the priestesses of [GetDeityDefinition('omen_vensyn').GetName|Y] teach that this speaks of a great war between the last two cities of the #Y Ular-Pria#!; either [GetProvince('(int32)5607').GetName|G] or [GetProvince('(int32)5694').GetName|G] will destroy the other. Woe unto those that live to see such prophecies fulfilled!

03_mignadg_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] builds a thalassocracy that defeats the perfidious forces of the [GetCountry('UPJ').GetName|T] and unites the #Y Ular-Pria#! under one banner.

03_mignadg_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: The Empire of the Ular-Pria shall be reborn!

03_mignadg_task_1_DESC.text: The nearby isles that comprise the #G Austropetolian Archipelago#! would stand a better chance against #T Euryalean#! armies if we were united, and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] believes that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] can persuade our kin to submit to our rule.\n\n#Y Conquering the nearby islands will bypass this mission.#!

03_mignadg_task_2_DESC.text: The beating heart of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] is the ancestral home of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective] family and is the pride and joy of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], who has vowed to leave [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] mark on the city. The important harbor district has been targeted for expansion, as the need for a navy to counter the might of [GetCountry('UPJ').GetName|T] is dire.

03_mignadg_task_3_DESC.text: The time has come for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] to make good on the promises that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] has made - we must stand against the growing tyrrany of the [GetCountry('UPJ').GetName|T] and stake our claims throughout the #G Austropetolian Archipelago#!.

03_mignadg_task_4_DESC.text: Word is spreading throughout nearby #G Morrigon#! and #G Eptelon#! of the brutal struggles between [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] and [GetCountry('UPJ').GetRuler.GetName|Y] to carve out their spheres of influence throughout the #G Austropetolian Archipelago#!.\n\n#Y 'The War of the Snakes'#!, as it has come to be known abroad, is said to be one of the bloodiest and most savage wars ever fought amongst the #Y Ular-Pria#!.

03_mignadg_task_5_DESC.text: After a difficult war with our enemies, the hour of retribution is at hand and our soldiers have made a request that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has granted them; they can completely sack the city of [GetProvince('(int32)5607').GetName|G].

03_mignadg_task_6_DESC.text: The farmlands of nearby [GetProvince('(int32)5692').GetName|G] could provide even more vegetables @vegetables! than they currently do, but there is one prickly problem; the pirates that have unofficial control of the nearby port and its valuable hinterlands.\n\nAnd yet [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has proposed a solution; once the farmlands have been built in #G Mohr#!, then our engineers will construct a new district within for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] for the displaced pirates to make their homes.

03_mignadg_task_7_DESC.text: The jungles of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] have an extensive cave network underground, running deep into the island where no #Y Ular-Pria#! has dared to delve.\n\nAnd yet these dangerous subterranean grottoes are the source of the diamonds @gems! that have brought the city its wealth, and without them, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] would not be able to fund its construction schemes.

03_mignadg_task_8_DESC.text: The tiny islet of [GetProvince('(int32)5697').GetName|G] would serve as an excellent sister-port to the busy site of [GetProvince('(int32)5694').GetName|G], which has become practically overwhelmed due to the high volume of traffic it receives.

03_mignadg_task_9_DESC.text: In our wars against the [GetCountry('UPJ').GetRuler.GetName|Y], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] was disappointed to see many #Y Nagarajian#! mercenaries serving in the auxiliary forces of the tyrants ruling [GetProvince('(int32)5607').GetName|G]. In an effort to punish the cowardly northerners for contributing to our enemies, it has been decided that their islands must be taken!

03_mignadg_task_10_DESC.text: The prophecies have come true - a mighty King has unified the scattered tribes of the #G Austropetolian islands#! into an Empire that will reclaim the long-lost glory of the #Y Snakefolk#!! All hail [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] and all hail #Y 'The Empire of the Ular-Pria'#!!

03_mignadg_task_11_DESC.text: On the outskirts of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], there are jungles that are filled with valuable sugarcane @sugar! that we should consider exporting.\n\nWhen we have enough funds to do so, we should prioritize building vast latifundia for our serfs. Sugar is a rarity in foreign markets and yet we have it in abundance - we should capitalize upon this.

03_mignadg_task_12_DESC.text: Thanks to our steady exports of silk @silk! and sugar @sugar!, we can afford to build roads that will connect [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] to the plantations and ports in its hinterlands. There will be some expenditure involved, but it will be well worth the investment.

03_mignadg_task_13_DESC.text: Although many foreign merchants will not sail deep within the #G Austropetolian Archipelago#!, they will overcome their natural fear of the #Y Ular-Pria#! and travel to the majestic market built at the city of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].

me_mignadg_1_desc.text: After many weeks of a fierce diplomatic campaign, the nearby islands of [GetCountry('UP3').GetName|T], [GetCountry('UP5').GetName|T] and [GetCountry('UP6').GetName|T] have all submitted to the authority of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G]. Our grand city casts long shadows over our nearby kinsmen, who desperately hope to emulate our ways for themselves, and rather than wage fruitless wars of aggression against each other, it has been decided that it is in everyone's interest that they recognize [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] as the supreme authority of a new confederacy, one led by the mighty nation of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T].\n\nThe three Tribal Chiefs traveled to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] in order to personally submit to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], who commanded that four goblets of #Y Eptelonian#! wine be brought before the gathered assembly.

me_mignadg_1.a.text: I drink to your health, and praise the gods for your wisdom

me_mignadg_1.b.text: I propose that the world know us by a new name...

me_mignadg_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_2_desc.text: It has been difficult work finding the resources to fund the recently-completed #Y Military Harbor#! that was built at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], but somehow, our chief architects were able to finish the bold designs that were suggested by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y].\n\nAfter a long period of construction, our existing port district has been doubled in size, with plenty of room for our warships. The best sailors within all of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] are to be found within our fair city now, and our ships that sail from our harbor are filled with experienced boathands.

me_mignadg_2.a.text: The gods remember the Ular-Pria and give us their blessing

me_mignadg_2_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_3_desc.text: With our fleet at a respectable size, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] feels the time is ripe to challenge the dominance of the [GetCountry('UPJ').GetName|T] in their own backyard - the calm waters of the #G Austropetolian Archipelago#!.\n\nFrom the glorious city of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], the light of the islands, we shall usher forth a new era, one where the tyrannical #T Euryalid Kingdom#! has been punished for the sins against the #Y Ular-Pria#!.

me_mignadg_3.a.text: The hour of glory is at hand...I pray we are ready

me_mignadg_3_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_4_desc.text: The price of every trade goods, like grain and wine, is beginning to creep up; a bitter side effect of the devastating wars that are being fought in the #G Austropetolian Archipelago#!. The threat of famine is not quite here, but if we have a couple more seasons like this one, then [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] will be in danger.\n\nHarvests are also shaping up to be poor in general, an unfortunate result of the lack of manpower out in the fields that comes at the worst possible time. Some are complaining that the gods are displeased with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] and the greed of the elites living within their mansions in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], but the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has shrugged off these criticisms.

me_mignadg_4.a.text: If we look back, then we will be destroyed - only forward

me_mignadg_4_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_4$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_5_desc.text:
By the time that the armies of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] had landed on the island of #G Kraklaz#!, the war with [GetCountry('UPJ').GetName|T] was a foregone conclusion - there was nothing in all of #G Omniluxia#! that could keep our levies from storming the walls of the [GetCountry('UPJ').GetAdjective] capital.

Rumors of the vast wealth of the [GetCountry('UPJ').GetAdjective] people motivated our soldiers to utterly destroy our enemies, and now that their so-called 'League' has been dissolved by an edict issued by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], the generous [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] unleashed [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] armies upon the fallen #T Euryalean#! capital, telling them to plunder it to their heart's content in a speech delivered outside the army camps of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].

'Spare nothing, faithful sons of #T Mignadg#!, but gorge yourselves upon the corpse of this monstrosity! Tear down the marbled porticoes that grace the #Y Tower of Chereus#! and fill your bags with the incense taken from its markets - I care not what happens to the remnant of the Euryaleans, even if they vanish completely from the #Y Austropetolian Isles#!'.

Within a week, the ancient city of [GetProvince('(int32)5607').GetName|G] was burned to the ground, with no trace of the great civilization that had once thrived there.

me_mignadg_5_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_5$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_6_desc.text: Although they were reluctant to leave their port of [GetProvince('(int32)5692').GetName|G], when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] promised to relocate their households and possessions to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] at no cost to the pirates, they decided to abandon the dangerous southern coasts, with its ramshackle huts, and head for the splendors of the #T Mignadg#! city.\n\nSome were troubled by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y]'s insistence on giving the buccaneers an entire district within the capital, which quickly became known as #Y The Buccaneer's Quarter#! for obvious reasons, and yet few were willing to voice their displeasure. No one wanted to anger the bold [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], lest they find a gang of leering scoundrels at their doorstep one evening, cudgels in hand.

me_mignadg_6.a.text: If you wish to keep your forked tongue, then sssilence it!

me_mignadg_6_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_7_desc.text: As the sun rises over the #G Central Omniluxian Sea#!, one of the first things that can be seen in the port at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] is the long line of trade ships waiting for permission to dock. There are many tired deckhands that would love nothing more than spending their coins in the marketplaces of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] capital, but there will be tariffs and dues to pay before they are given permission to wander the streets - the people of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] run a tight ship and do not cut any corners when it comes to their trade.\n\nAnd with good reason; merchants from as far away as [GetProvince('(int32)2470').GetName|G] are willing to make the dangerous journey north in order to secure the best prices for themselves, and our eager craftsmen are happy to oblige, taking the middleman profits for themselves. The trade of gems and diamonds are keeping the marketplaces of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] full, and everyone is praising [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] handling of the economy.

me_mignadg_7.a.text: May the gods continue to bless our endeavors

me_mignadg_7_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_7$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_8_desc.text: In retrospect, it seems inevitable that [GetProvince('(int32)5697').GetName|G] would become a city of its own; its proximity to the grandiose [GetProvince('(int32)5694').GetName|G] all but guaranteed that this former backwater would rise in importance, and thanks to its location at the mouth of the #Y Strait of Greegroknlp#!, the narrow body of water that separates that island from the mainland, it sees its fair share of traffic from merchant and soldier alike.\n\nIn time, this city will grow to become one of the great cities of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G], perhaps even one day surpassing [GetProvince('(int32)5607').GetName|G] in importance - the true second city for the #Y Ular-Pria#!, built by the majestic [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y].

me_mignadg_8.a.text: What a fortunate state of affairs for all involved - especially me

me_mignadg_8_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_8$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_9_desc.text: While [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] remained focused upon defeating [GetCountry('UPJ').GetRuler.GetName|Y] during the so-called #Y 'War of the Snakes#!, the vengeful [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] did not forget the insult of hearing about entire cohorts of #Y Nagarajian#! sellswords attacking our islands while our armies were distracted. The perfidious northerners also supplied both manpower and gold to the tyrants living in [GetProvince('(int32)5607').GetName|G] while harassing our shipping lanes during the recent wars; sins that are unforgivable.\n\nBut once our southern enemies were defeated, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] unleashed the wrath of our armies against the northern islanders, and it wasn't long before the squabbling #Y Nagarajian#! tribes fell to the deadly forces of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T].

me_mignadg_9.a.text: Did you think I would allow you to raid my shores with impunity?

me_mignadg_9_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_9$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_10_desc.text: When [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] sent forth word from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] announcing the restoration of the #Y Empire of the Ular-Pria#!, there were a few sour voices that accused the new [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] of becoming the very thing that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] destroyed - a tyrant, one worse than any King of the [GetCountry('UPJ').GetName|T] could ever be. The Euryaleans were ambitious and cruel, this is true, but they never succeeded in uniting the many tribes of the #Y Ular-Pria#! together. Will the sons of #T Mignadg#! be faithful and just leaders, or will they despoil the lands worse than any that came before them? It remains to be seen.\n\nBut the ascendance of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] was foretold by prophecy, and although the twin distasters that befell our people, #Y The Fall of the Ular-Pria Imperium#! and #Y The Great Collapse#!, would have destroyed a weaker people, we have triumphed where no one else could have. The Empire of Serpents has been reborn!

me_mignadg_10.a.text: Long may the House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective] reign!

me_mignadg_10_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_11_desc.text: It is said that many serfs spend their entire lives in the sugar @sugar! farms outside of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], their eyes cast longlingly towards the gleaming spires of the magnificent [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] capital in the distance.\n\nAlthough they will spend a good portion of their lives toiling in the hot jungles, their blistered hands sticky with sugarcane sap, they still hold on to the hope of a better life one day.

me_mignadg_11.a.text: Work hard now, and perhaps you will earn your freedom

me_mignadg_11_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_11$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_12_desc.text: When it was first proposed to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] that we build a system of roads through the jungles that would connect everything on the island to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] did not require much convincing.

me_mignadg_12.a.text: No matter what the cost, I shall pay it - build those roads!

me_mignadg_12_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_12$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_13_desc.text: Although trade with the outside world has suffered immensely since the #Y Great Collapse#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has done [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] fair share to bring back the foreign merchants to the marketplaces of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] by ordering that a vast #Y Grand Market#!, the greatest ever seen in all of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], be built within the capital.\n\nThanks to the judicious use of #Y Dwarven Concrete#!, a strong building material that was only recently adopted by our kinsmen, our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] engineers were able to finish the market in a few months - much earlier than everyone anticipated.

me_mignadg_13.a.text: We welcome everyone that wishes to trade with us to #E Iprnk#!

me_mignadg_13_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg_task_13$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_mignadg_14_desc.text: Now that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has reforged the #Y Empire of the Ular-Pria#!, it has been proclaimed throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] is a true descendant of our ancient ancestors. From this day forth, let it be known throughout all #G Omniluxia#! that the #Y Snakefolk#! have reclaimed their birthright!

me_mignadg_14.a.text: I shall lead the Empire of the Ular-Pria to its greatest days!

me_mignadg_14_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y Blood Of The Ular-Pria#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_DESCRIPTION.text: The deadly conflicts brought on by the #Y High Elven Invasions#! have not only plunged the island of #Y Arteon#! into chaos, but have caused tensions on the neighboring isle of #G Eptelon#!, as well.\n\nRealizing that the distractions are a perfect opportunity for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] to expand their borders, the bold [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has ordered [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] armies to prepare for an invasion of the north.

03_mignadg2_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] have conquered the island of #G Eptelon#!.

03_mignadg2_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: We must expand our Empire to encompass the islands around us!

03_mignadg2_task_1_DESC.text: The time has come to launch our invasion of #G Eptelon#!, but we must choose a city on the #Y Austropetolian Isle#! that will serve as a staging ground for our armies.\n\n#Y We will fortify a city in the province of#! #T Otorix#! #Y in preparation for our invasion.#!

03_mignadg2_1_2_tooltip.text: We will choose which city receives the following modifier;

03_mignadg2_task_2_DESC.text: To ensure success for our military units fighting in #G Eptelon#!, we will need to make sure that the province of [GetProvince('(int32)5666').GetArea.GetName|G] is well-stocked. We must make sure that we have the supplies on hand to ensure that our army achieves victory!

03_mignadg2_task_3_DESC.text: The coasts of [GetProvince('(int32)1101').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G] lie just across from the [GetProvince('(int32)5666').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G] - we must prepare claims before we can cross the #G Arteptolian Sea#! in order to establish a foothold on the island.

03_mignadg2_task_4_DESC.text: Our valiant armies have conquered portions of [GetProvince('(int32)1033').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G], driving the natives farther into the interior of the island. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|G] has vowed that the rest of #G Eptelon#! will be ours!

03_mignadg2_task_5_DESC.text: [GetProvince('(int32)1033').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G] is a land comprised of tribes, but [GetProvince('(int32)675').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G] is a different animal altogether; there are #Y High Elves#! and #Y Artheousians#! on the coasts. We will encounter a new type of enemy that we have never fought before.

03_mignadg2_task_6_DESC.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] does not have much use for the native cultures on #T Eptelon#!, and has deemed them to be fitting slaves for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|G].\n\nNot only shall our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] cast the #Y Eptelonians#! into fetters, but [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] will even attack their very beliefs - the ruthless [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has given the order to destroy the #Y Eptelonian#! holy sites.

03_mignadg2_task_7_DESC.text: The glorious [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], long may [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] reign, has destroyed all resistance to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] rule over #G Eptelon#! - all hail the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T]! #G Eptelon#! has been sacked and its treasures have funded the construction of the metropolis of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].

03_mignadg2_task_8_DESC.text: Although we have complete confidence in the ability of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] soldiers to secure victory on their own, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has decided that we will augment our forces with auxiliaries taken from the #Y Austropetolian Isles#!.

03_mignadg2_task_9_DESC.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has unleashed the armies of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] against the native #Y Eptelonians#!, and the air is hazy with the smoke of smoldering holy sites. The savage #Y Snakefolk#! armies are pillaging freely, and no one can stop them.\n\nWith the plunder that we have taken from their sacred places, a powerful artifact has been created by an #Y Ular-Pria#! #Y Mage#! - the #T Staff of Enslavement#! will help us convert the natives to our ways.

03_mignadg2_task_10_DESC.text: The reputation of the port city of [GetProvince('(int32)653').GetName|G] certainly precedes itself - everyone that sails the #Y Central Omniluxian Sea#! is familiar with the deadly #T City of Thieves#!. Despite its lawless reputation, it is known to be a good place to recruit mercenaries - especially now, thanks to the #T High Elven Wars in Arteon#! that have sent many refugees to #G Eptelon#!.\n\n#Y This will start an event chain.#!

03_mignadg2_task_11_DESC.text: The #Y Austropetolian Isles#! have jungles that grow the rare plant hemp @hemp! - something that would be quite useful for our navy, if we were able to harvest enough of the material.

03_mignadg2_task_12_DESC.text: Not everyone is resisting the #Y Ular-Pria Invasion#! of [GetProvince('(int32)1033').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G] - there are some local warlords that are willing to sell out their kinsmen to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|G], as long as the price is right.

03_mignadg2_task_13_DESC.text: After our troops ravaged [GetProvince('(int32)1101').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G], many of the poor souls that escaped our armies left their homes and crossed the #G Arteptolian Sea#! in their desperation to survive. Because of our actions, the city of [GetProvince('(int32)919').GetName|G] has seen tens of thousands of displaced #Y Eptelonians#! arrive, which has caused tension between [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|G] and [GetCountry('MH1').GetName|Y]. #Y The island of#! #Y Arteon#! is already struggling in general, and the last thing anyone wants is a full-blown refugee crisis.\n\nAs of late, the disagreements between the two countries seem to have become personal, and at this rate, the [GetCountry('MH1').GetRulerTitle|Y] of [GetCountry('MH1').GetName|Y] and the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle|G] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|G] are going to plunge their countries into war.

03_mignadg2_task_14_DESC.text: The #Y Eptelonians#! have long exported an inferior type of coffee @coffee! that only grows on their island, but [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has demanded that their plantations be burned to the ground - only the islands of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] should be able to grow coffee!\n\n#Y This province will no longer produce coffee, and the Ular-Pria will choose what is manufactured there instead.#!

03_mignadg2_1_desc.text: Once [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] had decided to invade #G Eptelon#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] knew that the armies of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] would need a staging ground on the #Y Austropetolian Isle#!. The ports of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] are too far away from #G Eptelon#! to be of any use, so a foreign city must be serve as a temporary base for the #Y Ular-Pria#! forces.\n\nThe only question remains; where exactly shall we direct our troops? There are two cities on the northern coast, [GetProvince('(int32)5660').GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)5666').GetName|G], that are good candidates for a war capital, but the final decision must be made by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y].

03_mignadg2_1.a.text: I have chosen Fethr as our home away from home

03_mignadg2_1.b.text: Gimaprld is the best location for our men

03_mignadg2_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_2_desc.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has ensured that our Austropetolian cities are well-stocked for the campaigns ahead. Not only are the raw materials required for war on hand, but [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has personally visited the troops, even delivering an impromptu speech to the levies.\n\nAfter the soldiers heard their [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] promise unlimited wealth in the days to come, they were motivated to sack as many cities as they possibly could.

03_mignadg2_2.a.text: I do not care how many Eptelonians you kill...

03_mignadg2_2_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_3_desc.text: Although rumors are starting to spread throughout [GetProvince('(int32)1101').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G] that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] is preparing to invade, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] wants to keep the element of surprise and has threatened to destroy any of the kingdoms that are on the coasts.\n\nA general state of unease has settled over the province as the nervous inhabitants wonder when the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] will attack. Trade in the region is beginning to dry up, as merchants travel for safer waters, and the price of grain is going up every day.

03_mignadg2_3.a.text: It is only a matter of time before my soldiers land...

03_mignadg2_3_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_4_desc.text: The overwhelming forces launched by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] have quickly destroyed any opposition and have carved out possessions along the southern coasts of #G Eptelon#!.\n\nBolstered by this victory, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has vowed that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] armies will only continue to assault the citadels and fortresses of the natives.

03_mignadg2_4.a.text: It is only a matter of time before we take the entire island

03_mignadg2_4_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_4$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_5_desc.text: When it became clear that [GetProvince('(int32)1101').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G] would become a part of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] ordered [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] soldiers to fight harder than ever. For there remained yet even more to do - the entire island must bow to the commands issued by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], and this includes [GetProvince('(int32)428').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G].

03_mignadg2_5.a.text: More plunder and glory awaits you in the north!

03_mignadg2_5_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_5$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_6_desc.text: Some voices in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] have branded [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] a savage, claiming that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has gone too far with the native #Y Eptelonians#!, but [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has ignored all of these criticisms.\n\nIt seems that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] even enjoys the nickname that the #Y Eptelonian#! slaves have given to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] - they call [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] #Y 'Godslayer'#!, or the #Y 'Shatterer of Dreams'#!. The #Y Eptelonians#! claim that our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] is a harbinger of the end of days, and many of them have abandoned hope.

03_mignadg2_6.a.text: Let them fear me, as long as they obey me

03_mignadg2_6_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_7_desc.text:
The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has managed to expand the borders of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] to encompass the isle of #G Eptelon#! - a feat that surpasses the deeds of the Rulers of Old and their Empire that perished in the #Y Great Collapse#!.

Word has traveled throughout neighboring #Y Arteon#!, as the desperate inhabitants wonder if the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] presence on #G Eptelon#! will either aid or hinder their cause. The arrival of a new regional power is never a good thing, however, and some of the Kings across the #G Arteptolian Sea#! are beginning to put their plans into motion.

But today is a day of celebration, for the House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective] have put the wealth of conquered #G Eptelon#! into [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], which has now been built into a true #Y metropolis#!. The power and accomplishments of the #Y Ular-Pria#! will never be matched by anyone!

03_mignadg2_7_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_7$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_8_desc.text: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] sent out the call throughout the #Y Austropetolian Isle#! that anyone that would like to join the levies of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] were welcome to travel to [GetProvince('(int32)5660').GetName|G]. Promising good pay and a chance to make a fortune plundering #Y Eptelonian#! settlements and cities, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] informed the local authorities that the time to train these new recruits was imminent and that preparations would need to be made.\n\nWhat no one, expected, however, was just how many soldiers arrived at the capital - thousands of warriors, all clamoring for the glory of battle.

03_mignadg2_8.a.text: We will be undefeatable with these riders on our flanks!

03_mignadg2_8_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_8$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_9_desc.text: Although [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] gave [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] men permission to destroy the holy sites of [GetProvince('(int32)428').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G], the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] did [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] best to prevent word of the atrocities committed by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] from reaching [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].\n\nEven [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] realized that the army had gone too far, but [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] would not discourage them from sacking and destroying the temples of the #Y Eptelonians#!. In order to facilitate this gruesome task, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] commissioned an artifact of great power, a #T Staff of Enslavement#!, using wealth stolen from the islanders.

03_mignadg2_9.a.text: Kill them all and take everything!

03_mignadg2_9_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_9$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_10_desc.text: When [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] asked [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] friend about the availability of mercenaries within [GetProvince('(int32)653').GetName|G], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] did not expect the answer that came in a letter that was delivered one morning to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] from the governor of the #T City of Thieves#!.\n\n'My [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]. There are many sellswords hanging around the #Y Slums#!, but they do not respect outsiders...you will have to come in person if you wish to obtain their services.'

03_mignadg2_10.a.text: Yes, that is fine - let us prepare to leave at once

03_mignadg2_10.b.text: I am not going down to the slums...are you crazy?

03_mignadg2_10_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_10_tooltip2.text: #Y The current event chain will end.#!

03_mignadg2_11_desc.text: A few short days later, the ship bearing the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] arrived in [GetProvince('(int32)653').GetName|G] to some devastating news; [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] friend, [SCOPE.sChar('this_man_is_about_to_be_murdered_scope').GetName|Y] the governor of [GetProvince('(int32)653').GetName|G], had been viciously assassinated by a group of rogue mercenaries. The lawless sorts that run the slums are openly attacking local officials with impunity - things are truly out of hand in the province.\n\nHiding safely aboard [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] ship, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has a couple of choices to ponder; [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] could pay some locals to kill the mercenaries responsible for this crime ([ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y]'s' private soldiers refused to go into the #Y Slums#!), or [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] could also opt to do nothing - the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] is here on business, after all.

03_mignadg2_11.a.text: Hire mercenaries to attack those responsible for this

03_mignadg2_11.b.text: I do not care what happened, actually - I am here to work

03_mignadg2_11.c.text: This was a mistake - I am returning to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName]

03_mignadg2_11_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y Arrival At Sum Khaya#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_12_desc.text:
In a few short days, the mercenaries hired by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] were able to find the perpetrators of the heinous crime against [SCOPE.sChar('this_man_is_about_to_be_murdered_scope').GetName|Y], and a full pitched battle was held down in the #Y Slums of Sum Khaya#! that would be talked about for years to come.

In the end, the hired muscle of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] managed to defeat the disorganized rabble pitted against them, and they took many hostages for the #Y Ular-Pria#!. But [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] showed no mercy to those that surrendered their weapons, and had hundreds of men executed in cold blood on the city streets.

Word began to travel that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] was a ruthless warrior, and hundreds of mercenaries left [GetProvince('(int32)653').GetName|G] for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] that same day. It was clear to the sellswords that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] was a butcher of men, and this would bode well for their future prospects as raiders and looters.

03_mignadg2_12.a.text: I have accomplished what I set out to - sail for home

03_mignadg2_12_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y A Ruthless Reputation#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_13_desc.text: In the few short weeks that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] was in [GetProvince('(int32)653').GetName|G], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] managed to meet the local powerbrokers and regional authorities, all of whom were willing to sell their services to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle].\n\nIn the end,[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] agreed to hire as many archers as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] could afford, promising to equip any man who brought his own bow to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].

03_mignadg2_13.a.text: Now that I have what I came here for, it's time to return home

03_mignadg2_13_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y A Master Of Missiles#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_14_desc.text: Thanks to the hemp @hemp! farms built throughout the #Y Austropetolian Isles#!, we now have a surplus of the rare plant on hand - news that will be well-received by the boatwrights and sailmakers living in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].

03_mignadg2_14.a.text: This is exactly what we needed

03_mignadg2_14_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_11$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_15_desc.text: In the end, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] had no qualms when it came to cutting deals with #Y Eptelonian#! turncoats, for no #Y Eptelonian#! would ever be accepted by the #Y Ular-Pria#! as anything more than a servant. The traitor that presented himself before the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] presented no serious threat whatsoever to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], and everyone in the room knew this fact.\n\nStanding before  [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] was a renowned #Y Eptelonian#! general named #Y Tuomoleik#!, and our spies report that the natives had hoped that this very man would be the one to lead the local armies against us. What a cruel blow it must be, to see their best hope for freedom groveling on his knees before the #Y Snakefolk#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]!

03_mignadg2_15.a.text: I hope you are prepared to die for the Empire

03_mignadg2_15_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_12$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_16_desc.text:
It is no secret that [GetCountry('MH1').GetRuler.GetName|Y] blames [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] for the refugee crisis happening in [GetProvince('(int32)919').GetName|G]. The [GetCountry('MH1').GetRuler.GetName|Y] city has tens of thousands of #Y Eptelonian#! refugees living in the port district and local tensions are out of control - if [GetCountry('MH1').GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] is not careful, then [GetCountry('MH1').GetRuler.GetSheHe] could have an angry mob sacking the royal palaces. The [GetCountry('MH1').GetAdjective] [GetCountry('MH1').GetRulerTitle] has written many letters to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] that have gotten increasingly angrier in tone, but our armies have continued to sack and pillage #G Eptelon#! to their heart's content, all but ignoring the complaints of the #Y Arteonians#!.

One morning, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] was already in a foul mood when something on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] desk caught [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] eye - another letter from [GetCountry('MH1').GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] had arrived the night before. The contents of this message were filled with contempt and open threats against the people of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], ending with a promise to sack the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] capital and give it to the #Y Eptelonian#! refugees on #Y Arteon#!.

Crumpling the letter in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] hand, a visibly-enraged [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] announced that the #Y Snakefolk#! armies would invade #Y Arteon#! when the time was right.

03_mignadg2_16.a.text: I will destroy your city and kill everyone in it!

03_mignadg2_16_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_13$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_mignadg2_17_desc.text:
[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] was present to watch the burning of the coffee plantations that were once a popular sight in the province of [GetProvince('(int32)1108').GetName|G]. Although the #Y Eptelonian#! coffee plant is noticeably inferior to the varieties that can be found within our homeland, the locals still had a thriving industry exporting the roasted beans...but this is to be no more.

[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] ordered [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] soldiers to uproot every bush and set every farm to the torch. The indigenous workers were also killed to a man. After today, the #Y Eptelonian#! coffee plant would disappear from the island, never to return.

Breathing in the scent of ash and smoke, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] turned to an advisor and gave the orders for the next phase of development here.

03_mignadg2_17.a.text: Create workshops for the distilling of liquor

03_mignadg2_17.b.text: We have need for more glass

03_mignadg2_17.c.text: Spices grow in abundance on Eptelon

03_mignadg2_17.d.text: Invest in a facility that can brew elixir

03_mignadg2_17_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_mignadg2_task_14$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_nazani_DESCRIPTION.text: The #Y Nazani Empire#! was born from the western half of the old #Y Zani#! world, but its survival has depended on more than inherited glory. The people of #Y Bharamuntacho Zani#! are neither the old eastern #Y Zani#! nor simple conquerors among strangers; they are Weagelian, imperial, and reborn.\n\nIf the #T Empire of the West#! is to survive its enemies and outgrow the shadow of #Y Durobaeraste#!, the #P Purple Emperor#! must strengthen the capital, choose a second city worthy of balancing the imperial court, and decide whether the future of the #Y Nazani#! lies in disciplined expansion or a perfected imperial heartland.

03_nazani_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when the #Y Nazani#! have strengthened #Y Bharamuntacho Zani#!, raised a second city beside it, chosen the future direction of the #T Empire of the West#!, and restored imperial or subject rule throughout #Y Wegalia#!, the #Y Borderlands#!, and the #Y Old Frontlines#!.

03_nazani_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: The Nazani must strengthen their homeland before they can claim to be the true inheritors of the western Zani world.

03_nazani_task_1_DESC.text: #Y Bharamuntacho Zani#! was once the western capital of the old #T Zani Empire#!, the city where emperors spent the gentler months far from the eastern court. For the #Y Nazani#!, it must become more than a seasonal palace; it must be the permanent heart of a reborn imperial order.

03_nazani_task_2_DESC.text: The old imperial gods still watch the streets of [GetProvince('(int32)2720').GetName|Y], and the #T Temple of the Unconquered Zani#! remains one of the clearest proofs that the western court is no provincial accident. By renewing the sacred district around the temple, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] can bind dynasty, city, and faith together.

03_nazani_task_3_DESC.text: #Y Cloth#! from [GetProvince('(int32)2720').GetName|Y] already clothes officials, priests, and merchants across the capital. With proper mills, dyes, and guild oversight, those workshops can become the foundation of a courtly economy worthy of a #T Purple Emperor.#!

03_nazani_task_4_DESC.text: A great empire is not held together by soldiers alone. It survives through ledgers, seals, courts, educated clerks, and the terrifying certainty that every governor's report eventually reaches the palace. The #Y Nazani#! court must build a chancery capable of ruling more than a ceremonial capital.

03_nazani_task_5_DESC.text: The capital cannot grow on purple cloth and imperial pride alone. The fields, fisheries, and cattle lands around [GetProvince('(int32)2720').GetName|Y] must be organized into a proper food network, feeding the city even when war or intrigue strains the countryside.

03_nazani_task_6_pdeso.text: Pdeso, Shield Of The Southern Sea

03_nazani_task_6_pdeso_DESC.text: [GetProvince('(int32)3382').GetName|Y] is already a city of stone walls, sea traffic, and southern soldiers. If the #P Purple Emperor#! raises #G Pdeso#! as the second city of the realm, the #Y Nazani#! homeland will lean toward ports, fortresses, and the disciplined projection of power.

03_nazani_task_6_esenzeu_DESC.text: [GetProvince('(int32)2347').GetName|Y] already guards the northern forests as a fortified city of glassmakers, soldiers, and Great Wolf rites. If the #P Purple Emperor#! raises #G Esenzeu#! as the second city of the realm, the #Y Nazani#! homeland will gain a stern northern counterweight to the court at #G Bharamuntacho Zani#!.

03_nazani_task_7_DESC.text: Protected roads must bind the imperial capital, its chosen counterpart, and the old towns of #Y Wegalia#!. The granaries have funded cheaper road construction; now the original heartland must be joined by dependable routes for grain, officials, and soldiers.

03_nazani_task_8_DESC.text: A second city must do more than mirror the capital. In [GetProvince('(int32)3382').GetName|Y], imperial guilds can turn stone, walls, and harbor dues into southern strength; in [GetProvince('(int32)2347').GetName|Y], they can bind glassmakers, garrisons, and northern markets to the imperial court.

03_nazani_task_9_DESC.text: The #Y Nazani#! practice of imperial blinding is reviled by many enemies and feared by every ambitious courtier. Whether [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] rules through restraint or through the memory of darkened eyes, the palace must make clear that treason has consequences and justice has a procedure.

03_nazani_task_10.text: The Two Cities Of The West

03_nazani_task_10_DESC.text: At last, [GetProvince('(int32)2720').GetName|Y] and the chosen second city stand as twin pillars of the #Y Nazani#! homeland. One is the sacred capital of the reborn #Y Zani#!; the other is the counterweight that turns imperial ambition into revenue, movement, and authority beyond the palace.

03_nazani_task_11_wide_DESC.text: The old provinces of #Y Wegalia#! must provision the emperor's armies beyond the frontier. Reliable musters, loyal officers, and well-stocked roads will carry imperial authority through the marshes and borderlands.

03_nazani_task_11_tall_DESC.text: Let the wealth of two seas flow into the imperial cities. Palaces, academies, and thriving markets will make the western court a seat of learning and splendor worthy of its inheritance.

03_nazani_task_12_DESC.text: The #Y Nazani#! have strengthened the capital, raised a second city beside it, and chosen the shape of their future. Throughout #Y Wegalia#!, the #G Borderlands#!, and the #G Old Frontlines#!, imperial governors and subject lords once more answer to the #P Purple Emperor#!. The western empire is no longer viewed as the weaker sibling of #Y Durobaeraste#!, but stands proudly on its own two feet. It is its own power, its own court, with its own legacy and its own promise of #T Zani#! rebirth - all hail the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|Y]!

03_nazani_task_16_DESC.text: The [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|R] has been reduced to dust at the hands of the victorious [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], who has reclaimed our ancestral territories and restored the #T House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective]#! to the prestige and respect it lost over centuries of decline. The common people have taken to calling the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] #G 'Dragon Slayer'#! - a title that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] doesn't mind one bit.

03_nazani_task_13_DESC.text:
Beyond the #Y Nazani#! homeland, the old #G Borderlands#! beckon. The lords of [GetProvince('(int32)2187').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|Y] remain unaware of our saboteurs operating in their midst, and by all accounts, they are not ready for what is to come.

Through shadow and secrecy, we have kept contacts with #G Orcish mercenaries#! in the region - warriors that help protect the colonies that we have funded over the years. Gold and promises will purchase their loyalty, and together, we shall reshape the western lands into an empire worthy of the #Y Zani#! name.

#R Accepting Grommash's aid in the events that follow can lead directly to war in the Borderlands.#!

03_nazani_task_14_DESC.text: Beyond the #G Borderlands#! lie the ancestral #Y Marshlands#!, where imperial purple once flew above the black waters. By laying claim to the wetlands, we remind their scattered lords that the #T Zani#! inheritance has not been forgotten.\n\nOnce half the #G Borderlands#! answer to us or our subjects and the realm is at peace, the court can finish its preparations. The moment to carry our banners into the marshes will be ours to choose.

03_nazani_task_15_DESC.text: The dragon-lands of #Y Kainaxarthos#! remain the great prize of our lost western inheritance. Let the court proclaim our claim before the world, and let the #Y Soventeir#! hear that the #P Purple Emperor#! remembers what was taken.\n\nWith half the #G Marshlands#! under imperial or subject rule and the realm at peace, our preparations can be brought to completion. The remaining wetlands need not all fall before we turn our gaze toward the #Y Dragon#!'s Throne, but the hour of reckoning will be ours to choose.

03_qoes_DESCRIPTION.text: As the chaos of the #Y Great Collapse#! toppled the Empires of #G Luxterra#!, a dwarven adventurer named #Y Edis [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective]#! came down from the #Y Skyreach Mountains#! with his kinsmen and fought against the tribes living on the #G Skyreach Steppes#!. The Copper #T Dwarves#! won a decisive battle against a combined #Y Goblin#! and #Y Selaskusian#! army sent to stop them, pushing them back from the best lands in the region and founding the city of [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G] at the foothill of the mountains.\n\nThe sturdy walls of #G Bad-Furqorin#! would protect the nascent Copper #Y Dwarven#! kingdom in the years to come, but their many enemies have never accepted their presence among them and eagerly await an opportunity to destroy the city.

03_qoes_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when the Copper #T Dwarves#! of [GetCountry('SR4').GetName|T] have overcome their enemies and have established a mighty kingdom on the #G Skyreach Steppes#!.

03_qoes_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: We must complete the work that our ancestor Edis began!

03_qoes_task_1_DESC.text: The hated #Y Goblin#! tribes that live in the foothills of the #Y Skyreach Mountains#! have long been a thorn in the side of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], but their end rapidly approaches. Prepare our claims and gather our levies, for we shall cross through the pass near [GetProvince('(int32)3960').GetName|G] and dispel the #Y Goblins#! from the province of [GetProvince('(int32)3960').GetArea.GetName|G]!

03_qoes_task_2_DESC.text: If only our people could eat the cinnabar taken from the mines at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y]! Food security has always been a problem for our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] kinsmen, and as heightened tensions in the region are beginning to constrict the food supplies, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] will be forced to attack our neighbors in order to keep our granaries full.

03_qoes_task_3_DESC.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has accomplished something that our glorious ancestor, #Y Edis [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective]#!, fought for his entire life, but could never achieve - the pushing back of the #Y Goblin#! Hordes and the expansion of our borders.

03_qoes_task_4_DESC.text: As the fame and glory of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] spreads throughout all #T Luxterra#!, it comes as no surprise to discover that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y] has become one of the most populated cities in all of the #Y Skyreach Steppes#!.\n\nAll manner of Dwarvenkind have made their way to our city in order to seek their fortunes in the golden days of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s reign. Recently, a master craftsman, the most skilled armorer in all of #T Omniluxia#!, arrived in the capital in hopes of seeking our patronage.

03_qoes_task_5_DESC.text: Much to the chagrin of every Copper #Y Dwarven#! farmer that lives near [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y], the fertile fields of the capital are an important source of cinnabar for the region. Instead of harvesting grain with hand scythes, our laborers carry pickaxes into the mountains - let us make sure that their efforts are not in vain.

03_qoes_task_6_DESC.text: The inhabitants of [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|Y] have long worshiped [GetDeityDefinition('omen_edis').GetName|G] at the holy site located within our city, and yet [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] believes that there is more we could do to honor our patron deity.\n\nThe [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has called for a grand forum to be constructed outside of the religious district, one that will welcome the faithful to the #Y City#! of the Copper #T Dwarves#!. When all is completed, a #Y Grand Temple to Edis#! shall be constructed and the heart of our capital shall be transformed forever.

03_qoes_task_7_DESC.text: Travelers from all across #T Luxterra#!, even from as far away as [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|Y] and [GetProvince('(int32)1331').GetName|Y], often make the dangerous journey to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] in order to buy our cinnabar from us directly. Our capital is widely known as the #R City of Cinnabar#!, for we have made fortunes selling the rare mineral.

03_qoes_task_8_DESC.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|Y] has long owed its survival to two things; the walls of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y] and the swords of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective] Clan, both which have protected our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] people since we first founded our city.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has made it known throughout [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G] that the time for military service draws near; if our people are to survive, then we shall have to fight for our lives.

03_qoes_task_9_DESC.text: [GetDeityDefinition('omen_edis').GetName|G] would be proud of the deeds and accomplishments of the incomparable [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], the mighty [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] that has led our forces to this moment - the proclamation of #T Edisdor#!.\n\n#Y This will start an event chain#!.

03_qoes_task_10_DESC.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has long desired that the #T Skyreach Stone Altar#!, one of the most sacred #Y Dwarven#! relics, reside within [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|Y]. Even though this seems like a distant dream, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has faith that the gods will somehow bring the altar to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] one day.

03_qoes_task_11_DESC.text: While everyone knows of the cinnabar mines located just outside of the walls of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], the nearby hills and mountains also contain marble and iron ore that is destined for the forges and blacksmiths of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] people.

03_qoes_task_12_DESC.text: After years of blaming magic users for the disasters that befell our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] ancestors, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has abruptly decided that we must invite magic users to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] in hopes of learning what we can from them.

03_qoes_task_13_DESC.text: The province of [GetProvince('(int32)4131').GetArea.GetName|G] to our south has long supplied beef and mutton for the #Y Ta'ata#! #Y Goblins#! living near us, but their days of feasting are over thanks to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] and our ferocious [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] warriors. Once we have built farms throughout our neighboring province, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] shall never want for meat again!

me_qoes_1_desc.text: For hundreds of years, our forces have had to bide their time behind the sturdy walls of [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G], watching in mute frustration as #Y Goblin#! raiding parties terrorized the settlements of [GetProvince('(int32)3960').GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)3961').GetName|G]. #Y Manpower#! has always been a resource that our army has had to ration, and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] could not afford to lose thousands of soldiers in a pitched battle on the #G Skyreach Steppes#!.\n\nBut now, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has made it clear that the dwarves of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] will not allow the #Y Goblins#! to pillage our holdings any longer - [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] has vowed to circle the #Y Skyreach Mountains#! and destroy the bandits and riders that hide in the foothills.

me_qoes_1.a.text: The time has come to destroy all threats to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]...

me_qoes_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_2_desc.text:
Turning away from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] advisors, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] walks out of the storeroom with a grim look on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] face. Over the last few months, the amount of grain held within the vaults at [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G] has fallen precipitously, and it is feared that we might not have enough food to last through the next winter.

[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has always struggled with food security, for the best farmlands in the region - in fact, the only farmlands within the #G Skyreach Steppes#! - are where the city of [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G] was built. And when the sons of #Y Edis [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective]#! discovered that cinnabar could be found in the fields near the capital, that sealed the city's fate - the Copper #T Dwarves#! would always have to rely on imports to feed their people, for their love of gold was greater than their love of food.

But the situation is growing untenable, and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] knows it - something will have to be done.

me_qoes_2.a.text: We must attack south and seize Goblin farms - we have no choice

me_qoes_2_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_3_desc.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has somehow managed to achieve what eluded our ancestors for hundreds of years - the pushing back of the #Y Goblin#! hordes that have menaced our borders and threatened our continued existence. Never have our armies had to fight as desperately and fiercely as they have, and there were moments when it seemed that we could lose everything that we have achieved. Despite all odds, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has defeated the #Y Goblin#! tribes and their #Y Selaskusian#! auxiliaries, chasing the remnants of their broken levies far into the #Y Skyreach Steppe#!.\n\nRealizing that the gods are with the Copper #T Dwarves#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has sworn to lead our armies to even greater victories in the days ahead. We are truly the Sons and Daughters of [GetDeityDefinition('omen_edis').GetName|Y], the Scions of the Conquering King!

me_qoes_3.a.text: May [GetDeityDefinition('omen_edis').GetName] march with us into battle forevermore!

me_qoes_3_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_4_desc.text:
One year ago, a famous visitor came to the capital of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] and the entire city was abuzz with the news of his arrival. When [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] heard that this master armorer, a man by the name of [SCOPE.sCharacter('dwarven_master_smith').GetName|Y], was passing through [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G] on his way to [GetProvince('(int32)4262').GetName|G], the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] wasted no time, but immediately extended an invitation to the wizened old craftsman.
