An elegant feast was prepared for [SCOPE.sCharacter('dwarven_master_smith').GetFirstName|Y], and as goblets of mead were served on platters of silver, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] finally found some courage and cleared [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] throat to speak, but the old man cackled loudly with a twinkle in his eye and interrupted.

'I have seen a thing or two in my time, Heir of Edis, and I know why you have summoned me thus.' Rubbing his wrinkled hands together gleefully, [SCOPE.sCharacter('dwarven_master_smith').GetFirstName|Y] smiled widely, revealing a near-toothless maw. Rising to his feet, the old man bowed deeply and began to shuffle for the door. 'Give me twelve months to work in your workshops and I will craft for you the greatest shield in all of #G Omniluxia#!!'

And one year later, that was exactly what happened.

me_qoes_4.a.text: You do me a great honor, [SCOPE.sCharacter('dwarven_master_smith').GetFirstName] - I thank you

me_qoes_4_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_4$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_5_desc.text:
When the heirs of #Y Edis [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective]#! discovered that their city of [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G] was built on top of a massive cinnabar mine, the small farms that were built outside of the city were dismantled practically overnight - every available scrap of land would soon see the rich earth overturned with spades and pickaxes as the Copper #T Dwarves#! searched high and low for the precious mineral.

This controversial decision would cause problems in the years to come, for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] was built on the only arable farmland within the #G Skyreach Steppes#!. Although there would be many hungry days for the Copper #T Dwarves#!, the fortunes they made from selling cinnabar allowed them to expand their fortifications in ways that would have been impossible without vast sums of gold. The citizens might have grumbling bellies, but at least they were safe from the steppe tribes.

The administration of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has doubled down on the efforts to extract cinnabar from the mountains by building mills throughout the city. While some [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] elites have complained, claiming that granaries are needed more than workshops, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has been adamant in his requests.

me_qoes_5.a.text: This is the price we must pay for freedom...

me_qoes_5_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_5$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_6_desc.text: #Y Visitors#! to [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G] were always impressed by the awe-inspiring sight of the #Y Temple of Edis#! located within the city's oldest district, and countless pilgrims have made the journey to the Tomb where the mortal remains of [GetDeityDefinition('omen_edis').GetName|Y] are located in order to pay their respects.\n\nAnd yet what was before pales in comparison to what exists now, for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has opened up the treasuries of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] and spent a princely sum in order to construct new buildings in the heart of the city. A magnificent new plaza, the #Y Forum of Edis#!, has been built alongside the #Y Dragon Road#!, the main thoroughfare leading through the capital. The final addition to the city, a masterwork designed by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], is the #Y Great Temple#! that was erected next to the ancient holy site, giving the faithful a place to worship the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] #T Deity#! of War.

me_qoes_6.a.text: These buildings will be my eternal legacy, a gift to Bad-Furqorin

me_qoes_6_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_7_desc.text: One of the most common sights to be found on the roads leading to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] is convoys of armed soldiers and guards accompanying merchant caravans. Traders from all across #G Luxterra#! and even a few brave souls from #G Morrigon#! have become well-acquainted with the twisting mountain paths that lead to the capital of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], for the best prices for the rare mineral can only be found within the towering walls of the Copper #Y Dwarven#! capital. It is known far and wide that the wealthy [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] citizens live in the #Y City of Cinnabar#!, making the arduous journey through the hills and badlands of the #Y Skyreach Steppe#! a necessity for those seeking profits.

me_qoes_7.a.text: If you want the best prices, then you must come to our markets in person

me_qoes_7_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_7$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_8_desc.text: Once the final decisions had been made, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] commanded [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] magistrates to go down to the plazas and squares of [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G] and issue the call for volunteers to fight alongside our troops. Previously, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] had asked [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] generals to assess the state of the army, and their report did not exactly inspire confidence - if our men were routed in a pitched battle, then the capital itself would undoubtedly fall.\n\nWith the stormclouds of war threatening to spill over the horizon amidst a critical manpower shortage, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] knew that, if [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] were to survive the coming battles, they would need every able-bodied dwarf fighting in the levies.

me_qoes_8.a.text: A call to arms! Who will follow the Sons of Edis in the days to come?

me_qoes_8_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_8$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_9_desc.text:
The power and prestige of the Copper #T Dwarves#! has never been greater than it is at this moment! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has led the #T Qoes#! levies out from the walls of [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G] and has won victory after victory, destroying any that oppose our designs upon the #G Skyreach Steppes#!.

All across #G Omniluxia#!, the tales of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] are recounted in the streets and cities, with rumors of the fabulous wealth of the Copper #T Dwarves#! captivating those that stop to listen. Stories of streets paved with cinnabar, of the magnificent Copper #G Forum#! and the holy #Y Tomb of Edis#! in the heart of the city are enough to fill a man's head with daydreams for weeks.

A generation ago, no one knew our names, yet now, the entire world envies our accomplishments!

me_qoes_9.a.text: All hail the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]! Glory to the Heirs of [GetDeityDefinition('omen_edis').GetName]!

me_qoes_9_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_9$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_10_desc.text: One of the holiest artifacts for all Dwarvenkind is the $treasure_skyreach_altar$, the primordial artifact hewn from the oldest parts of the #Y Skyreach Mountains#!. Countless sacrifices to the #Y Hebric Pantheon#! have been offered on its weathered marble slab, and the base of the altar is covered in crudely-carved archaic runes - the first recorded use of written language in any of the #Y Dwarven#! histories.\n\nWhen the triumphant forces of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] brought the #T Skyreach Stone Altar#! to [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G], the celebrations in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] capital lasted for weeks. What greater sign of divine favor could there be? It is said that whomever holds the Altar speaks for all Dwarvenkind.

me_qoes_10.a.text: The gods have blessed us beyond measure, all thanks to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]!

me_qoes_10_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_11_desc.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], our spies have informed us of some troubling news from the #G Marenica Sea#! region - travelers have reported seeing a giant #Y Dragon#! flying inland from the coasts. A large caravan of #Y Werhenlander#! cinnabar traders was expected in [GetProvince('(int32)3816').GetName|G] a week ago, but they have vanished in the #Y Skyreach Passages#! without a trace. Rumors are starting to spread like wildfire and many people are afraid to visit our kingdom now.\n\nOur soldiers have not seen the drake ourselves, but we thought you should be aware of what is happening abroad, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle].

me_qoes_11.a.text: Hmm...this isn't good. Keep me informed of any developments

me_qoes_12_desc.text:
The sun had just risen over the #Y Skyreach Mountains#!, but many living within the #Y City#! of the Copper #T Dwarves#! were already awake and working. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] was sleepily thumbing through the pile of letters that were on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] desk when a loud rumbling shook the entire city of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].

'An earthquake!' [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] swore as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] rose to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] feet, but another tremor shook the citadel and caused the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] to collapse to the floor. Head spinning, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] ran towards the entrance and barely escaped the palace before another violent convulsion caused the entire building to collapse. A large shadow filled the plaza, plunging the city into darkness, and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] turned around, only to feel [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] blood turn to ice.

A giant #Y Dragon#! was flying above the skies of the city, and as the beast screamed in rage, a piercing sound that caused [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] to grasp [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] ears in agony, a pillar of flame erupted from its mouth - [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] was under attack! Operating solely on instinct, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] grabbed the #Y Flameshield of Qoes#! from the armory and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] trusty sword. Moments later, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] ran down into the city, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] mind racing.

me_qoes_12.a.text: Gods have mercy...what am I going to do?

me_qoes_13_desc.text: The #Y Dragon#! is raining its fiery breath down upon the streets of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] capital, melting the stone buildings of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] with its unfathomable heat. The screams of women and children can barely be heard over the horrendous sounds of toppling architecture; it sounds as though the #Y Skyreach Mountains#! are falling down onto the city.\n\nAlthough traveling through the devastated streets was difficult, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] managed to make it to the barracks located just outside of the citadel, where the remaining levies of the frightened Copper #T Dwarves#! were gathering. Their number was small - hundreds of soldiers have abandoned their posts and countless more have already perished. All eyes are upon [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], who must issue orders immediately.

me_qoes_13.a.text: Rally the troops and fill the skies with arrows!

me_qoes_13.b.text: I, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName], Heir of Edis, will fight the #E Dragon#!!

me_qoes_14_desc.text: The last week was a nightmare for the people of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], who have seen almost everything that they have worked so hard for destroyed practically overnight. The #Y Dragon#! attack lasted hours, and the fearsome drake burned down entire districts of the city, killing tens of thousands of unlucky dwarves that could not escape the densely-packed streets of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], fearing that the wrath of the Wyrm would destroy the capital entirely, gathered the Copper #Y Dwarven#! armies and launched a frantic defense of the city, filling the skies with thousands of arrows. Somehow, gods be praised, the beast was wounded and flew away towards the #Y Skyreach Passages#!, leaving the smoldering metropolis of #G Bad-Furqorin#! in ruins.

me_qoes_14.a.text: We are lucky to have survived; life in Bad-Furqorin will go on

me_qoes_14_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y Aftermath Of The Attack#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_15_desc.text:
Truth be told, even those that witnessed the ensuing battle could not believe their eyes; [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] rode out from the gates of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] alone, leaving [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] soldiers behind as the intrepid [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] challenged the #Y Dragon#! to combat.

At first, the Wyrm ignored the solitary figure standing before the city, but as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] raised the #Y Flameshield of Qoes#! above [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] head and chanted a spell of protection, the loathsome drake could not resist the challenge and flew down to attack the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle].

It was said that, in that moment, a ghostly figure appeared on the battlefield - a glimmering shade that stood next to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], dressed in the armor of [GetDeityDefinition('omen_edis').GetName|Y]. With the #T God of War#! at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] side, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] knew in that moment what [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] destiny would be.

Hours later, the Copper #T Dwarves#! gathered the broken body of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] from the battlefield. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] was missing an arm and was barely recognizable, so badly was [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] burned, but the great warrior had not fallen in vain - there, underneath [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] twisted and battered frame, lay the body of the dragon #Y Baurig, Scourge of the Skyreach Passages#!. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], the true Heir of Edis, had defeated the greatest enemy that #G Bad-Furqorin#! would ever see.

me_qoes_15.a.text: May the gods honor the memory of the #E Dragonslayer#!

me_qoes_15_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y Dragonslayer, The Heir Of Edis#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_16_desc.text: Now that the threat from the nearby #Y Goblin#! tribes has been neutralized, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] is more than happy to send our workers to the hills and plains located just a couple day's ride from the capital to mine for ore. In the past, these workers would have been accompanied by heavily-armed soldiers, for the #Y Goblins#! and #Y Selaskusian#! riders of the #Y Skyreach Steppe#! love nothing more than the thrill of hunting Dwarvenkind, but things have changed as our armies have won victories against the enemy.\n\nNot only have we seized these territories for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], but the profitable mines we have constructed are a clear sign to everyone in the region that we do not plan on leaving anytime soon.

me_qoes_16.a.text: The engineers of Bad-Furqorin have need of marble, iron and stone!

me_qoes_16_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_11$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_17_desc.text: In the weeks following the disastrous dragon attack on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], the mourning citizens of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] would construct a tomb carved out of the purest cinnabar to hold the remains of the fallen hero, placing the sarcophagus next to that of [SCOPE.sCharacter('dragonslayer_ruler_scope').GetHerHis] ancestor Edis.\n\nWhile many wept bitter tears upon remembering the sacrifice of the Dragonslayer, the #G War Priests#! revealed to the citizens that a new constellation was seen in the skies over #G Bad-Furqorin#! that same evening; brave [SCOPE.sCharacter('dragonslayer_ruler_scope').GetName|Y] would live forevermore as a #T Hebric#! god.

me_qoes_17.a.text: We shall honor your memory forever, [SCOPE.sCharacter('dragonslayer_ruler_scope').GetFirstName]!

me_qoes_17_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y Tomb Of The Dragonslayer#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_18_desc.text: Although the people of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] did not suffer during the #Y Great Collapse#! - it can even be argued that the accomplishments of #T Edis the Grim#! could have only taken place during the chaos of its aftermath - our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] kinsmen are certainly suspicious of magic users.\n\nBut these prejudices must be abandoned, for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has changed the laws to allow practictioners of the arcane to freely pursue the magical arts within our realm. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] believes that we are doing ourselves a disservice by not embracing the study of magic, for our many enemies do not share the same qualms as we do. Now, all throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], specialized libraries that focus on obtaining magical texts have been opened, and mages from all across #G Luxterra#! are traveling to our capital.

me_qoes_18.a.text: We cannot afford to allow others to cast spells against us!

me_qoes_18_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_12$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_qoes_19_desc.text: One of the direst problems facing [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] has just been solved by the brilliant [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], who has been the most dynamic [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] since perhaps [GetDeityDefinition('omen_edis').GetName|Y] himself. #Y Large#! farms have been built close to home to provide our citizens with fresh meat, and the food security problems that have plagued [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] for generations have finally been eased.\n\nNow that these estates have been built throughout the #Y Goblin#! settlements to our south, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has given the order to the #T Qoesi#! overseers to put the locals to work on the farms - anyone over the age of eight summers will be required to labor in the fields and on the farms.

me_qoes_19.a.text: We promise to keep the Goblins close to their lands...heh...

me_qoes_19_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_qoes_task_13$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_razani_DESCRIPTION.text: Although the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T] has graciously granted the refugees from the fallen city of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G] sanctuary, an incident at the royal court in [GetCountry('SOV').GetCapital.GetName|G] would prove to be the prelude to a #T Dragkhanic#! #Y Civil War#! - one that will have ramifications for all of #G Omniluxia#!.

03_razani_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] successfully challenges [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetName|Y] for control of the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T] before launching an invasion of the western coast of #G Luxterra#!.

03_razani_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: Zemmairthia Jarenam, I shall reclaim you...

03_razani_task_1_DESC.text: In an effort to further integrate [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] into the royal court at [GetProvince('(int32)4864').GetName|G], the newly-crowned [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName|G] has been asked to marry a princess from the [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective] House.\n\n#Y This task will be#! #R bypassed#! #Y if our#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle|T] #Y is married.#!

me_razani_1_desc.text:
After many anxious weeks of correspondence between [GetCountry('SOV').GetCapital.GetName|G] and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], the day of the proposed marriage between [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] and his bride, [SCOPE.sCharacter('soventeir_princess').GetName|Y], is finally at hand.

The [GetCountry('SOV').GetRulerTitle] insisted on being the one to give away [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetHerHis] niece, [SCOPE.sCharacter('soventeir_princess').GetFirstName|Y], but unfortunately for all involved, [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetName|Y] began celebrating early in the day and was very inebriated during the ceremony. Once the rites were completed and the feasting began, [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] continued to drink unmixed Hazalar wine, and as the strong liquor began to do its work, the topic at dinner turned towards uncomfortable things, like the recent #Y Fall of [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName]#!.

Reaching for a haunch of roasted lamb, the [GetCountry('SOV').GetRulerTitle] stifled a belch and began chuckling. 'I can't help but notice that you have done quite well for yourself, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], despite living a life defined by failures.' Rudely pointing towards [SCOPE.sCharacter('soventeir_princess').GetFirstName|Y] with a silver fork, [GetCountry('SOV').GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] laughed out loud. 'A beautiful princess from the Royal House and the city of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName|G] to rule over as a personal fief...not too bad, young man. If your #Y Jarenam#! kinsmen knew that such hospitality awaited them in the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T], then I would half-expect to see a thousand ships filled with cowards sailing over the horizon.'

A deadly silence fell at the dinner table, interrupted only the droning strings and clanging cymbals of the court musicians. Rising to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] feet, face choked with rage and feeling the eyes of all present upon [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] half-bowed, hand on the hilt of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] sword.

me_razani_1.a.text: Forgive me, but it is time for me to leave, your Majesty...

me_razani_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_jqf_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

03_saptarum_DESCRIPTION.text:
Nearly four hundred years have passed since the sack of our great city by the #Y Zani#! invaders. Since then, our nation has declined into a rump state deep in the mountains. While we may lament the loss of our past glory, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] does possess certain advantages that will help it succeed on the international stage: a warrior culture and a strong merchant heritage.

The city currently finds itself as a #Y plutocratic society#! dominated by a council of the #R Great Merchant Families#! of the city, the #Y Kvaran#!, the #Y Otensonn#!, and the #Y Segurrvelk#!. The #Y Kvaran#! are the oldest and wealthiest family, and members are often very traditional in their beliefs. The #Y Otensonn#! claim to be descendants of the great hero #G Oten 'to Hrungmogg'#!, and have a strong military tradition, with all male members expected to become a part of the aristocratic officers that run the military. Finally, the #Y Segurrvelk#! are the youngest family, said to have been founded by commoners who managed to use their talents to achieve great wealth as merchants. They are the largest family and the most populist of all of the three.

While the three families run the state, their rivalries have caused a rift that could be exploited by an outsider. While the #Y Kvaran#! and the #Y Otensonn#! continue to uphold the tradition of acting as #Y 'Custodians of the Throne'#!, the #Y Segurrvelk#! push for the abolition of the long-vacant throne. On top of political disagreements, the #Y Kvaran#! and #Y Otensonn#! fear the power that the much larger #Y Segurrvelk#! might use against them if the country was ever to enter another civil war.


In this environment, it will only take one event to trigger a catastrophic chain reaction that will once again change the trajectory of the #Y Saptan#! people!

03_saptarum_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has restored its place as one of the strongest powers in #G Morrigon#!!

03_saptarum_task_1_DESC.text: Having used the foolish #Y Kvaran#! and #Y Otensonn#! against the #Y Segurrvelk#!, the young king can now work on undermining the power of the remaining families.\n\nNow that the balance of power is gone, the #Y Kvaran#! and #Y Otensonn#! are at each other's throats, and believe the King will be a useful tool they can use over the other. With this knowledge in mind, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] plays along and placates the families by removing their rivals from positions of power. However, he quietly plots to put his supporters into these roles, until he has full control of the government and the army, and is able to expel the corrupt families.

03_saptarum_task_2_DESC.text: With their dark red armor and Bonesteel swords, the #R Forrj Guard#! was a legendary force that protected the #Y Saptan Kingdom#! in its heyday. With the fall of its final commander, #G Oten 'to Hrungmogg'#!, and the kingdom itself the guard faded into legend. However, with the return of the #Y Aspatta#! and the army reforms led by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], the time has come for the #R Forrj Guard#! to return as vanguards of the King's new royal army.

03_saptarum_task_3_DESC.text: With the expulsion of the last remnants of the old families, new nobility have filled their place. With the wealth he's seized from the former families, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has decided to invest into his army, both to ensure his personal control over his soldiers and to centralize his power over the kingdom.

03_saptarum_task_4_DESC.text: A symbol of hope for our people, integrating the prosperous colony of [GetCountry('SV4').GetName|T] will provide more men for our armies and land to tax. Their annexation will be [GetCountry('SV2').GetName|T]'s first step to empire.

03_saptarum_task_5_DESC.text: Ever since the collapse of the #Y Zani#!, the #Y Saptans#! have maintained friendly relations and even alliances with the neighboring #Y Borderlander#! #Y Leslesi#! tribes, with #G Aspatabi#! being founded on land purchased from #Y Leslesi#! chieftains. However, while we were distracted by political squabbles, our allies were subjugated by other #R hostile Borderlander tribes#! and #R Orcish invaders#!. It's time to honor our longstanding friendship and liberate the #Y Leslesi#!!

03_saptarum_task_6_DESC.text:
The #Y #R Acliuram Orcs#!#! are relatively recent players in #Y Northern Morrigon#!, and have been a rising threat to all powers in the area.

Arriving around two hundred years ago, these #R Orcish invaders#! created colonies on the coast of the #G Orcish Sea#! surrounding the major trade hubs they conquered, such as #Y Gorhoffabi#!.

A bellicose people, the #R Orcs#! have managed to become the dominant trading force in the #G Orcish Sea#! by hooking potential customers to their 'products' and threatening other traders and nations with violence to eliminate the competition. It would benefit us to take over their trading hubs and end their tyranny for good.

03_saptarum_task_7_DESC.text: As the #Y #R Orcs#!#! are being dealt with, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] turns his attention to the various hostile #Y Celtican#! and #Y Borderlander#! tribes that occupy the many inland and coastal trading hubs of #Y Northern Morrigon#!. Conquering their wealthy cities will bring us one step closer to dominating the #G Orcish Sea#! Trade!

03_saptarum_task_8_DESC.text: With both the #Y #R Orcs#!#! and #T Humans#! subjugated, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] can finally begin consolidating his dominion over the #G Orcish Sea#! Trade! Developing the various trade hubs he's conquered, the wealth that will flow into his #Y Kingdom#! from this endeavor would be able to fund his future campaigns against the hated [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|T]!

03_saptarum_task_9_DESC.text: Using the newfound wealth of the #G Orcish Sea#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] can now turn his full attention to his ultimate ambition: the conquest and destruction of the [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|T]. Heirs of the cruel #Y Zani#!, the [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|T] must be utterly destroyed before [GetCountry('SV2').GetName|T] can truly rise again.\n\nHowever, such a stable and wealthy empire will be difficult to subjugate, so [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s armies must first weaken them by plundering the wealthy cities of the #Y Ularians#!.

03_saptarum_task_10_DESC.text: With other empires greedily eyeing up the weakened [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|T], we must strike quickly to ensure our dominion over our hated enemies! Let us not allow them to escape judgement!

03_saptarum_task_11.text: Punish the Heirs of the Zani

03_saptarum_task_11_DESC.text: #T Dwarves#! among all races are notorious for holding grudges, and no dwarves hold a greater grudge than the #Y Galmar Silver Dwarves of Morrigon#! have against the #Y #R Weagelians#!#!. With the fall of the [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|T] and the capture of the ancient #Y #R Zani#!#! city of [GetProvince('(int32)2720').GetName|G], the #Y Galmar#! finally have their chance to take their revenge on the descendents of their conquerors.

03_saptarum_task_12_DESC.text: There is a popular myth among those who dwell along the slopes of the #Y Pjershyan Highlands#!, one of a bird as large as a dragon and unable to be killed. It is said in the #Y Sørrgann#!, or #Y Great Walk#!, that the #Y Galmar#! hunted this bird every day for a hundred years, with its meat sustaining them throughout their journey to the #Y Saptan Valley#!. The elders say that once the bird's bones were symbolically burned in a cave, it would reappear from the mountains the following morning.\n\nThis bird, the #Y #R Forrj#!#!, is a symbol of our city. A city reborn through the flames that incinerate others. A city that is no longer the capital of a kingdom, but now the seat of an empire.

03_saptarum_task_13_DESC.text: With our bloodlust subsiding, our people look with fresh eyes at the destruction we've brought to the children of the #Y #R Zani#!#!. Ruined cities, families, villages, farms, we've become so blind with rage that we've burned everything in our path. As the fires turn to embers, it's time to help rebuild and resettle the former cities of the #Y #R Zani#!#! in our image with the help of our #Y #G Leslesi#!#! allies.

03_saptarum_task_14_DESC.text: Despite all the chaos our nation has gone through, our council has persisted. However, factionalism and infighting amongst the families has left us weak. If we are to become a strong country we must first ensure our government is stable.

03_saptarum_task_15_DESC.text: With our new army we are now able to impose our influence abroad and expand our influence and power. We should begin by finally annexing the only other #Y Galmar#! city big enough to contest our strength, [GetProvince('(int32)2651').GetName|G], bringing their resources and manpower into our growing Republic.

03_saptarum_task_16_DESC.text: Due to our shared hatred of the #R Zani#!, our people have often maintained strong relations with the various #Y Leslesi#! tribes of the #Y Northern Pjershyan Hills#!, which translated into trade agreements and military alliances that were disrupted during the chaos caused by our coup that removed the corrupt #R Council of Elders#!. During our internal conflicts, neighboring #R Borderlander tribes#! and #R Orcs#! subjugated our allies, and we failed to take any actions even after our council's ascension. The #Y Leslesi#! are fierce warriors and loyal allies, freeing them from their oppressors and integrating them into our Republic would be beneficial to us and our ambitions in the region.

03_saptarum_task_17_DESC.text: Now that we've secured our borders and recruited our #G Leslesi#! allies, the council's next main objective is to expand their influence in the wealthy #Y Orcish Sea Trade#!. By capturing and developing key #R Orcish#! and #Y Human#! ports, we can simultaneously eliminate our competition and create major economic centers to expand our influence abroad.\n\nAdditionally, captured #Y Orcish#! trade vessels could prove useful for any future maritime ambitions…

03_saptarum_task_18_DESC.text: By integrating our #G Leslesi#! allies we have inherited their conflicts with the other major #R Borderlander tribes#! to our south. However, we can use this to our advantage and claim the resources of the southern #Y Borderlanders#! for ourselves!

03_saptarum_task_19_DESC.text: Using the knowledge we've gained from studying #R Orcish#! ships, we must innovate on their designs and construct a grand #G Merchant Fleet#! capable of protecting our trade interests against conniving #Y Orcish#! and #Y Human#! pirates and steering trade to our new ports!

03_saptarum_task_20_DESC.text: Controlling such a large expanse of land is a costly endeavor, especially due to the hostile nature of the #R Borderlanders#!. However, our #G Leslesi#! allies provide us with a unique solution. By dispersing #Y Leslesi#! settlements around the south, we can establish friendly trading posts who will ensure regional stability.

03_saptarum_task_21_DESC.text: Back during the #Y Saptan Golden Age#!, our people were known as some of the best silversmiths in all of #G Morrigon#!; a reputation that would unfortunately attract unwanted attention. However, now that our Republic is strong enough to protect itself, we should encourage and patronize the artisans of our realm to restore this ancient reputation!

03_saptarum_task_22_DESC.text: Our conquests have brought [GetProvince('(int32)2559').GetName|G] and the council great wealth and splendors. To commemorate our successes and showcase the wealth and authority of the council and our realm, the #Y Kvaran#! have patronized several upcoming artists and metalworkers to create the #Y Sørrsalla#!, or #Y Great Hall#!.

03_saptarum_task_23_DESC.text: With the #Y Sørrsalla#! completed, it is only reasonable that our city match the magnificence of such a work! Let us put our new artisans and laborers to work on making our city a true #Y Sørrborr#!, one with impenetrable walls as high as the #Y Walls of God Mountains#!!

03_saptarum_task_24_DESC.text:
While our Republic has become very wealthy, that wealth has concentrated mainly amongst the powerful aristocratic nobles of the great merchant families

Unfortunately, this has caused quite a bit of unrest amongst the general population, with serfs and freemen demanding an expansion of citizenship while citizen soldiers demand better representation in our council.

Our attempts to placate the masses with massive building projects have not seen the success we are hoping for, and we must acquiesce to some of their demands lest we succumb to ruinous riots and revolts.

03_saptarum_task_25_DESC.text:
The #G Leslesi#! have proved to be resourceful and loyal allies, going from scattered communities to large urban centers of civilization.

They've adopted many aspects of #Y Galmar#! culture, with many even adopting the #T Hebric#! faith, putting their own heroes into our pantheon and their philosophers and theologians arguing whether #Y Galmarr 'to Vernun'#! and other #Y Silver Dwarven#! heroes were reincarnations of #G Lula#!. Many of their brightest have become some of the most skilled traders and generals in our nation.

However, they remain second class citizens to the #Y Galmar#!, and very few #Y Leslesi#! are actually allowed official citizenship.

With the passing of the #G Ubaturren ulfton Thorgarren#!, this is now an issue which many #Y Leslesi#! and #Y Galmar#! alike have decided to change.

me_saptarum_1_desc.text: By the time the bickering #Y Kvaran#! and #Y Otensonn#! decide to consolidate their power, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] already has full control over the city and the nation. Loyal statesmen pledge their support to the King as the frantic #Y Kvaran#! and #Y Otensonn#! scramble to find any allies in court to assist them.\n\nIn the following weeks the wealth and influence the mighty #Y Kvaran#! and #Y Otensonn#! once wielded has been seized by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], and their families are forced to march out of [GetProvince('(int32)2559').GetName|G] in shame to an unknown fate.

me_saptarum_1.a.text: The rule of the families is over, long live the King!

me_saptarum_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_2_desc.text: Nearly four hundred years after its dissolution following the #R #E Great Zani Invasion#!#!, the #Y #R Forrj Guard#!#! rises once again.\n\nMarching in perfect sync, the afternoon sunlight gleams off of their blood red armor and the hilts of their bonesteel swords. They stop and form ranks in front of their King, whom they've pledged to serve for life, even at the cost of their own. After a short inauguration speech, the King is elated with the response of his new vanguard.

me_saptarum_2.a.text: Long live Saptarum! Long live Saptabi! Long live the Aspattan Kings!

me_saptarum_2_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_3_desc.text: As [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s new Royal #G Army#! marches through the streets of [GetProvince('(int32)2559').GetName|G], residents stare in awe at the powerful force our King commands. As this great parade comes to an end, the King holds an elaborate ceremony meant to cement his power over his kingdom, with his new nobility lining up to pay fealty to him and only him. Only a few years prior he was an outcast, a subject of what was his rightful kingdom, now he is a true monarch not seen since the last days of the #Y Aspatta#!!

me_saptarum_3.a.text: This is the first step to empire!

me_saptarum_3_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_4_desc.text: The citizens of [GetProvince('(int32)2651').GetName|G] cheer as their King arrives to their thriving city. His visit has attracted many settlers and freemen who have accompanied him on his journey, many of whom now flock to the overcrowded markets and taverns of the city. Under his decree, this small border outpost is to now become an official city of the #Y Kingdom#! of [GetCountry('SV2').GetName|T].

me_saptarum_4.a.text: Glory to the King! Glory to [GetProvince('(int32)2651').GetName]!

me_saptarum_4_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_4$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_5_desc.text: Arriving at the gates of the city to meet with the #Y Leslesi#! Chieftains outside [GetProvince('(int32)2559').GetName|G], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] is surprised by caravans full of families and freemen. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] asks the Chieftains what their people are doing so far from home, to which they respond that they wish to make [GetProvince('(int32)2559').GetName|G] their new home. Knowing his armies will need a fresh source of men, the King readily agrees and helps accommodate his new subjects!

me_saptarum_5.a.text: Even the humans approve of our monarch's rule!

me_saptarum_5_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_5$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_6_desc.text: The skies fill with smoke as the screams of the #R #E Aceliuram#!#! are drowned out the sounds of our swords falling upon the #R #E Orcish#!#! invaders. As their cities fall, their people are faced with two choices: death or expulsion.\n\n Weeks after the success of his campaigns, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] triumphantly watches as the #R #E Orcs#!#! are sent off to an unknown fate, hopefully to be lost in storms or attacked by the bloodthirsty #R #E Remun#!#! or #R #E Rendun#!#! #R #E Orcs#!#! of the godless #R #E Bloody Isles#!#!. Finally rid of the oppressive invaders, the King's #G #E Leslesi#!#! auxiliaries let out a fearsome cry of victory as they watch a sabotaged ship sink below the unforgiving waves of the #G Orcish Sea#!.

me_saptarum_6_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_7_desc.text: While the #Y Aceliuram#! colonies are viewed with disdain by our people, there is no denying that their #G Inner Flame#! burns brightly, allowing them impressive victories against the weak and foolish #Y #R Shuar#!#! and #Y #R Vakkan#!#! of #Y Northern Morrigon#!. This knowledge made it all the more shocking to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] as he watched thousands of #Y Aceliurami#! pour into our capital. Some #Y #R Vakkan#!#! barbarians who call themselves '#Y Galmar#!' have expelled our kinsmen from their lands and driven them back to us. While we might disagree with their ideas and culture, an #Y Orcish#! enemy is always preferable to a #Y #R Vakkan#!#! friend.

me_saptarum_7_tooltip.text: #R We will gain a claim on [GetCountry('SV2').GetName]!#!

me_saptarum_8_desc.text: The #R #E Celticans#!#! and the #R #E Borderlanders#!#! to our South, once barbarians who roamed and killed without consequence, have been brought to justice through the strength and will of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s armies. With their few settlements in flames, their people scattered and disorganized, and their war parties broken before the combined strength of our disciplined infantry and skilled auxiliaries, the #R #E Celtican#!#! and #R #E Borderlander#!#! tribes now bow to the conquering king of #Y Northern Morrigon#!.

me_saptarum_8.a.text: The human dogs bow before our might!

me_saptarum_8_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_7$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_9_desc.text: From the ashes of the puny settlements that served as hubs of trade throughout #Y Northern Morrigan#! true commercial cities have arisen. Bustling with #Y Human#!, #Y Dwarven#!, and even remaining #R #E Orcish#!#! traders, it is evident to all that the rising [GetCountry('SV2').GetName|T] #Y Kingdom#! is the new dominant force in the #Y Orcish Sea Trade#!!\n\nHowever, disturbing signs keep [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] awake past reasonable hours. As his men sorted through the loot of the ruined cities of the Orcs, #R #E Zanic#!#! weaponry as well as letters from #Y Nazani#! officials were found among the wreckage. As the #G Celticans#! and #Y Borderlanders#! were driven from the field, #Y Nazani#! coins were found in their camps. All these worrying signals just reinforce [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s sole goal ever since he retook the throne lost by his ancestors:

me_saptarum_9_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_8$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_10_desc.text: The #Y Nazani#! cowards run from our armies! With their cities left defenseless, our men cheer as they expect sweet revenge against the feeble heirs of the #R #E Zani#!#!!\n\nHowever, the jubilant cries of our soldiers quickly turn to murmurs of confusion as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] issues strict orders no looting, razing, or killing as they march to occupy the towns. While the disappointed and confused men loyally march onto grateful crowds of #R Ularian#! civilians, the few wise enough to sense the danger they are in escape to the countryside, fearful of the hidden plans of the supposed #Y Merciful Conqueror#!.

me_saptarum_10.a.text: A predator among prey is not friendly, it is patient

me_saptarum_10_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_9$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_11_desc.text: While our current goals have been mainly local or internal, external events have piqued the interest of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]. The #Y Silver Dwarves#! of [GetCountry('SV2').GetName|T] have dealt a crucial blow to the decadent [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|T], crippling both their army and their economy. With the path to [GetProvince('(int32)2720').GetName|G] open, we might be able to claim a piece of this rival empire while they are stumbling.

me_saptarum_11_tooltip.text: #R We will gain a claim on [GetCountry('WGA').GetName]!#!

me_saptarum_12_desc.text: Despite the vultures circling around the ailing [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|T], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has managed to completely conquer the former lands of #R #E Zani#!#! from the incompetent #Y Emperor#! [GetCountry('WGA').GetRuler.GetName|Y]! As his royal entourage moves across his new domain, #Y Ularians#!, #Y Fidelians#!, and #Y Wegelians#! alike flock to meet the fabled #Y Magnanimous King#!, who rewards their curiosity with gifts of gold and silver from his homeland.\n\nThat night the generals and officials that have traveled with the young king are summoned to his tent. Seeking answers as to his sudden affection for the #Y Geallians#!, the disgruntled officials expect a heated discourse with their sovereign, however they are silenced immediately when they notice that the King's typically warm smile has been replaced with a chilling toothy grin.

me_saptarum_12_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_13_desc.text:
The weak man is pushed by guards into the King's throne room, collapsing onto the floor in front of him. Forced to kneel in front of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], [GetCharacter('(int32)326').GetName|Y] looks up with eyes full of hatred at the man who desecrated the legacy of the Great #R #E Zanis Zani#!#!.

The pale imitation of what was once the great #Y Nazani Emperor#! shouts in defiance in the Weagelian tongue,

'My empire has fallen, yet I still live. Face me, man to man, and allow me to either avenge my people or die alongside them'.

me_saptarum_edeath.text: #R The King will #E execute#! the final Emperor of the Weagelians!#!

me_saptarum_eduel.text: #R The King will #E duel#! the final Emperor of the Weagelians to the death!#!

me_saptarum_13.c.text: Great men are not granted death, it shall find them when the time is correct

me_saptarum_ebanish.text: #R The King will #E banish#! the final Emperor of the Weagelians!#!

me_saptarum_14_desc.text:
The duel lasts two minutes, as recalled by those present.

Despite his demeanor and health, [GetCharacter('(int32)326').GetName|Y] briefly had [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] on the defense.

An exchange of blows followed where the King struck the #Y Emperor#! fatally.

As the frail man collapsed, the King triumphantly raised his hammer as he was met by a roar of approval.

Even though his body defied him, the dying emperor's spirit would not relent. One quick and precise strike left the King with one final reminder of the strength of the heirs of #Y #R Zanis#!#!.

In a rage-filled fury the King finally strikes down the #Y Emperor#!, ending the #Y Nazani#! line and procuring cheers of celebration from the crowd.

The King orders his comrades to be silent, as he calls for the former #Y Emperor#!'s attendants to take his body back to #Y Weagelia#!. Despite their legendary grudges, there is one universal thing that any dwarf can respect: courage.

me_saptarum_14.a.text: Allow the Great Emperor to rest

me_saptarum_15_desc.text: News from far off #G Morrigon#! has reached [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]: The #Y Nazani#! have been killed at the hands of the #Y Silver Dwarves#! of [GetCountry('SV2').GetName|T]! While we do not relish the successes of the false claimants of #T Zanis#!' legacy, it is horrifying to see their destruction at the hands of barbarians from the west.\n\nAs news of his defiance spread amongst the common people, a new cult has arisen that worship him as a demi-god similar to the great #Y #G Zanis Zani#!#!. While we would not encourage this worship, the bravery of the #Y Nazani#! is certainly something to admire.

me_saptarum_15.a.text: Only #E #R Renn#!#! can decide his fate

me_saptarum_16_desc.text: Meeting with his ministers, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] begins to describe his plans for the fate of the #Y Geallians#! of #G Morrigon#!, children of the wretched #Y #R Zani#!#!.\n\nWhile most of his people cry out for blood, one lone voice speaks up for the #Y #R Ularians#!#! of the North, a #G #E Leslesi#!#! chieftain by the name of #Y Acco#!. The #Y #R Ularians#!#!, which he argues are a people who have common ancestry with the #Y Northern Borderlanders#!, are the most loyal out of all of our new subjects. If their lands should burn, we should at least do what we can to limit the damage and allow them to escape the upcoming vengeance of the #Y Galmar#!.

me_saptarum_16.a.text: Any people that march alongside the Weagelians are our enemies

me_saptarum_eularianraze.text: #R We will #E raze#! the cities of the #E Ularians#!!#!

me_saptarum_eulariansave.text: #R We will allow the #E Ularians#! a chance to flee!#!

me_saptarum_17_desc.text: With the #Y Ularians#! dealt with, the King and his ministers now argue about what to do with the #Y Fideli#! of #Y Southern Wegalia#!.\n\nWhile most continue to loudly voice their support for their destruction, a small group of more pragmatic nobles offer another suggestion. They argue for the enslavement of the able-bodied men and women to work on the various farms and workshops of our growing empire.

me_saptarum_17.a.text: The Geallian spirit must be burnt at the root

me_saptarum_efideliraze.text: #R We will #E raze#! the cities of the #E Fideli#!!#!

me_saptarum_17.b.text: They will serve as excellent slaves

me_saptarum_18_desc.text:
With the fate of all the other #Y Geallians#! dealt with, the only people left to receive punishment are the heirs of the #Y #R Zani#!#! themselves: the #Y #R Weagelians#!#!.

When [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] brings up the topic of the #Y Weagelians#! his entire tent goes silent. A room full of tense, hateful eyes barely hide the unspeakable hatred that his officials attempt to manifest into words. Finally, one man speaks. #Y 'Weagelia verr brennthou!'#!. Overpowered by emotion, his tent is filled with this singular chant.

#Y #R 'Weagelia verr brennthou!'#!#!

#Y #R 'Weagelia Verr Brennthou!'#!#!

#Y #R 'WEAGELIA VERR BRENNTHOU!'#!#!

me_saptarum_eweagelisave.text: #R We will #E raze#! the #E Weagelian#! cities!#!

me_saptarum_19_desc.text:
Through our conquests and destruction we have managed to accrue a large amount of wealth that the King has reinvested into our capital. Through careful planning and large projects, the city once nicknamed the #R #E 'Ruined City'#!#! has risen alongside our kingdom to become the jewel of our empire. Our new #Y #R 'Forrj City'#!#! will be recognized by all as one of the premier cities of the world, a true mountain metropolis!

'Our domain now ecompasses nearly all of #Y Northern Morrigon#!, and our new status as a major power of #G Omniluxia#! should be recognized by all. No longer are we simply the #Y Saptans#! of the #Y Saptarum Kingdom#!, but the reborn sons of [GetCharacter('(int32)73').GetName|Y], an empire reborn from the burning of our ancient enemy, whos souls fuel our ascendance.'

Thus declared [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], the first #Y Emperor#! of #Y #R Forrjkheim#!#!.

me_saptarum_19.a.text: From the embers of the Zani we shall rise!

me_saptarum_19_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_12$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_20_desc.text: A whole year as passed since the rebuilding of #Y Wegalia#! was started. #Y Dwarf#! and #Y Human#! alike have worked side-by-side to rebuild the damage done by marauding bandits, rouge soldiers, and the King's revenge. Together, the #Y Galmar#! and the #Y Leslesi#! have been able to repopulate the ruined cities of #Y Wegalia#!, bringing peace and stability to the lands East of the #G Wall of God#!.\n\nTruly our people have been blessed by the great [GetCharacter('(int32)64').GetName|Y] and [GetCharacter('(int32)74').GetName|Y], as we can finally work towards a lasting peace with the #Y Geallians#! who we've spent hundred of years hating.

me_saptarum_20_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_13$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_21_desc.text:
With the pretender defeated, the merchant families of [GetCountry('SV2').GetName|T] gather and agree that change must occur to ensure that a threat like this can never arise again.

First, it was agreed that the family rivalries must not get in the way of governance. The former #Y Family Council#! will be divided evenly between the three families, with each one receiving five seats on it for a total of fifteen council members. #Y One of our#! members will be elected as the #Y Hatamögg#!, or 'Speaker', for our council and be the face of our Republic abroad.

Secondly, the new council will pass civic reforms to restrict citizenship and therefore political power and education to the upper classes to ensure that the bureaucracy remains in our control.

Finally, this council intends to pass army reforms to allow only citizens to lead armies, cementing our control over the military. To ensure we have enough manpower, any freeman who serves in the military for more than ten years will gain citizenship for them and their descendants.

The '#Y #G Thyrr Ubaturren#!#!', or '#Y Three Reforms#!', as they come to be known as, will be fundamental in ensuring stability in our new republic.

me_saptarum_21_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_14$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_22_desc.text: Annexing the people of [GetProvince('(int32)2651').GetName|G] has brought both their resources and manpower into the capable hands of our republic. Having solidified our power, we can now look to expand our influence throughout the region!

me_saptarum_22_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_15$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_23_desc.text: The newfound partnership between the new council and the #G #E Leslesi#!#! chiefs has brought much strength to our burgeoning republic!\n\nWhile they're able to provide us with their fearsome warriors and skilled trackers, our administrators and traders help them found permanent large settlements where the chiefs can increase their own personal wealth as well as grow the wealth of their communities!

me_saptarum_23_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_16$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_24_desc.text: Initially arriving as exiled traders, our people managed to coexist with the xenophobic #R #E Orcish#!#! colonists when they first arrived over two centuries ago. However, their continued hostile expansion into #Y Northern Morrigon#! has made such cooperation inevitable, as they took our rightful lands as well as much of our influence in the #G Orcish Sea#!!\n\nNow, the tides have finally turned and we have reclaimed our lands and the #Y Orcish Sea Trade#!!

me_saptarum_24_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_17$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_25_desc.text: The #R #E Emzali#!#! and #Y #R Munthzali#!#! tribes of to our south have raided our lands and disrupted our trade for centuries. However, with help from our #G #E Leslesi#!#! allies they shall terrorize our people no more! Our armies now march through their hovels, teaching these savage brutes to respect our power!

me_saptarum_25.a.text: The humans will kneel to us

me_saptarum_25_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_18$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_26_desc.text: People from nearby villages have flocked to see our great #G Merchant Fleet#! set sail!\n\nWith this new navy, pirates and raiders seeking to wreck havoc upon ports or fishing villages will be a concern of the past, as republican sails will instill fear into the hearts of pirates. The safety our sailors provide shall pursuade merchants from across the #G Orcish Sea#! to trade in our ports, providing our kingdom with wealth unseen since the #Y Saptan Golden Age#!!

me_saptarum_26_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_19$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_27_desc.text: The new #G #E Leslesi#!#! colonies bustle with life as our more urbanized and civilized allies impart their knowledge and culture onto the more savage #R #E Borderlander#!#! and #R #E Celtican#!#! tribesmen that occupy the lands near the #G Marshlands#!!\n\nWith help from our allies, these new friendly centers of administration have been able to increase our dominion over the south!

me_saptarum_27.a.text: We shall grow alongside our allies!

me_saptarum_27_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_20$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_28_desc.text: Two distinguished council members talk at the formers mansion, admiring a piece he commissioned from the famous #Y Gavnn Hraldhrtt#!\n\nThe small silver figure is meant to resemble the patron, with its features ornately carved and clothes decorated with golden buttons. The two men murmur their opinions, not allowing the other to hear their true thoughts on the piece. Finally, the guest speaks up:

me_saptarum_28.a.text: I dont really get this piece, but it looks expensive!

me_saptarum_28_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_21$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_29_desc.text: The wealth flowing into our nation has led the many wealthy noblemen and traders to seek finer luxuries and artistic crafts that aim to surpass even the great works of silver from the #T First Kingdom of Srrørum#!!\n\nRecently, numerous traders and artists have appeared at council meetings to push forward plans for a new meeting hall. This #Y 'Great Hall'#!, while expensive, may provide patronage to our new artists as well as create a lavish symbol of the power of our republic!

me_saptarum_29_tooltip.text: #Y We will begin construction on the #E Sørrsalla#!!#!

me_saptarum_30_desc.text:
My #Y Hatamögg#!, our great project is now complete!

The #Y Sørrsalla#!, or #Y Great Hall#!, is a large pantheon-like building made of marble and furnished with great chairs and tables of fine wood and cloth. The main room is filled with silver statues of our ancestors and noblemen while the golden heads of mythical beasts look down at guests from the ceiling. Looking around, visitors notice the walls of this great room are lined with large woolen tapestries of our greatest achievements, battles, statesmen, and warriors.

While this project could be considered expensive,  in return we now host a physical symbol of our wealth and authority to the masses and to the wider world!

me_saptarum_30_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_22$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_31_desc.text:
Long ago, we made the foolish mistake of thinking that our city's naturally defensible position would protect us from invaders, and our hubris led to our destruction. Now we face a new problem of overpopulation, as our ancient city cannot adequately house or sustain the influx of people that are migrating here.

With some careful planning, we are able to solve both problems. By patronizing artists and architects to rebuild our city, a new metropolis can arise out of the embers of our old capital. Walls as tall as the great #Y Walls of God#! that surround our city now rise out of the ground around our new capital, capable of defending attacks from even mighty dragons!

With these new improvements, our city has truly ascended to become one of the few #Y Sørrborr#!, or 'Great #G Metropolis#!' of the #Y Dwarven#! World!

me_saptarum_31_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_23$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_32_desc.text:
After weeks of negotiations and debates, the leaders of both parties have managed to find a compromise. The following series of laws, known to all as the '#Y #G Ubaturren ulfton Thorgarren#!#!', or #Y #G Reforms of the Citizens#!#!, are passed:
1 - Citizenship will be extended to all freemen regardless of prior military service.
2 - The council, now called the '#Y Sørrhlturr#!', the Great Thing, will be split into two branches. The '#Y Ghlattanvindr#!', or Father House, will be made up of 15 members of the Great Merchant families just like during the times of the #G Thyrr Ubaturren#!, while the '#Y Arnnanvindr#!', or Son House, will be made up of 100 representatives elected by their fellow citizens. Election terms for the #Y Ghlattanvindr#! will be 4 years while it will be every two years for the #Y Arnnhtlurr#!.
3 - The #Y Hatamögg#! role will be elected from #Y Ghlattanvindr#! every four years by the members of the #Y Arnnanvindr#! and serve as the face of the republic in international affairs, commander in chief of the army, and ensure laws passed by the #Y Sørrhlturr#! are enforced onto the nation.
4 - The #Y Ghlattanvindr#! will be in charge of commercial and military affairs while the #Y Arnnanvindr#! will be in charge of civilian and naval affairs. Both can present possible legislation which can be vetoed by the other. The #Y Ghlattanvindr#! requires a majority vote to pass legislation while the #Y Arnnanvindr#! required 3/4ths agreement to pass legislation. Possible legislation must be passed by both houses to become law.

Having formed a new government, the first #Y Sørrhlturr#! makes a unanimous decision. No longer are we a simple 'rum', as we are no longer waiting for a king to return. Our new republic, born from the unity of the #Y Saptan#! people, will be called #Y #G Srrøveldi#!#!, or the #Y #G Silver Republic#!#!.

me_saptarum_32_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_23$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_saptarum_33_desc.text: The rising support for universal #Y Leslesi#! citizenship has led to numerous debates in both the #Y Ghlattanvindr#! and the #Y Arnnanvindr#! and between the two houses. Weeks passed with no meaningful solutions or compromises passed until one shocking announcement changed the debates altogether. A pair of bright young #Y Leslesi#! statesmen were adopted into the #Y Segurrvelk#! family by an older retired merchant who had no heirs. The brothers, #Y Vodenos#! and #Y Cavarus#!, debated together with their new platform, their exemplary oratory skills making many old guard senators sympathetic towards #Y Leslesi#! citizenship.\n\nFinally, after around a year of debates and legislation, the '#Y #G Janirr Thorgarren#!#!' #Y Laws#! were finally passed by both houses, granting universal citizenship to all freemen of #Y Leslesi#! descent as well as equal status and rights as #Y Galmar#! dwarves.

me_saptarum_33_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_saptarum_task_24$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

01_seekers_DESCRIPTION.text:
Almost seventy years ago, a shepherd that was known as #Y Cerwain the Hermit#! was tending to his flocks when the ground began to tremble and a soft light enveloped the frightened old man. Fearing for his life, #Y Cerwain#! felt a voice speak from inside him, sharing a simple message of hope; 'The Way will be revealed.'

In the years to come, the encounter that the hermit had on the Hill Ganara outside the city of [GetProvince('(int32)3502').GetName|G] in #G Celtica#! would become known as the #T Revelation#!, and the #Y Message#! that was revealed to that simple farmer would become a riddle destined to topple ancient dynasties from their thrones, scattering the mighty nations and causing brother to kill brother...

'Seek nothing but the #Y Way#!; turn from your families, your children, your gods, your loved ones. Seek nothing but the Way; abandon your ancestors and your oaths, set aside your traditions, let the graves of your forefathers be covered by darkness until they are forgotten. #Y Nothing#! matters but the Way; it is the Way above everything else that must be Sought.'

01_seekers_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when the #Y Seekers#! have formed an Autocratic Monarchy, one dedicated to spreading the light and Seeking the Way that dispels all darkness.

01_seekers_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: The heretic faiths of Morrigon shall perish in the purifying flames of inquisition!

01_seekers_task_1_DESC.text: One of the earliest passages in the #Y Annals of the Grand Inquisitor#!, a history of the #Y Seeker#! Faith and its founding mythos, describes the heroic wars waged between the earliest #Y Seekers#! and the dwarven town dwellers of #G Celtica#! in an account known as #Y The Northern Hebric Omostthanat#!.\n\nAccording to the Annals, once the #Y Way That Is True#! began to be taught in the valleys of #G Celtica#!, a few pious Kings surrendered their authority to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetName|T], who then led the people to attack the decadent #T Hebric#! dwarves that lived in the northern mountains.

01_seekers_task_2_DESC.text: If we have any hopes of maintaining our control over the lands that we conquer, then we must have a #Y Secret Police#! that will secretly work to maintain peace throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] while hunting down the enemies that threaten the Way.

01_seekers_task_3_DESC.text: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetName|T] finds its power to be diluted, too decentralized, and that is because there are too many Grand Masters ruling independently - there should be only one, and it must be [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]. Now that the dwarven abomination has been driven out from among us, we must quell dissenting voices and unite the various Councils under the banner of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T].

01_seekers_task_4_DESC.text: We cannot refrain from spreading the message of the Way, but must forcibly convert those that are unwilling to join the Path of Truth and Light. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] will not rest until our countrymen have embraced the #Y Message#!.

01_seekers_task_5_DESC.text: In order to celebrate the victories that our levies have won for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has declared a ten year period of jubilee - one for each of the provinces that our mighty Knights have taken for the faithful.

01_seekers_task_6_DESC.text: While the unrestricted use of magic has been blamed for the #Y Great Collapse#! and the world-shattering cataclysms that followed, the #Y Seeker#! #Y Council#! cannot afford to ignore this potential source of strength. Instead of letting the mages run amok, however, we shall train them in the proper use of the arcane at a #Y Warlock Academy#! we will build in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].

01_seekers_task_6_tt.text: Our ruler will study the arcane arts at our #Y Academy#! and will receive a randomized #G School of Magic#! trait.

01_seekers_task_7_DESC.text: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetName|T] has issued a command from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] regarding that status of the subjugated dwarves living within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T]. There are rumors that soulgems @soulgems! have been found in [GetProvince('(int32)3406').GetName|G], and it is the wish of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] that the #Y Copper Dwarf#! returns to the mines that his people are so familiar with.

01_seekers_task_8_DESC.text: The #Y Copper Dwarves#! that used to live in these provinces before the #Y Northern Hebric Omostthanat#! destroyed their kingdoms were mostly farmers, simple workers tending to the rich black soil that kept their granaries filled. With their lands depopulated, the time has come for faithful #Y Seekers#! to take advantage of the bountiful farmlands available to us and send in eager settlers.

01_seekers_task_9_DESC.text: The region of #G Celtica#! was destined to be the birthplace of the #Y Seeker Beliefs#!, and once the Way has been embraced by the majority of peoples living within our mountainous valley, we will proclaim ourselves to the world as the 'Founders of the Way' - the nation that brought true religion to #G Morrigon#!.

01_seekers_task_10.text: The Holy Order Of The Seekers

01_seekers_task_10_DESC.text: In the greatest triumph ever recorded by #Y Seeker#! historians, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has conquered a worthy nation for the people within the heartlands of #G Celtica#!, taking the entire region for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetName|T].\n\nNow, the time has come to proclaim the arrival of the #Y Holy Order of the Seekers#! - we shall not rest until the light of the Way is shared with all of the apostate kingdoms of #G Omniluxia#!.

01_seekers_task_11_DESC.text: Slowly, by degrees, the #Y Seeker#! Faith has spread throughout the northern provinces of #G Celtica#!. As the Way guides our path forward, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetName|T] has declared that we shall not rest until we have freed the south from the tyranny of religious oppression.

01_seekers_task_12_DESC.text: Now that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has grown to a respectable size, it has been suggested that we send messages to the remaining [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetName|T]s that do not recognize our authority and tell them the time has come to submit.

01_seekers_task_13_DESC.text: Now that we have secured possession of the region of #G Celtica#!, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetName|T] has insisted that we built fortresses at the three entrances to our valley. We must not allow the enemies of the Way to have easy access to our core territories!

01_seekers_task_14_DESC.text: As our grip continues to tighten on the northern territories within the region of #G Celtica#!, our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], riding high from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] string of impressive victories, has announced that the people of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] must complete the unfinished tasks of the #Y Northern Hebric Omostthanat#! by destroying the other dwarven kingdoms around us.\n\nFor the first time in our history, our levies will march for the #G Morrigan Mountains#! to the west and cast down the abominable dwarves that live there.

01_seekers_task_15_DESC.text: As the glory and light of the Way spreads throughout the lands within our dominions, our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has received a gift from the craftsmen living within the city of [GetProvince('(int32)3502').GetName|G] - an exquisitely-crafted weapon that is known as the #Y Grand Maul of the Seeker Inquisitor#!.

03_srrorum_DESCRIPTION.text:
With the #G Green Valley#! united for the first time in centuries, our people can now focus on reclaiming the full borders of #Y [GetCharacter('(int32)64').GetFirstName]'s Kingdom#!. Our people once built great cities across the #Y Gorrskkóen Forests#!, along the rocky coasts of the #G Southern Sea#!, and deep inside the #G Dragon's Pass#!!

The end of our Golden Age is filled with mysteries, but certain grudges have withstood the test of time. Following the death of the #Y Sacred Pair#!, our lands were invaded by #T Elves#!, #T Hobgoblins#!, and #Y Dragkhans#!, pitiful races that envied our lavish cities. Our people were pushed back to our homeland of the #G Green Valley#! with a few scattered settlements across #G Morrigon#!. Slowly, those that resisted were destroyed and forgotten.

With #G Srrørum#! restored, our people can once again dream of #Y Srrøkheim#!, and recreating #G Southern Morrigon#! in our image!

03_srrorum_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] conquers all of #G Southern Morrigon#!.

03_srrorum_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: Let us follow the dream of Srrøkheim!

03_srrorum_task_1_DESC.text: Now that we've united the valley under our banner, it's time to dream bigger. Long ago, our ancestors controlled nearly all of #G Southern Morrigon#!, from the #G Green Valley#! to the #G Dragon's Pass#!. The first step to retake our empire will be to look beyond the confines of our homeland.

03_srrorum_task_2_DESC.text: #Y Just#! as the #Y Western Gate#! protects us from #Y #R Elven#!#! raiders, the #G Eastern Gate#! has prevented #Y Silver Dwarven#! war bands from invading the hill tribes of the #Y Western Lungs Forest#!. If we have any hopes of reaching the #G Dragon's Pass#!, we must first conquer the entrance to the lands of the #Y #R Western Wood Elves#!#!!

03_srrorum_task_3_DESC.text: What used to be #Y Gorrskkóen Forest#! was changed irreversibly millennia ago by #Y #R Wood Elven#!#! immigrants, who introduced the #Y #R Yaga Trees#!#! which came to dominate the landscape and created what is now the #Y Western Lungs Forest#!. Filled with mana, these trees are practically impossible to burn, live for centuries, and affect the environment around them, creating dangerous #Y #R Fai#!#! out of what used to be the surrounding fauna and flora. While the #Y #R Wood Elves#!#! thrive in this environment, those trees are the main reason nearly any invasion of their territory is met with failure.\nFortunately, #Y Human#! mages from the #G Dragonscale School of Defensive Magic#! have been teaching the #Y Zare Jad#! style in [GetProvince('(int32)3988').GetName|G], which, with some investment, might be able to shield our armies from the various hazards found in the #Y #R Eldritch Forests#!#!!

03_srrorum_task_4_DESC.text: With our armies prepared, we must learn from previous armies who have attempted and failed to invade the vast Eldritch Forests of the Western Wood #T Elves#!. Our opponents are divided into many tribes, a fact we can exploit. If we strike fast and ensure our armies are safe from the Fai, we can dominate the #Y Western Lungs Forest#!!

03_srrorum_task_5_DESC.text: While we try to control the unruly #T Elves#!, we should be wary of the opportunistic Cumbrians to our west. Securing our border is the only way to prevent a future invasion of our new holdings during a time of weakness!

03_srrorum_task_6_DESC.text: The Three Silokhai, or Silk #G Cities#!, of the #Y Admadi#! #T Elves#! are the most sophisticated urban centers in the #Y Western Lungs Forest#!, as well as the largest silk producers in all of #G Morrigon#!. Needing to more effectively control the elves, we could develop these cities into centers of administration for us to better manage our new conquests!

03_srrorum_task_7_DESC.text: Once, the #Y Gorrskkóen Forest#! was home to large cities such as Steffanskkópiabi and Gorrvlikkabi, cities that were consumed by the unending forests that the #G Elven#! invaders brought. Overwhelming us with their forest magic, our cities and communities were lost, and we were confined to the #G Green Valley#!. However, we are once again the masters of the now #G Western World Lungs#! Forest, and we should send #Y Anvindr#! settlers to go and reclaim our cities from the #G Elven#! trespassers and their demonic eldritch forests.

03_srrorum_task_8_DESC.text: Through our conquests we've found ourselves in possession of vast lands suitable for ports. With some investment, we can make ourselves an important player in the #G Southern Sea#! Trade, exporting vast amounts of minerals and wood from our new ports to fill our coffers!

03_srrorum_task_9_DESC.text: Having full control over the Western Lungs Forests, we must continue east towards to #G Dragon's Pass#!. In our path stand the unruly #Y Dragkhan#! tribes of the Western Plains as well as the few #Y Sovenerian#! holdings who block us from reaching our final goal. Defeating them will be tough, however, their conquests will serve as excellent experience for our soldiers, who will eventually have to face the fiercer #T Hobgoblins#! to the North.

03_srrorum_task_10_DESC.text: At long last we have managed to make it to the mountains of the #G Dragon's Pass#!. Our veteran soldiers now face the armies of the #Y Ahualtzi#! #T Hobgoblins#!. Hardened by centuries of invasions and raids from #T Dragkhanic#! tribes and neighboring #G Hobgoblin#! states, the #Y Ahualtzi#! are formidable warriors and the mountainous nature of their homeland will make it difficult for our forces. However, victory should be a needed morale boost for our tired soldiers.

03_srrorum_task_11_DESC.text: Having conquered the #Y Ahualtzi#!, we now face the formidable kingdoms of the #Y Droishu#! and #Y Shoishoni#!. Organized around the two major cities of #Y Driotrai#! and Tlazcal, their armies are numerous and their conquest will be difficult. However, the #Y Urhuk#! nomads of the east mirror the #T Hobgoblins#! that razed the great #Y Silver Dwarven#! cities of the #G Dragon's Pass#!, and their conquest will be particularly cathartic for our people.

03_srrorum_task_12_DESC.text: Having defeated the #G Hobgoblin#! threat, our former friends, the Sovenarians, and the #Y Borderlander#! tribes of the North now look hungrily at the chaos we've created. To secure our holdings, it's imperative that we control all of the entrances of the #G Dragon's Pass#!, from the unruly northern kingdom of the #Y Jishani#!, to the savage #G Kana'i#! goblin tribes of the Inner #G Dragon's Pass#!.

03_srrorum_task_14_DESC.text: The oldest tablets in #Y Veddtunn#! tell of grand #Y Silver Dwarven#! cities that towered above the bleak landscape of the #G Dragon's Pass#!; Hthgartgerrpiabi, Hæjbaenabi, Ásennabi. Rebuilding these ancient cities will attract more migrants and stronger control over our new lands!

03_srrorum_task_15_DESC.text: Records from the #Y Mythic Age#! are hard to find, but oral traditions describe our ancestors as the most advanced in the world, able to produce unbreakable #Y Mythril#! and long-lasting #Y Dverpi#! Coal in large quantities and with ease. By sending out explorers, adventurers, and academics into the #G Dragon's Pass#! we may be able to find fragments of their forgotten technology that we may be able to use.

03_srrorum_task_16_DESC.text: While our forefathers dreamed of a restoration of #G Srrørum#!, we dream bigger, we dream grander, we dream of empire; of #Y Srrøkheim#!, the Empire of the #Y Silver Dwarves#!.

03_srrorum_task_17_DESC.text: Now that we control both sides of the pass that leads into the #G Green Valley#!, we must ensure that our homeland can never again be threatened by outside invaders. Fortifying both of the gates should make the entrance to the #G Green Valley#! impenetrable!

03_srrorum_task_18_DESC.text: Long ago in the #Y Mythic Age#!, we were ruled by the legendary #G Hthgart 'to Vernunghaltt'#!, who was known for his large infrastructure projects. Perhaps one of his most famous projects were the Royal Roads, stretching from the Sacred #Y Silver Caves#! to the #G Eastern Gate#!, connecting all of the #G Green Valley#! to the outside world. With the passing centuries his work has decayed to mere dirt roads and paths. It is time that we honor our dear father and rebuild his vast road network.

03_srrorum_task_19_DESC.text: With our conquest of foreign peoples and our embrace of foreign ideas, many new heretical beliefs have begun permeating our society. In order to strengthen belief in the ancestors, a series of grand temples must be built in the major cities of the valley to house and organize a priesthood that can help enforce the proper traditions and rituals that have been uniquely present in #Y Silver Dwarven#! society and religion since the #Y Mythic Age#!!

03_srrorum_task_20_DESC.text: Long considered the center of the universe by our people, the #Y Silver Caves#! near #G Srrøvikkabi#! are the holiest site in the #Y Silver Dwarven#! world. However, the city of #G Srrøvikkabi#! itself isn't as grand. While it is the home of the #T Order of Sennmoggen#!, it does not have enough housing or temples for the great influx of pilgrims that arrive each year.\n\nWith some investment, we can turn this minor stop on the way to the caves into a grand center of our faith!

03_srrorum_task_21_DESC.text: #G Veddabi#! is the educational and magical heart of our nation. To be able to catch up to the better developed magic and technology of the outside world, we should ensure that the '#Y City#! of Knowledge' is rebuilt to house much more than just a couple of academies for noble students!
