03_srrorum_task_22_DESC.text: The #Y Gerrmoggen#!, or 'Mountain Men', have been causing chaos and performing esoteric magic in the hills of the #G Green Valley#! since the #Y Mythic Age#!. Their isolation from other mages and unique terrain has led them to develop a unique style that is not seen anywhere else in #G Omniluxia#!.\n\nOur mages at Veddborr are eager to attract as many of these magical wanderers as possible to establish the first domestic #Y Silver Dwarven#! magic school at the recently expanded Veddborr. With some funding and encouragement from the state, we could help create and spread this new style among new #Y Anvindr#! #Y Mages#!.

03_srrorum_task_23_DESC.text: Due to increasing urbanization, our cities are attracting new migrants that are contributing to a boom in our population. However, due to the limited amount of arable land in the valley and the increased demand for food, there are many concerns that our cities will starve.\n\nA group of academics have recently reached out to the King to ask for funding for a new research project that could solve this problem. The #Y Verobaen#! Farms of the #Y Mythic Age#! were large farms carved into the mountains that created artificial arable land. With our help, they might be able to create new farms in a similar style that could replicate the #Y Verobaen#! Farms of old!

me_srrorum_1_desc.text: While the defenders of [GetProvince('(int32)4085').GetName|G].GetName] are used to repelling #Y Dwarven#! raiders, they were not prepared to deal with for our large, organized army! Their pitiful defenses stood no chance against our forces, falling to our kingdom quickly and swiftly! With the #G Eastern Gate#! now in our possession, we can finally look towards #G Elven#! lands with the intent of conquest!

me_srrorum_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_2_desc.text: Standing at the very edge of his kingdom, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] and his army watch as the magicians step forwards to cast their magic. Prayers are uttered, men shuffle nerviously, and it seems like the whole army is holding its breath. These mages have trained for months or even years to be capable of casting such spells. If they succeed, the mana shields around our men should protect them from the harmful effects of the #Y Yaga#! Trees as well as hide them from the #R Fai#!. However, should they fail, the entire expedition into the forest becomes an impossible task.\n\nSuddenly, a spark of light. The warm glow of mana embraced the army as each man is surrounded by a small outline of bright light shining no brighter than the final embers of a small flame. Cheers erupt throughout the ranks as the entire army seems to release a sigh of relief. Most relieved is [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], who addresses his men:

me_srrorum_2.a.text: Let us reclaim the Gorrskkóen for the Silver Dwarves!

me_srrorum_2_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_3_desc.text: The #T Elves#! put up a good fight, their knowledge of the land has allowed them to claim the lives of many of our strongest warriors. However, dwarven discipline and bravery has proven victorious! Protected from the vicious #R #E Fai#!#! by our mages, our forces were able to tame the forests!\n\nThe once divided tribes now kneel before us or face exile, as their new sovereign [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] will decide the ultimate fate of the #Y Gorrskkóen#!.

me_srrorum_3_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_4$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_4_desc.text:
It has been many centuries since we last contacted any of the tribes of man. Although some knowledge of the outside world eventually made its way to the #G Green Valley#!, our people still remained under the impression that the various human tribes served the #Y #R Great Empire of the Eagle#!#! that attacked us in the time of #Y Hefdarr#!. Thus, it came to us as a surprise when our #T Dragkhanic#! subjects informed us that their empire, the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|T], had succeeded those who called themselves '#Y Zanni#!'.

However, our people have been shocked once again when we took the hills of the west of the #Y Gorrskkóen#! from the humans who inhabited it. They state that their people, the '#Y Kerrnowans#!', are the true descendants of the #Y Zanni#!! To the chagrin of our confused sovereign, those in the hills to the north claim that their ancestors fought against the #Y Zanni#!! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] pities these poor humans, as their short lives mean they cannot even remember the history of their ancestors.

Regardless of whether these men are descendants of the #Y Great Empire of the Eagle#!, we must now rule them. The generals suggest administering their lands from the great fortress-city of [GetProvince('(int32)4184').GetName|G], while the nobility lay claim to the wealthy city of [GetProvince('(int32)4135').GetName|G] and petition the king to allow them to govern the province.

me_srrorum_4.b.text: [GetProvince('(int32)4135').GetName] shall govern the so-called tribes of the Zanni

me_srrorum_4_tooltip.a.text: #Y [GetProvince('(int32)4184').GetName] will become the capital of our #E Zanazi-Vetalians#! holdings!#!

me_srrorum_4_tooltip.b.text: #Y [GetProvince('(int32)4135').GetName] will become the capital of our #E Zanazi-Vetalians#! holdings!#!

me_srrorum_5_desc.text:
My Lord, with the conquest of the #Y Gorrskkóen#! completed the nigh herculean task of governing it now arises. Both #G Elven#! and #Y Dwarven#! petitioners have arrived in your court, asking for you to verify their claims.

Despite being few in number, the #T Elves#! still outnumber us and a revolt could pose a significant risk to the stability of the region. Many pragmatic #G Elven#! lords and chieftains have decided to switch their allegiances and serve you in exchange for large swathes of lands for them to govern. While they might not be trustworthy, it may be worth it to placate these local leaders to quell discontent amongst our new subjects.

I hope not to burden you with this information, but many of your dwarven subjects have presented their own petitions. The various citizens, nobles, and administrators whether involved in the conquest or not are asking your highness for land and the honor to govern the new territories. While guaranteed to be somewhat more trustworthy than the #T Elves#!, I don't believe our new subjects will take to these outsiders too kindly.

The decision is yours my lord.

me_srrorum_5.b.text: Dwarves would do a much better job at managing them

me_srrorum_5_tooltip.a.text: #Y We will employ local #E Elven#! rulers to administer the #E Western World's Lungs#!!#!

me_srrorum_5_tooltip.b.text: #Y We will employ #E Dwarven#! administrators to control the #E Western World's Lungs#!!#!

me_srrorum_6_desc.text:
My Lord, I hate to bring such heavy decisions to you once more, but the petitioners seeking an audience with you has tripled since our last discussion!

The #T Elves#! demand to have their lands respected and protected against incoming dwarven settlers. Their detached worldview wouldn't make it too difficult to coexist with them as long as we allow them space to roam and resume their semi-nomadic lifestyle.

However, many dwarven subjects, eager to follow the dream of #Y Srrøkheim#!, seek lands in the forests. While alone their settlements might face the terrors of the forest, they intend to stick together and resettle legendary cities of old. However, their colonies will directly clash with the #T Elves#! seeking to migrate around what they see as their traditional lands. Worse, many of them call for the expulsion or even eradication of the #T Elves#! living in these areas, giving into their demands will surely lead to violence!

As the King, the call is yours to make.

me_srrorum_6.a.text: Htgarth's Children shall once again inhabit the Gorrskkóen!

me_srrorum_6.b.text: Perhaps we can avoid more bloodshed...

me_srrorum_6_tooltip.a.text: #Y We will expel the local #E Elves#! and resettle the forest with #E Dwarven#! colonists!#!

me_srrorum_6_tooltip.b.text: #Y We will attempt to coexist with the local #E Elves#!!#!

me_srrorum_7_desc.text: For the first time since the #T First Kingdom of Srrørum#! our people once again sail on clear waters of the #G Southern Sea#!! However, we still have much to learn from these #Y Zannisonn#!. The guile of their merchants are only challenged by the bartenders of [GetProvince('(int32)3947').GetName|G], and they are important members of our new port cities.\n\nWith our coast secured, we can now look east, towards the untamed western #T Dragkhanic#! tribes and the rumored #G Hobgoblin#! horde.

me_srrorum_7_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_8$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_8_desc.text:
[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] faces the defeated Qhans of the #Y Dragonland Steppes#!.

Their pitiful cavalry torn to shreds by #G Elven#! bows and #Y Silver Dwarven#! heavy cavalry, the Qhans have had no choice but to surrender and petition the King to allow them to continue grazing their lands. Procuring several strong #T Dragkhanic#! mounts, they offer them to the King as a sign of submission.

[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] graciously accepts their gifts, and allows them to return to their families with promises of peace. Although they are violent and unruly, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has made sure that he has broken their spirit, such that the tribes will not embark on the war path for many years.

me_srrorum_8_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_9$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_9_desc.text: After much intense fighting, we have gotten a foothold into #G Hobgoblin#! territory! Many #Y Shoishoni#!, already enemies of the ruling #Y Droishu#! horde, have even joined our ranks to fight against the #Y Zalthu#! line.\n\nNow all that stands in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s way of reclaiming #Y Srrøkheim#! is the great city of [GetProvince('(int32)4721').GetName|G], stronghold of the descendants of #Y Girm the Conqueror#!!

me_srrorum_9_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_10_desc.text:
[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] had been consulting his generals in his tent when he heard the news. After months of grueling siege the great city of [GetProvince('(int32)4721').GetName|G] had finally fallen to his forces!

A large force of soldiers had forced their way through a destroyed section of the city's walls, causing chaos amongst the defenders who were overwhelmed by our numbers. Its only a matter of time before the seat of the #Y Zalthu#! clan belongs to the king.

However, just as those present begin to celebrate, the messenger also informs them of the great slaughter occurring in the city. He claims that many men have grown wild, seeking revenge for the #G Hobgoblin#!'s past transgressions against the #Y Silver Dwarves#!. There are tales of fires, looting, and killing of both #T Hobgoblins#! and foreigners found in the #Y Boblo District#!. If nothing is done, surely the city shall be razed to the ground!

[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] leans back in his chair, pausing before he gives his response.

me_srrorum_10.a.text: Discipline the men, we are better than this!

me_srrorum_10_tooltip.a.text: #Y [GetProvince('(int32)4721').GetName] will be spared from being sacked!#!

me_srrorum_11_desc.text:
With the conquest of the #Y Inner Dragon's Pass#! the distant #Y Dolin#! have finally been reunited with us!

Lost centuries ago, many tales of an independent #Y Silver Dwarven#! kingdom to the south of the #G Green Valley#! had been circulating for decades, however none believed it to be true until we regained contact with them after our conquest of the #Y Goblins#!! Their civilization radiating from their great city of [GetProvince('(int32)5562').GetName|G], these dwarves seem to have a unique relationship with the typically hostile #Y Goblins#! we now find ourselves ruling.

With many #Y Dolin#! immigrating back to the #G Green Valley#! there have been ideas petitioned by local #Y Dolin#! nobility to allow them to rule the lands of the #Y Inner Dragon's Pass#! in the king's name.

me_srrorum_11.a.text: They shall serve as my vassals

me_srrorum_11_tooltip.a.text: #Y The #E Dolin#! will be given their own kingdom!#!

me_srrorum_11_tooltip.b.text: #Y The #E Dolin#! will remain under our rule!#!

me_srrorum_12_desc.text: With the majority of our ancestral homelands now under our control once more, the glorious conquests and flashy battles can now slow as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] prepares to secure his new holdings.\n\nWith the #G Green Valley#! at capacity, many families are eager to return to the lands once held by their ancestors and claim their own homesteads. These serfs and freemen have petitioned the king for lands in the new territories. Seeing this as an opportunity to secure the former lands of the aggressive #T Hobgoblins#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has decided to pragmatically support their requests.

me_srrorum_12_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_12$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_13_desc.text: #G Opoea#!, known to #Y Htgarth#! as #Y Sennhæjen#!, is a land rich with minerals and defined by beautiful mountains and valleys. Due to its similarity to the #G Green Valley#! it has become a popular destination for many new settlers.\n\nChoosing to name their settlements after legendary cities of #Y Silver Dwarven#! history, the settlers have been allotted the following lands to administer the province:

me_srrorum_13.a.text: [GetProvince('(int32)4146').GetName], the land of iron and rich soils

me_srrorum_13.b.text: [GetProvince('(int32)4049').GetName], a land of beautiful green hills

me_srrorum_14_desc.text: #G Storanê#!, once known as #Y Hjallilantpi#!, is home to large quantities of #G Hobgoblin#! tribes, including the once-great city of [GetProvince('(int32)4721').GetName|G].\n\nSome nobles have petitioned the King to allow them to rule the province from this great urban center. However, many families ask that the king allot them lands in [GetProvince('(int32)3991').GetName|G], which would serve as a capital of the region.

me_srrorum_14.a.text: [GetProvince('(int32)4721').GetName] shall remain the capital of Storanê

me_srrorum_15_desc.text: #G Borysthenes#!, called Ausvlien in our histories, is home to both the wild #Y Urhuk#! horsemen as well as the #Y Shoishoni#! wizards, rivals of the #Y Droishu#!.\n\nThe only other urban center that could call itself a city in the valley, [GetProvince('(int32)4187').GetName|G], has become a target of petitions by nobility who seek to lay claim to the riches of the city and the region. However, groups of freemen have petitioned the king for weeks to allot them lands in the fertile plains of the #Y Urhuk#!, serving as a regional capital that could tame the unruly nomads.

me_srrorum_15.a.text: [GetProvince('(int32)4187').GetName], home of the wizards, shall serve as the capital

me_srrorum_15.b.text: The fertile plains of [GetProvince('(int32)4147').GetName] will tame Borysthenes

me_srrorum_16_desc.text: The #Y Inner Dragon's Pass#! is home to various #Y Goblin#! tribes as well as the #Y Dolin Silver Dwarves#!, who have made their hold of [GetProvince('(int32)5562').GetName|G] one of the most breathtaking sights in all of #G Omniluxia#!!\n\nThe #Y Dolin#! petition the king to remain the capital of the new province, as their unique relationship with the #Y Goblins#! might command their respect and loyalty. However, many nobility petition the king to be given governorship of the region, and have recruited willing freemen and serfs who wish to enter the caverns to create a new life for themselves.

me_srrorum_16.a.text: Allow the Dolin of [GetProvince('(int32)5562').GetName] to rule the savages

me_srrorum_16.b.text: We shall build an even greater city in [GetProvince('(int32)5554').GetName]!

me_srrorum_17_desc.text: Excellent news my lord! Your initiatives and decrees have created many prosperous towns and cities all over the #G Dragon's Pass#!! What was once closer to a desolate wasteland has become a fertile land that benefits both #Y Dwarf#! and #G Hobgoblin#! alike!\n\nHowever, some of the local #T Hobgoblins#! have raised concerns of possible #R draconic#! activity. They claim the new wealth of the region may attract nearby #G Dragons#! who will wreck havoc upon the population to add to their hordes atop the impossibly tall #Y Dragon Mountains#!.

me_srrorum_17.a.text: You have to be a fool to believe such stories

me_srrorum_17_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_14$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_18_desc.text:
My Lord! Urgent news from the #G Dragon's Pass#!!

Rumors have circulated by many in the more rural areas of disappearances. Starting with sheep, it has escalated to the vanishment of entire households.

While this worrying news is something to be aware of, it is important to note that this information has not been corroborated by nearby towns, and remains hearsay in the countryside.

me_srrorum_18.a.text: These are tall tales from paranoid herders

me_srrorum_18_tooltip.text: #R We will wait for any confirmations to verify these reports...#!

me_srrorum_19_desc.text:
My liege, reports of attacks from the great dragon #Y Fjirno#! in the #G Dragon's Pass#! have been confirmed! Identified by his white scales, this ancient being has not been seen for at least two hundred years, with many claiming he was awoken by the noise made by the multitude of new cities in the #G Dragon's Pass#!

Attacks on villages have been stated to displace entire communities, with the attacks getting bolder after every incident. The latest report tells of an attack on a moderately sized city, in which around a third of the buildings were burnt down by the beast!

What shall we do [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]?

me_srrorum_19.a.text: Send a brave party of explorers to find the beast's lair!

me_srrorum_19.b.text: Ignore it, the monster will grow bored soon

me_srrorum_19_tooltip.a.text: #Y We will send scouts to find the Dragon's lair#!

me_srrorum_19_tooltip.b.text: #R We avoid confronting the Dragon.#! #Y (This will end the current event chain.)#!

me_srrorum_20_desc.text:
Great king, the explorers you sent have returned with news of the dragon's lair!

They claim to have found his horde, and one presents a detailed map of their journey through the #Y Dragon Mountains#!. They claim #Y Fjirno#! rests in a cave atop one of the lesser peaks, leaving every three days and returning again to rest for two.

With the information provided, there are two major options to consider. We could overwhelm the beast with our armies. Despite possibly losing many men, the monster is sure to be slain should we attack while he is sleeping.

Alternatively, you could lead a party of our best to attempt to slay the dragon yourself. However, this action may be very dangerous my liege, and I cannot recommend it.

me_srrorum_20.b.text: Prepare me a suit of armor capable of withstanding the Dragon's flames

me_srrorum_20_tooltip.a.text: #Y We will send in the army to eliminate the Dragon!#!

me_srrorum_20_tooltip.b.text: #Y The King will sally forth with a small party to defeat the Dragon!#!

me_srrorum_21_desc.text:
A great celebration is held in the streets of [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName|G], the #Y Dragon#! has been slain!

Despite taking many losses against the unforgiving mountains as well as #Y Fjirno the Terrible#! itself our men managed to return victorious with the dragon's head in tow!

Those who lived to tell the tale explain how they took the sleeping beast by surprise, and blinded the young wyrm so it could not properly defend itself. As it retreated into the cave, the men pressed on, noticing the large trails of blood the monster left behind. Trapped with nowhere to run, #Y Fjirno#! made his final stand, taking the lives of many brave warriors until he finally succumbed to his wounds.

These 'Rekkaisigrramoggen' have been given the highest honors by the king, and shall be remembered as the great heroes who felled the mighty #Y Fjirno the Terrible#!!

me_srrorum_21_tooltip.text: #G Despite great cost, the army has defeated the Dragon!#!

me_srrorum_22_title.text: The Fall of a Great King

me_srrorum_22_desc.text:
Hundreds gather in [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName|G] to mourn the loss of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y].

Our heroic King engaged in a mighty brawl against the accursed wyrm #Y Fjirno the Terrible#!, taking both of the monster's eyes as it slept. As it awoke it let out a terrible roar that froze all in the party besides the King, who continued to attack the weak points in the dragon's scales.

Writhing in pain, #Y Fjirno#! struck at one of the party members, ready to devour him whole. As the poor soul made his peace, our noble King dropped in front of him and struck the beast's maw, taking one of its teeth but being sent flying into a wall. It was then that the monster dealt a fatal blow to the King with its tail, and fled.

While the rest of the party was eventually able to drive away the heavily injured #Y Fjirno#!, there were unable to save [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y].

The tooth he recovered will be displayed as a trophy commemorating his bravery, and his body will be laid in the #Y Silver Caves#! to rest with his ancestors.

Despite his untimely demise, he will live forever as a god amongst his people.

me_srrorum_22_tooltip.text: #R The King has fallen in battle driving the Dragon back!#!

me_srrorum_23_desc.text: With the #G Dragon's Pass#! secured, many scholars from [GetProvince('(int32)3988').GetName|G] have taken an interest in the ancient land. Recounting ancient stories and histories, many of them have come to believe that ancient artifacts and relics dating back to the #Y Mythic Age#! could be found in the new territories!\n\nExcited by the prospect of finding these ancient treasures, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has decided to send out a large expedition of explorers to roam around certain regions that may contain such treasures.

me_srrorum_23.a.text: Our prize lies in the plains of [GetProvince('(int32)4196').GetName]!

me_srrorum_23.b.text: In the mountains of [GetProvince('(int32)4063').GetName] is where we shall find Htgarth's treasures!

me_srrorum_23.c.text: [GetProvince('(int32)4031').GetName] surely hosts the artifacts we seek!

me_srrorum_23_tooltip.a.text: #Y We will search for relics in [GetProvince('(int32)4196').GetName]!#!

me_srrorum_23_tooltip.b.text: #Y We will search for relics in [GetProvince('(int32)4063').GetName]!#!

me_srrorum_23_tooltip.c.text: #Y We will search for relics in [GetProvince('(int32)4031').GetName]!#!

me_srrorum_24_desc.text:
After much time members of the expedition have finally returned to the capital to present their findings to the King!

[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], eager to hear their report, is perplexed by their nervious demeanor. After a moment of awkward silence, the leader of the expedition musters his courage to give the King his report. Despite their fertile soils and bountiful harvests, the plains has not been able to produce any relics or treasures. The expedition has scoured every town, cavern, and hill but their explorers could not find any of the relics mentioned in the many histories of the #Y Mythic Age#!.

Silence ensues this report, as the expedition representatives seem to collectively hold their breaths. Much to their surprise, the King simply dismisses them, despondently stating:

me_srrorum_25_desc.text:
Months have passed since the court has received word from the expedition. Despite the lingering doubts of the explorer's success, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] remains hopeful that the expedition will return bearing treasure.

All of a sudden, a messenger arrives, bearing news of the successful return of the explorers!

Leaving his palace, the King is met with the expedition's leaders, who recount their struggles and journeys to find lost relics in the remote mountains of [GetProvince('(int32)4063').GetName|G]. Enchanted by their tales, the King listens as the explorer details the relic he encountered whilst traversing a cavern near the base of a mountain.

Revealing the relic to the King, he explains how he encountered the great #Y Konunvelkkon#!, one of the #Y Royal Drills#! of the #Y Royal Pair#!. Mentioned in a few legends, the #Y Royal Drill#! is a mechanism unseen anywhere in #G Omniluxia#!, a relic of a more advanced time where a single man could use this contraption to level mountains. With a tip made of #Y Mythril#! and powered by #Y Dverpi#! coal, these drills were thought to have been destroyed in order to keep them out of the hands of other invading races at the twilight of the #T First Kingdom of Srrørum#!.

Thrilled with this discovery, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] orders his best scholars to take the legendary tool back to #Y Veddtunn#! to be studied. While its complexity may prevent its use for many years or even decades, the King is determined to provide the gold his scholars require to unlock its secrets.

me_srrorum_25_tooltip.text: #G We have recovered the legendary #E Konunvelkkon#!!#!

me_srrorum_26_desc.text:
After many months of waiting, reports finally arrive from the expedition at [GetProvince('(int32)4031').GetName|G]!

While they lament that they have not found any relics, the expedition leaders report of a strange discovery that might interest your highness. In the hills they ran into a small isolated village where the people would create a black powder to create bursts of flames for their rituals. While initially hesitant to show outsiders their secrets, the elders caved to the explorer's threats of violence and taught them how to create the powder.

This powder, 'Aykkdidaft', while not the relics we have sought, may be useful to our scholars in #Y Veddtunn#!.

me_srrorum_26_tooltip.text: #Y We have discovered a strange explosive powder.#!

me_srrorum_27_desc.text:
'Millennia have passed since the fall of the #T First Kingdom of Srrørum#! and the loss of our homelands. The destruction of our cities. The loss of our power and wealth.'

'Reforming the great kingdom of #Y Hefdarr#! and #Y Htgarth#! allowed us to dream once again.'

'To dream of #Y Srrøkheim#!, the great empire of the #Y Silver Dwarves#!.'

'An empire than encompassed all of the territories our ancestors once claimed in our extensive history that traces back to the beginning of the world!'

'Now here we stand, with this dream realized. #Y Elf#!, #Y Goblin#!, #Y Dragkhan#!, #Y Human#!, #G Hobgoblin#!, they all kneel at our feet. At the feet of the great empire of #Y Htgarth#!.'

'The great empire of #Y Hefdarr#!.'

'My empire, #Y Srrøkheim#!.'

Cheers and screams follow as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], the first emperor of #Y Srrøkheim#!, dons his imperial crown.

me_srrorum_27_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_16$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_28_desc.text: Long considered the center of the world, [GetProvince('(int32)3904').GetName|G] has now become a true #Y Sørrborr#! worthy of being the spiritual center of our faith. With the faithful organized, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has been able to claim his rightful place as the spiritual leader of the #T Srrøhebrikk#! world!\n\nAs the leader of those who believe in #Y Htgarth#! and #Y Freja's#! rightful succession as heirs of the #Y Stone Father#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] is obligated to go and bring heretics to the true faith. Indeed, the #T Hebric#! world cannot be united until #T Srrøhebrikk#! armies occupy all of the great primordial caves! Thus, the great #Y Silver Omostthanat#! against our brothers must begin!

me_srrorum_28_tooltip.text: #Y We will claim the #E Holy Caves#! for the #E Silver Pair#!!#!

me_srrorum_29_desc.text: The great #Y City of Knowledge#!, [GetProvince('(int32)3988').GetName|G], has long been a metropolis of academies and libraries. However, with the patronage of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] the city has become a true #Y Sørrborr#! truly worthy of hosting the great #Y Veddtunn#!!\n\nNow hosting a great magic academy, its only a matter of time until the #Y Silver Dwarves#! manage to train magicians able to match the strength of those found in other nations!

me_srrorum_29_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_21$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_30_desc.text:
For millennia the elusive #Y Gerrmoggen#! have used folk magic passed down in their families for generations for all sorts of purposes, commonly causing mischief and mayhem from which the #Y Silver Dwarven#! suspicion of magic stems. Gathering even a few of these mysterious hermits to teach pupils at [GetProvince('(int32)3988').GetName|G] was no easy task, harder still was working with what few experienced mages exist to codify and document a formal style using their techniques.

Despite these challenges, the brilliant mages at the new #G Konungladurr School of Stone Magic#! have meticulously developed the #T Gerrtágadi Style#!, whose users are capable of manipulating stone as if it were made of clay.

With the #Y Gerrmoggen#! put to productive use and a new style that could revolutionize construction and combat, the future of the kingdom looks bright!

me_srrorum_30_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_srrorum_task_22$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_srrorum_31_desc.text: While our people have always utilized terrace farms in our production of food, widespread and efficient use of the land seen in the #Y Verobaen#! farms of the #Y Mythic Age#! have not been seen for millennia! With our realm united, many of our scholars have taken an interest in the ancient techniques utilized by our ancestors. Able to access record from across the #G Green Valley#!, many of them have been able to propose more efficient farms reminiscent of these ancient #Y Verobaen#! models!\n\nWith these farms projecting to substantially increase our yield, there are those in government that have proposed selling the surplus for kingdom to profit from.

me_srrorum_31.a.text: These farms are for the benefit of the people!

me_srrorum_31.b.text: How much profit are we talking about?

me_srrorum_31_tooltip.a.text: #Y We will focus on maximizing the output of our yields!#!

me_srrorum_31_tooltip.b.text: #Y We will focus on maximizing the profits of our yields!#!

03_wakvircu_DESCRIPTION.text: Hundreds of years ago, long before the #Y Great Collapse#! would bring ruin and devastation to those alive to witness it, it is believed that a #T Star from the East#! fell from the skies and landed in the #G Northstar Bay#!. This Star brought strange people with it, angelic beings that spoke in hushed voices and glowed with a soft light, and these pale creatures lived alongside our ancestors as gods and taught our people many things - most importantly, our #Y Stellaric Religion#!. One day, the #Y Visitors#! said that they must leave and that they would fade away with the morning dew, and it came to pass exactly as they said - they vanished into nothingness at daybreak, turning into motes of light that dissipated like a dream.\n\nFor many centuries, we have lived peacefully, protected by the #Y Tayngvw Mountains#! that circle our cities like an impregnable wall. Our civilization has thrived, especially when compared to our neighbors, but infighting amongst our Senators has weakened our position at the worst possible time, for the #R Blood-Stained#! religion is rapidly spreading to our north and we fear for our way of life in the face of their aggression.

03_wakvircu_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has reinvigorated its regional economy through investment and war and has formed the #T Stellaric Consortium#!.

03_wakvircu_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: The scales are perfectly balanced, yet one false move could destroy everything that we have accomplished...

03_wakvircu_task_1_DESC.text: About eighty years ago, a dispute between [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s great-grandfather and the #T Stellaric Guildmasters#! of [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|T] over tax receipts caused the city to declare its independence from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|Y]. These pointless arguments have gone on long enough, however, and it is time that we attempt to mend this rift.\n\n#Y This task will be#! #R bypassed#! #Y if we already own#! #G Cuwa#!.

03_wakvircu_task_2_DESC.text: Now that we have brought the rebellious citizens of [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|T] back into the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective|G] fold, the time has come for us to move our capital from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|Y] back to the majestic city on the coasts where it belongs.

03_wakvircu_task_3_DESC.text: If we hope to expand our control over the trade routes of the #Y Errfalian Sea#!, then we must have a proper navy that is well-trained and staffed with the best sailors that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|G] can produce.

03_wakvircu_task_4_DESC.text: Omens have been taken, and the #G Priests of#! #G [GetDeityDefinition('omen_ying_pin').GetName|G]#! have shared the will of the gods with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] - the holy site for Ying-Pin must be moved from [GetProvince('(int32)1830').GetName|T] to [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|T]. The #Y Commander of Storms#! desires his shrine be placed within the Harbor District of our capital, so that his presence can be felt by our people.

03_wakvircu_task_5_DESC.text: There are two trade goods that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] excel at producing; dyes and glass. It has been proposed by the master craftsmen living at [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|Y] that we combine our two most famous luxury items and begin producing #T Stellaric Stained Glass#! within the capital workshops.

03_wakvircu_task_6_DESC.text: Although the province of [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetArea.GetName|G] is naturally protected by the #Y Tayngvw Mountains#!, there are two overland routes into the #T Stellaric#! heartland that many foreign armies have marched through over the centuries.\n\nIn order to safeguard our borders from the threat of our neighobrs, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has demanded that fortifications be built at [GetProvince('(int32)1740').GetName|T] and [GetProvince('(int32)1779').GetName|T].

03_wakvircu_task_7_DESC.text: Before we can hope to humble our enemies on the battlefield, then we must overhaul the army and tactics; not only must our nobility lead our forces, but we must have manpower reserves on hand to replenish the soldiers that we lose in battle. May #T Renjuun#! bring glory to our warriors!

03_wakvircu_task_8_DESC.text: Although there are many kingdoms and tribes that will oppose our expansion into the #R Bloody Peninsula#!, the armies of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] will not be deterred from conquering what is rightfully ours. There are many valuable resources in the lands to our south that we will need in order to establish the #T Stellaric Consortium#!.

03_wakvircu_task_9_DESC.text: The Oligarchs living within [GetCountry('DR8').GetName|T] have abandoned the safety provided by the #Y Tayngvw Mountains#!, choosing instead to build their cities in the forests and plains of #Y Central Errnorfallie#!. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] is convinced that we can persuade our distant cousins to submit to the authority of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] as long as we guarantee their rights - the #G Stellaric Faithful#! must be united!

03_wakvircu_task_10_DESC.text: There are large swathes of territory within #Y Central#! and #Y Northern Ernorrfalie#! that are unclaimed by the settled tribes living on the plains, and although this could change at any moment, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has proposed that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective|G] treasuries pay for settlers to go inhabit these lands.

03_wakvircu_task_11_DESC.text: There are some trade goods, like stone and horses, that are frustratingly common in many other realms yet remain scarce for us. The unfortunate reality of our position has forced us to invade the forested foothills of the province of [GetProvince('(int32)1938').GetArea.GetName|Y], for we cannot afford to be without these essentials for civilization.

03_wakvircu_task_12_DESC.text: For about eighty years, the city of [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|T] was ruled by cabal of rebellious Senators that took arms against the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state in a brazen display of treasonous defiance, and during those dark days of corruption and misery, the ancient #Y Stellaric Guildhouses#! - the heart of the Old #Y City#!, buildings with religious and historic significance for our people - have fallen into a pitiful state.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has vowed to restore the Guildhouses to their previous glory.

03_wakvircu_task_13_DESC.text: After a period of expensive warfare that drained the resources and will of the State and its citizens, we have finally managed to secure the land required to proclaim our #Y Stellaric Consortium#! - a religious and economic bulwark against the encroachments of the #R Blood-Stained#! to our north and the #G Norrskalkieans#! to the south.

03_wakvircu_task_14_DESC.text: Now that we have possession of the #G Lokvir#! province, with its abundant resources of stone and horses, we must do everything we can to increase production of these goods. Not only must we invest in the local infrastructure, but we must also ensure that the quarries and stables of our new territories are filled with hard-working laborers.

03_wakvircu_task_15_DESC.text: Although it will require a tremendous effort, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] wants to construct earthworks that run from the foothills of the #G Tayngvw Mountains#! to our fortifications in [GetProvince('(int32)1740').GetName|T] and [GetProvince('(int32)1779').GetName|T].\n\nThe [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] believes that shaping the battlefield in this manner this will keep our people eternally safe from the threat of invasion, although some within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|T] are questioning the wisdom and practicality of this idea.

03_wakvircu_task_16_DESC.text: We have heard the disturbing reports emanating from [GetProvince('(int32)1718').GetName|T]; rumors of #R Blood-Stained#! raiding parties sweeping out of the northern mountains, armed with #R Drow#! steel and showing no mercy to prisoners, women and children alike. Although we have occasionally quarreled with [GetCountry('GS1').GetName|T] over the years, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] does not wish to see a #T Stellaric#! neighbor fall to the barbarous hordes that now press against their borders.

03_wakvircu_task_17_DESC.text: The #R Bloody Peninsula#! is known for two things, primarily; the brilliant red beryls that can only be found at [GetProvince('(int32)1814').GetName|T] and the potent brandy that is brewed in the distilleries of the city of [GetProvince('(int32)1879').GetName|T]. Now that we have these territories within our possession, the Guilds are requesting that we invest in the production of these tradegoods.

03_wakvircu_task_18_DESC.text: The pirates that have plagued our shipping in the #Y Errfalian Sea#! should perhaps not be viewed as competitors and nuisances, but as potential friends - should we turn a blind eye to their activities as long as they promise to ignore our ships?\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] believes so, and has proposed an unorthodox solution to a perennial problem. Preliminary messages have been sent to the pirates from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|T], and they are interested in hearing what else [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has to say.

03_wakvircu_task_19_DESC.text: An elegant ship from the islands of the #G Sea Elves#! sailed into the port at [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|T] this morning, causing a commotion in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective|G] capital that has not been seen in some time.\n\n#Y This will start an event chain.#!

03_wakvircu_task_20_DESC.text: [GetCountry('GS2').GetRuler.GetName|T] has written a distressing letter to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] that asks for the aid of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] people.\n\nThey have expressed a willingness to submit to the authority of the #G Stellaric Guildmasters#!, but even though they are afraid of their enemies and in a desperate situation, they still hoping to profit from the situation. Their [GetCountry('GS2').GetRulerTitle] has said that [GetCountry('GS2').GetName|T] will become our #Y Client State#! if we agree to build them a #Y City#! where their capital, [GetProvince('(int32)1860').GetName|T], is located.

03_wakvircu_task_21_DESC.text: For hundreds of years, our ships have patrolled the waters of the #Y Northstar Bay#! in order to keep the trading lanes free of pirates, but the reputation of the #G Stellaric Guildmasters#! suffered greatly when [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|T] declared independence. The time has come to reassert our position as the preeminent naval power in the region - trade will flourish unimpeded under our watchful eyes.

03_wakvircu_task_22_DESC.text: The Senators living in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] have been left to their own devices for too many years, and as a result of their negligence and greed, civic matters within our country have been choked by corruption. Now that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has the political capital to expend, the time has come to reform the #Y Senate#!.

03_wakvircu_task_23_DESC.text: Many of the coins that are collected by the treasurers living within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] have been debased with impurities, and the #Y Guildmasters#! are demanding that a new currency be issued.

03_wakvircu_task_24_DESC.text: Who can deny that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] is the seat of power of a mighty nation? Across all of #G Omniluxia#!, the name of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] is spoken with reverence, for our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] is one of the strongest political leaders in the entire world. Although it will be an expensive undertaking, we must establish embassies in the capital cities of the empires of #G Omniluxia#!.

03_wakvircu_task_25_DESC.text: As our borders expand, it has become increasingly unwieldly for a deliberative body, such as the #Y Senate#!, to properly manage our internal affairs. It has been proposed that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] assumes direct control over the government; an idea that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] seems amenable to.

me_wakvircu_1_desc.text:
[GetCountry('DR7').GetRuler.GetName|Y], the [GetCountry('DR8').GetRulerTitle] of [GetCountry('DR8').GetName|T], would be recorded in the #Y Stellaric Annals#! as the last ruler of an independent [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|G], and [GetCountry('DR7').GetRuler.GetHerHis] bloodless submission to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] would be celebrated annually by the grateful people living within the coastal home of the #Y Stellaric Guildhouses#!.

At long last, a shameful episode that began with arguments over tariffs on dyes and led to a full-blown civil war between the #G Stellaric Guildmasters#! and the #Y Stellaric Senate#! has come to an end. The traitorous #Y Guildmasters#! had relied on mercenaries for over eight decades to selfishly keep the #Y Senate#! away, but in an increasingly dangerous world, [GetCountry('DR7').GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] realized that an independent #T Cuwa#! was at risk for being conquered by armies hostile to the #T Stellaric#! faith. Secret messages and promises were exchanged via back channels, and the garrison of #T Cuwa#!'s citadel surrendered the next morning, opening the city's gates at dawn.

In a magnanimous display, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has agreed not to execute the [GetCountry('DR7').GetRulerTitle] or any of the other rebels, nor let the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] levies sack #T Cuwa#! - things that have earned [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] the love of the city's inhabitants. In truth, the newly-appointed [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle|E] had other things on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] mind - like how [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] should organize the government now that the #Y Stellaric Council of Guilds#! had been restored.

me_wakvircu_1.a.text: Now that we are united, let us become work together as one

me_wakvircu_1_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_1$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_2_desc.text:
For eighty long years, the #Y Stellaric Senate#! lived in exile at [GetProvince('(int32)1740').GetName|G], but now they have returned to [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|G] in glory. No more shall the rightful #Y Senate#! be separated from the #Y Guildmasters#!, the mighty merchants controlling trade throughout eastern #G Luxterra#!, but the two august bodies will be joined together in this day forth in a newly-proclaimed #Y Stellaric Council of Guilds#!.

The greatest celebration ever held within the city of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] was undoubtedly the Festival that accompanied the #Y Proclamation of the Stellaric Republic#!. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], the Head [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] of the newly-empowered #Y Council#!, spent a small fortune to make sure that the people were feasted with wine and bread and that daily games would be held.

For nearly thirty days, donatives were handed out in the streets; gifts of meat and pastry, fresh fruits and sometimes even handfuls of silver and gold coins were tossed into the alleyways, where they were snatched up by the greedy mobs. And inside the palaces, secret ceremonies were held for the elites of the city and offerings were made to the #T Stellaric#! gods, asking for their blessings in the crucial days ahead. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] also made sure to personally meet with the local magistrates in attendance, promising that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] people would always be taken care of.

me_wakvircu_2.a.text: At long last, we are back home in Cuwa where we belong

me_wakvircu_2_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_2$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_3_desc.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] is greatly pleased by the reports of our growing navy, believing that we are starting to become strong enough to assert our will throughout the #G Northstar Bay#! and beyond. There remains much more to be done, of course, but this is a promising beginning.\n\nAs our shipwrights become more and more familiar with the skills required for the construction of war and trade vessels, they are becoming exceptionally knowledgable regarding their craft, and are now able to build quality ships in a much shorter period of time. All things considered, the efforts to rebuild the #Y Northstar Armada#!, the pride of our ancestors, have been an overwhelming success.

me_wakvircu_3.a.text: Tell our men to sail far and wide, searching for new ports of call!

me_wakvircu_3_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_3$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_4_desc.text: After months of upgrades, the #Y Military Harbor#! that was built in [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|G] has finally been completed and the will of [GetDeityDefinition('omen_ying_pin').GetName|E] has been realized - no longer will the #Y Ship-Father#! be worshiped in [GetProvince('(int32)1830').GetName|G], but a new shrine has been constructed near #T Cuwa#!'s sea walls. A local road was built connecting the two cities in order to facilitate the transfering over of Ying-Pin's sacred relics. In addition to this, a large training camp for our sailors was built next to the port district, and the harbor itself has been dredged and expanded - our engineers have had their hands full, to say the least.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has also asked that private quarters for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] be built, so that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] will have an office in which to conduct official state business without asking important dignitaries to travel to the palaces of the citadel or to the Guildhouses. Many days, even before the sun has risen over the #G Northstar Bay#!, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] can be found working in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] chambers, piously burning incense before a small statue of Ying-Pin.

me_wakvircu_4.a.text: May the hands of the Ship-Father protect our navy in the days to come

me_wakvircu_4_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_4$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_5_desc.text: Of all of the things that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] is known for, the ornate leaded windows that are made in the workshops of [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|G] must certainly be the most celebrated by the common people. World-renowned experts of both glassblowing and dye-making, the master craftsmen living within the capital have combined their efforts to produce stunning works of art, and the city streets are colored by swirls of light falling through the stained glass windows of cathedrals and chapels. The #Y Great Temple#! within the city has been beautifed with enormous panels of stained glass that tell the story of the #T Star from the East#! and the history of our ancestors, and the worksmanship is said to be so beautiful that it has brought many to tears.\n\nTo personally thank [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] for making all of this possible, an artisan named [SCOPE.sCharacter('stellaric_craftsmen_of_urn').GetName|Y] has made a gigantic ceremonial urn out of stained glass that bears the same images as the stained glass windows within the #Y Great Temple#!.

me_wakvircu_5.a.text: May this Urn bless the citizens of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]

me_wakvircu_5_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_5$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_6_desc.text: The #Y Tayngvw Mountains#! that circle the province of #G Northstar#! are some of the most formidable natural fortifications within all of #G Omniluxia#!, and many living within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] acknowledge that the lofty peaks of the #G Tayngvw#! range are one of the main reasons that our civilization has thrived over the centuries. Many an invading army has been deterred by the impenetrable wall of stone, and our armies have fought many successful ambushes in the two passes that lead into our province.\n\nWhile we have done well relying on these time-tested tactics in the past, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has recently decreed that fortresses should be built in the mountains, and now the overland routes that lie near [GetProvince('(int32)1740').GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)1779').GetName|G] are watched by some of the best soldiers from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].

me_wakvircu_6.a.text: The Tayngvw Gates shall never be opened again

me_wakvircu_6_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_6$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_7_desc.text: The elite troops that comprise the #Y Champions of Renjuun#! are the deadliest soldiers fighting within the armies of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] and their mere presence on the battlefield is known to raise the morale of our soldiers.\n\nLed by the sons of our noble class, the swords of these warriors are dedicated to the god of war [GetDeityDefinition('omen_renjun').GetName|Y] and ache to spill blood; these soldiers eagerly rush headlong into the fray without a thought for their lives, for the only thing that matters to them is victory for our people.

me_wakvircu_7.a.text: May Renjuun fight alongside our warriors and guide their blades!

me_wakvircu_7_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_7$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_8_desc.text: Ever since assuming power, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has made it known that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] plans on invading the #G Bloody Peninsula#! to our south. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] vision for the future of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] is elaborate and contingent upon a series of steps; after our foreign wars have concluded, the trade goods from our conquests will be funneled to the marketplaces of our capital, where they will eventually find their way onto ships that carry our wares to distant harbors.\n\nThis is no innovation in our history, after all, for this is precisely what our forefathers did before [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|G] rebelled and disrupted our control over the #G Northstar Bay#!. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] believes the time is right for us to reassert our traditional privileges over the #G Bloody Peninsula#!, however, and many in the #Y Senate#! agree with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] - the time for war shall soon be upon us.

me_wakvircu_8.a.text: The Stellaric Consortium shall be formed one way or the other!

me_wakvircu_8_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_8$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_9_desc.text: [GetCountry('DR8').GetRuler.GetName|Y] has been very public with [GetCountry('DR8').GetRuler.GetHerHis] apprehension over [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s political maneuvering over the last few years, all but admitting that the people of [GetCountry('DR8').GetName|T] should prepare themselves for their inevitable annexation. The inhabitants of [GetProvince('(int32)1939').GetName|G], the [GetCountry('DR8').GetAdjective] capital, are of two minds; some are afraid of losing their traditional way of life, but others are excited about the opportunity to learn from us.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] has not downplayed the notion that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] desires the submission of the [GetCountry('DR8').GetAdjective] [GetCountry('DR8').GetRulerTitle], but has publicly vowed to pass reforms that will ensure that all citizens living within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] are afforded the same liberties and rights.

me_wakvircu_9.a.text: The Stellaric Republics are stronger together under our rule

me_wakvircu_9_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_9$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_10_desc.text: Signs have been placed in the busy marketplaces of [GetProvince('(int32)1830').GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)1740').GetName|G] calling for colonists to settle the uninhabited lands around us. The authorities located in the capital have called for men of means to report to their offices to receive grants of land, and any settler that claims territory as their own will be allowed to farm it without paying taxes for the first ten years.\n\nLuckily for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], many of our countrymen have expressed an interest in moving away from the safety of the #G Northstar#! province out into the wild unknown, and some are willing to pay their own way, easing the financial burdens we face.

me_wakvircu_10.a.text: We must take advantage of this spirit of generosity while it is there

me_wakvircu_10_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_10$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_11_desc.text: Our wars in the #G Bloody Peninsula#! have pitted our forces against a variety of determined foes, but victory is ours. The #Y Ascendic Elves#! and #T Blood-Stained#! tribesmen living in the south fought desperately, but ultimately were defeated - a testament to our ability to project military strength outside of the province of #G Northstar#!.\n\nNow that we have secured the Peninsula for the people of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], it is time to consider moving westward into [GetProvince('(int32)1938').GetArea.GetName|G], for there are valuable trade goods in the region that we must have access to.

me_wakvircu_11_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_11$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_12_desc.text: Thanks to the generosity of the current [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], the pride and joy of the city of [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|G], the #Y Stellaric Guildhouses#! that are a physical sign of its economic strength, have been overhauled and renovated. Over the last eighty years, various sections of the Guildhouses had been abandoned to mice and mold, and it required architectural magicians from [GetProvince('(int32)2478').GetName|G] that were trained in the techniques of regenerative restoration to assist our local workers in rebuilding the rotted quarters.\n\nBut now, they have been completely refinished and opened to the public, and many of the richest merchants living within the region have been given their own fully-furnished quarters within the Guildhouses. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has made it very clear that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] desires to grow our business connections with the wider world, and the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] has found many willing partners that are willing to enjoy the benefits of being friends with the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T].

me_wakvircu_12.a.text: Our honor and reputation are restored alongside the Guildhouses

me_wakvircu_12_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_12$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_13_desc.text: In a moment of triumph for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] has been proclaimed from the palaces of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G]. The #T Stellaric#! faithful are no longer constrained by the #Y Tayngvw Mountains#!, but have conquered a mighty dominion that encompasses the plains and forests of the #G Bloody Peninsula#!.\n\nBy all measures, we are a strong economic power - our trade ships visit the ports of the rich kingdoms of #G Omniluxia#!, and our #Y Stellaric Guildhouses#! are home to many of the leading merchant consortiums operating within #G Luxterra#!. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has brought our country to the absolute heights of power, and the people living in the cities along the #G Northstar Bay#! view [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] as their hero, for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] has protected the people during times of chaos.

me_wakvircu_13_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_13$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_14_desc.text: We have wasted no time in extracting the material wealth from the province of [GetProvince('(int32)1938').GetArea.GetName|G], for now that we have steady supplies of stone and horses, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has poured the resources of the #T Stellaric#! state into the region.\n\nThankfully for us, all of these efforts have paid off, and the slaves and serfs sent to work in the stables and mines have mastered their tasks and produce more than we could ask for.

me_wakvircu_14.a.text: Everything is business as usual, then - excellent

me_wakvircu_14_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_14$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_15_desc.text: After a year of grueling work, the labor of our engineers in the bitter cold of the #Y Tayngvw Mountains#! has finally come to an end. Unfortunately for them, unseasonably heavy storms blanketed their work sites with snow, oftentimes slowing their pace to a crawl - many lost days were spent hovering over campfires within tents, waiting for the skies to clear. Nevertheless, they persevered in impossible conditions and in the end, they triumphed over nature and completed the difficult tasks that they were given by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle].\n\nMassive ramparts of stone were raised alongside our fortifications, and now it is difficult to discern where our fortresses end and the mountains begin; everything appears as an impenetrable wall of ice, thanks to the freezing temperatures high in the #G Tayngvw#! Gates that have covered everything with frost. On top of this, our garrisons were expanded and watchtowers were placed along the perimeter of our defenses - the overland route to the #G Northstar#! province is effectively sealed shut.

me_wakvircu_15.a.text: Our enemies will lose all hope when they see what we have done!

me_wakvircu_15_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_15$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_16_desc.text:
[GetCountry('GS1').GetRuler.GetName|Y], the [GetCountry('GS1').GetRulerTitle] of [GetCountry('GS1').GetName|T], has privately expressed doubts over [GetCountry('GS1').GetRuler.GetHerHis] ability to keep the #T Blood-Stained#! armies out of [GetCountry('GS1').GetRuler.GetHerHis] Republic. The news from the northern frontier is grim, and although the [GetCountry('GS1').GetAdjective] levies have fought heroically in the face of overwhelming odds, they believe it is only a matter of time before their luck runs out and their capital falls.

In order to prevent this calamity befalling our #T Stellaric#! brethren, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has sought out an alliance with our neighbors and has found them to be receptive. Not only will this ensure political stability along our shared border, but our combined militaries will hopefully be enough to repel any foreign aggressors.

After the alliance was formalized, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] considered asking our new friend if [GetCountry('GS1').GetRuler.GetSheHe] would be willing to become our #Y Client State#!. The [GetCountry('GS1').GetAdjective] [GetCountry('GS1').GetRulerTitle] is said to be a lover of money - would it not be better for all involved if we made the final decisions involving our mutual security?

me_wakvircu_16.a.text: Together we shall keep Blood-Stained and Helluvian at bay

me_wakvircu_16.b.text: Come now, my friend; retire to a life of ease and let me protect you

me_wakvircu_16_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_16$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_17_desc.text:
Once the rich territories of the #G Bloody Peninsula#! were firmly in hand, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] was quick to send workers to the hills of [GetProvince('(int32)1814').GetName|G] in order to mine the rare red beryl that the region is famous for.

But the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] symapthized with the difficult task of the locals, for mining beryl is very thirsty work indeed, and so [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] ordered that distilleries be built in the nearby city of [GetProvince('(int32)1879').GetName|G] in order to keep spirits high.

Roads were built throughout the region to facilitate the moving of these trade goods, and a port was even built on the coasts so that merchants could come purchase beryl directly from the mines.

me_wakvircu_17.a.text: We shall take excellent care of the Bloody Peninsula...

me_wakvircu_17_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_17$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_18_desc.text: For those living along the shores of the #G Northstar Bay#!, the sight of a pirate ship sailing in the distance in not an unfamiliar one - there are still occasionally rogue ships that will try to slip alongside the coasts, hoping that the navies of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] do not catch them. While many pirates are not foolish enough to test the will of the #Y Northstar Armada#! by raiding our shores, there are plenty of others who are not aware of the fire that they are playing with, and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has grown tired of sending out our ships to chase off the nuisances every other month.\n\nHaving decided that enough was enough, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] sent out messages requesting an audience with the Pirate Guilds, and much to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] surprise, the call was answered. One morning, a strange ship arrived outside of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], and its captain, a notorious pirate named [SCOPE.sCharacter('werhen_pirate_representative').GetName|Y], was tasked with hearing the words of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y].

me_wakvircu_18.a.text: We shall kill every scoundrel that enters our waters!

me_wakvircu_18.b.text: Take back everything that the pirates have stolen

me_wakvircu_18.c.text: Embrace these rascals and build a #R Pirate Haven#! in #E Cuwa#!

me_wakvircu_18_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_18$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_19_desc.text:
[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] was awoken one morning by a loud pounding on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] bedroom door and a stern voice barking from the other side. '[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], there is something down in the harbor that you must see - a #Y Sea Elven#! ship has entered our waters.' This was a rare thing, indeed, and caused [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] to rush from the citadel down to the port district immediately - the last time a reclusive #Y Sea Elf#! had been seen within our waters was generations ago.

Many hours later, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] guest, [SCOPE.sCharacter('stellaric_sea_elf_guest').GetName|Y], were having a quiet but intense discussion in a private room in the #Y Stellaric Guildhouses#!. Many glasses of tea and wine had been poured and the hour was already very late, but [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] gestured for a servant to bring another round and stifled a yawn as [SCOPE.sCharacter('stellaric_sea_elf_guest').GetFirstName|Y] continued her story.

[SCOPE.sCharacter('stellaric_sea_elf_guest').GetFirstName|Y] is an #T Ascendic#! Priestess - specifically a #Y Guardian of the Shrine of Na'athran#! - and she was commanded in a dream to sail for our city. When asked why, the priestess had given a shocking answer; she was sent to bring [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] back to her home, the island of #G Anror Ta-Oswir#! far to the East, so that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] could commune with #Y Na'athran#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim]self.

me_wakvircu_19.a.text: We shall set sail for the island of Anror Ta-Oswir immediately

me_wakvircu_19.b.text: You may stay here with us, [SCOPE.sCharacter('stellaric_sea_elf_guest').GetFirstName], but I am not leaving

me_wakvircu_19_tooltip.text: #Y Our Ruler will go on an adventure...#!

me_wakvircu_19b_tooltip.text: #Y This will end the current event chain.#!

me_wakvircu_20_desc.text: Although some of the Senators living at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] were incensed at the audacity of [GetCountry('GS2').GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s request, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] was one of the few that did not mind the boldness of the [GetCountry('GS2').GetRulerTitle], but rather, found [GetCountry('GS2').GetRuler.GetHerHis] crude honesty refreshing.\n\nThe [GetCountry('GS2').GetAdjective] people have obviously heard of our wealth and influence, and although we share the same beliefs, our kinsmen from across the mountains basically live in squalor - their settlements are primitive affairs, as they spend most of their time riding horses and hunting. They do not have the funds or the means to construct their own city, so asking for our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] engineers to make the journey to [GetProvince('(int32)1860').GetName|G] assist them seems like a small price to pay for their acknowledgment of our authority over them.

me_wakvircu_20.a.text: Most people are afraid to ask for what they want, but not Kosrfalcu

me_wakvircu_20_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_20$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_21_desc.text: Word is rapidly spreading through the pirate camps scattered around eastern #G Luxterra#!; if you value your livelihoods, then avoid entering the #G Northstar Bay#!, for the fleets of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] do not tolerate brigandry in their waters and will attack enemy vessels on sight.\n\nThe efforts of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] to clear the region of piracy have been a smashing success, and countries in the region are beginning to remember that we are the rightful #Y Stewards of the Errfalian Sea#!. Incoming trade to [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|G] has never been better, and our markets are filled with foreign merchants bartering and haggling with the locals.

me_wakvircu_21.a.text: The days of raiding are over, for the seas have been made safe

me_wakvircu_21_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_21$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_22_desc.text: Over the many weeks it took to sail from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] to [GetProvince('(int32)5892').GetName|G], [SCOPE.sCharacter('stellaric_sea_elf_guest').GetName|Y] told [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] about the mysterious god #Y Na'athran#! and how he led her ancestors to the island of #G Anror Ta-Oswir#! millenia ago. Over the last year, #Y Na'athran#! has been appearing nightly in [SCOPE.sCharacter('stellaric_sea_elf_guest').GetFirstName|Y]'s dreams, beseeching her to bring the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] to the eldritch forests of the isle.\n\n'But why would your god want anything to do with me? I am not even #T Ascendic#!...' [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] would often ask the Priestess, and yet the answer was always the same.

me_wakvircu_22.a.text: You will find out for yourself soon enough

me_wakvircu_22_tooltip.text: #Y Our ship continues to sail onward...#!

me_wakvircu_23_desc.text:
It was nighttime when the ship reached the island of #G Anror Ta-Oswir#!, but there were still #T Elves#! waiting to escort [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] to the city of [GetProvince('(int32)5896').GetName|G]. When the exhausted [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] finally reached the Sea #G Elven#! capital, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] was unable to hide [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] amazement at the city's magnificence; [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] had never seen anything like it in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] life, and truth be told, would never see anything like it again.

But there was hardly any time to admire the city, for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] was escorted under guard to a large temple on the outskirts of town and asked to go through its marbled doors. Once inside, stairs in the floor led down into a cave, where torchlight revealed a stream of brackish water that was dripping from the rocks and collecting into a silver basin. A few moments later after [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] arrived, [SCOPE.sCharacter('stellaric_sea_elf_guest').GetName|Y] joined [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] and gestured for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] to drink from the pool of murky water.

'I shall reveal to you a secret, o [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], known to only a handful within all of #G Omniluxia#!; #Y Na'athran#! was a Child of the Star of the East, one of the #Y Visitors#! spoken of in your myths. Drink of the bitter waters and receive the gift of the Eastern Star.'

me_wakvircu_23.a.text: What is happening? I don't understand...

me_wakvircu_24_desc.text: After [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] drank from the waters of the #Y Spring of Na'athran#!, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] lost consciousness, and when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] finally awoke days later, it was on board a ship heading back for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G].\n\n[SCOPE.sCharacter('stellaric_sea_elf_guest').GetName|Y] was not with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], and no messages had been left for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim], which stung more than the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] would have liked to admit. In the end, what the Priestess had set out to do had been accomplished, and there was no need to make it anything more than that.

me_wakvircu_24.a.text: So Na'athran was a Visitor...but what does it all mean?

me_wakvircu_24_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y The Sea Elf Priestess#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_25_desc.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has taken on the unenviable task of reforming the bureaucracy of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T], and after a period of one year, the overhaul of our government has been completed. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] was especially interested in cracking down on corruption, and no stone was left unturned in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] quest to remove the rot from the #Y Senate#!.\n\nAlthough some Senators complained about losing their so-called privileges, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] was adamant that no waste of state funds was acceptable, and the worst offenders have quickly fallen back into line. As a result, our bureacracy is the most efficient that it has ever been, and a spirit of honesty and responsibility resides within our government ministers.

me_wakvircu_25.a.text: I would have it no other way

me_wakvircu_25_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_22$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_26_desc.text: After the #Y Great Collapse#!, the #Y Zani aureus#! remained the standard when it came to gold currency, but they grow fewer in number, and those that are left have been debased by unscrupulous financial ministers and their coin clippers over the centuries.\n\nThere has been no universal standard used by the merchant classes throughout #G Luxterra#!, but this has recently changed; in a sign of our growing economic clout, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has issued a new gold coin from the mints at [GetProvince('(int32)1849').GetName|G], one that surpasses the #Y Zani#! aureus in purity - the #Y Stellaric Stater#!. Over the next hundred years, the #T Stellaric#! Stater would become universally adopted throughout #G Luxterra#! as the currency of Kings and Emperors, and its obverse image of a star plunging into the sea would become known worldwide.

me_wakvircu_26.a.text: We offer prayers to Szing-Szing in thanks

me_wakvircu_26_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_23$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_27_desc.text:
#T Stellaric#! merchants travel across the world, even sailing as far away as the #Y Zani#!-#Y Vetalian#! city of [GetProvince('(int32)3808').GetName|G] in #G Morrigon#! if the weather is with them.

And it is because of our growing presence in foreign lands that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] has permanent diplomats living in the important trade cities of #G Omniluxia#!; [GetProvince('(int32)2478').GetName|G], [GetProvince('(int32)4588').GetName|G], [GetProvince('(int32)2720').GetName|G] and even distant [GetProvince('(int32)2712').GetName|G] have #Y Stellaric Embassies#! tucked away in a district somewhere.

Our emissaries are present at the royal courts, and we maintain a presence in the important conversations of many kingdoms and are oftentimes consulted for our fair-minded counsel, for all are familiar with our name and our economic strength.

me_wakvircu_27.a.text: Our reputation abroad is worth its weight in staters

me_wakvircu_27_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_24$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

me_wakvircu_28_desc.text:
As the borders of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName|T] continue to grow, encompassing distant lands and bringing them into our shared sphere of prosperity, the gears of state have been increasingly gummed up by its size and inherent awkwardness. The #Y Senate#! has attempted to pass various reforms, but none have been able to deal with our problems, which grow more severe by the day.

It was at this crucial time in the history of the Republic that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] proposed a law that would disband the #Y Stellaric Council of Guilds#!, replacing them instead with a #Y Theocratic Monarchy#!. When asked who the new [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle] should be, the acclaim in the #Y Senate#! Hall was overwhelming as the voices of hundreds shouted in unison - [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y], there could be only [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y].

And so, it came to be that the last law passed by the #T Stellaric#! #Y Council#! was its own undoing, for the Senators voted to dissolve the assembly and entrust all power to the House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFamilyDisplayAdjective]. On that fateful day, many undoubtedly voted in line with their conscience, but [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName|Y] had made sure to bribe dozens of influential Senators in advance, and a kingly sum was spent securing their ayes.

me_wakvircu_28.a.text: And let it be known that it was worth every stater spent...

me_wakvircu_28_tooltip.text: The mission task '#Y $03_wakvircu_task_25$#!' has now been #G Completed#!!

zerywani_1_DESCRIPTION.text: The children of #Y Zehi#! once occupied a far greater amount of land, but as the aggressive #Y Samoyi#! tribes pushed from the north, all of #Y Dortry#! was lost. However, when all seemed doomed, the great celestial deer, #Y Jelen#!, graced the denizens of #T Malozechowie#!, giving us protection from further expansion through the magical soulgem mines. Here the city of #G Starogod#! was established, its magic walls emerging from #G Mount Jelen#!.\n\nMany years have passed since the celestial deer graced our city, and since then #T Malozechowie#! has expanded her borders both into #Y Lechii#! and #Y Zechii#! lands. Recent victories embolden us. The winds have changed, and the Celestial Deer clearly is telling us it is time to expand further, and perhaps even reclaim our old homes that we had lost centuries ago.

zerywani_1_CRITERIA_DESCRIPTION.text: This mission will be completed when we have reestablished #Y Zechie#!.

zerywani_1_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.text: Rise, children of #E Zehi#!, the chosen of #E Jelen#!.

zerywani_1_task_1_DESC.text: The #P Soulgem#! fort of #G Starogod#! is famous in our lands, and thus, we have studied them extensively. We should be able to use soulgems to create more powerful forts, although not as mighty as our famous #G Starogod#!'s walls.

zerywani_1_task_2_DESC.text: Our #P Mage#! class has shrunk over time. The discipline is very difficult to master and outside of #G Starogod#!, it is near impossible to study it. We must grow the mage population in order to benefit from the magic passed down from the time of #Y Zehi#!.

zerywani_1_task_4_DESC.text: Although the #G Mihuldorians#! have often come in our way, we should send for any ambitious #G Mihuldorian#! scholars to come and study in #G Starogod#!.

zerywani_1_task_3_DESC.text: Establishing a university of magic will put us in elite company in the world. Not many have our blessed and magical prowess, and it should attract to us even more mages to power our nation's administration.

zerywani_1_task_5_DESC.text: The #Y Lechii#! have long been our perpetual younger brothers. Ever since #Y Lehi#! and #Y Zehi#! split, us #Y Zechii#! have been blessed with knowledge, and they with martial prowess. As annoying as they can be, they deserve their own state, so let us establish such a brother client state.

zerywani_1_task_6_DESC.text: The centralization and growth of our state is clearly a sign from #Y Jelen#! herself that we must expand our influence. We will look East, West, and North to do so.

zerywani_1_task_7_DESC.text: The unification of the kin of #Y Zehi#! will empower our state in the most efficient way possible. Although Malolowii culture has improved significantly in the time it has had to develop on its own, our fellow #Y Lechii#! will surely easily adopt our innovations.

zerywani_1_task_8_DESC.text: The reconquest of the original land, #Y Zechie#!, was a far dream for any of our people to concieve. But now, #Y Jelen#! has spoken, and it is time to return to our ancestral homelands!

zerywani_1_task_9_DESC.text: The #Y Alagurii#! once pushed our people out of their homes. And now, we shall punish them. They will be our workers and peasants, banned from advanced magics, and servants to our #Y Nobles#! and #Y Mages#!.

zerywani_1_task_10_DESC.text: The increasing influence of the #Y Mage#! class has started to influence our politics. By incorporating this into our national identity, we will be able to use this new influence to our advantage.

zerywani_1_task_11_DESC.text: Establishing the #Y Kingdom of Souls#! would surely please mighty #Y Jelenia#!. In her name we conquered, and now with our victories behind us and dreams achieved, we should honor the mighty celestial deer as we have always done.

zerywani_1_task_12_DESC.text: #G Napkor#!, a rather unimpressive place, apparently held value in the ancient times. And through another great blessing from #Y Jelenia#!, the produce of #G Napkor#! secretes important ingredients for #Y Elixir#! craft.

zerywani_1_task_13_DESC.text: With an abundance of #Y Elixir#! produced in our borders, we may begin working on an #G Elixir of Life#!, which will heal our warriors at a speed unheard of this side of #G Mount Jelen#!.

zerywani_1_task_14_DESC.text: With an abundance of #Y Elixir#! produced in our borders, we may begin working on an #R Elixir of Harm#!, able to be used against our enemies, burning their skin, and improving our offensive capabilities.

zerywani_1_task_15_DESC.text: By combining the #Y Elixir#! crafting skills we have acquired with our #Y Soulgem#! technologies, we can create an #T Elixir of Soul#!, able to further strengthen our will itself!
